listings.rawTitle: NGC 6302 | Butterfly Nebula 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: NGC 6302, also known as the Butterfly Nebula, is a planetary nebula in the constellation Scorpio, 4000 light years from Earth. It looks like a giant, glowing insect in space, with two colorful “wings”, and a dark band of dust through the middle that resembles a body. Its central star is one of the hottest stars currently known. This extrait entangles our outer space and your inner space with a combination of bright fruit, iridescent florals and hazy mint. The camphorus, bitter blackcurrant of bucchu leaves collides head-on with tropical fruits and narcotic florals before softly descending to Earth via ambered patchouli and incense. Butterfly Nebula — a freezing void meets floral inferno..

Then come the fruits, carried by Timur, a citrusy spice with peppery accents: grapefruit, blood orange, peruvian lime, mandarin. The cacao comes alive, electrified by the burst of citrus: a thrill of indulgence.. Maître-parfumeur : Céline Perdriel.

A saffron-infused rum set ablaze by the fiery heat of Jamaican pimento. This bold opening gives way to a molten heart of cacao, discreetly amplified by a whisper of cinnamon. The opulent trail swells with roasted facets: tonka bean, hazelnut, and coffee.. Maître-parfumeur : Céline Perdriel.

A fragrance between modernity and nostalgia. A spring air, full of velvet and tender flowers, awakened by the crisp burst of pink peppercorn. Iris, thus contrasted, vibrates from root to petal to become even more expressive: in its trail, the delicate memory of a powder case.. Maître-parfumeur : Valérie Garnush.

Game of opposites, game of contrasts. First the coriander envelope: fresh, airy, and dashing. Then the heart of iris, blended with Osmanthus flower absolute, with apricot notes — suave and velvety. A chiaroscuro of flowers and fruits, a gourmet fragrance that cultivates paradox with elegance.. Maître-parfumeur : Laure-Emmanuelle Hermay.

Treasures of the Damascena rose. Fruity, honeyed, and opulent, it plunges into a spicy heart of Sri Lankan cinnamon and ends its journey in the tender, leathery warmth of ambery balms and woods. A captivating charisma, made of power and delicacy.. Maître-parfumeur : Dalia Izem.

A journey into the heart of a dream where amber vapors drift. Opening with a spicy note of Indonesian nutmeg, this sensual fragrance reveals the powerful and precious scents of Moroccan Damascena rose. A warm trail, almost incandescent, shaped with roundness and elegance.. Maître-parfumeur : Benoist Lapouza.

A fragrance that reveals the aphrodisiac powers of Guatemalan cardamom. It prolongs the journey into a heart of a thousand fresh and gourmet petals — those of the Grasse Centifolia rose. Deeply voluptuous, it is the perfume of skin warmed by the gentle rays of the sun.. Maître-parfumeur : Vincent Ricord.

A gourmet adventure at the heart of the oriental organ. The journey, initiated by the brilliance of Sichuan, continues on an addictive, opulent patchouli with vanilla. A reverie of incense, balms, and resins… A generous itinerary, resolutely sensual, steeped in seduction.. Maître-parfumeur : Corinne Cachen.

Comfort and sensuality, like an olfactory caress. On the deep, heady framework of patchouli, cinnamon — the queen of spices — leaves the imprint of delicate Oriental wisps. A cocooning perfume, a fur-like fragrance, warming both skin and spirit.. Maître-parfumeur : Émilie Bouge.

A zesty patchouli, infused with light and freshness. Sparkling pink peppercorn is its first partner. Then come ginger and the citruses. Finally, green and tonic tea leaf… Astonishing encounters for a tropical sea breeze, woody and oceanic, as invigorating as it is mesmerizing.. Maître-parfumeur : Corinne Cachen.

A return to ancestral origins. Opening with Guatemalan cardamom and Moroccan artemisia, this fragrance concentrates at its heart the perfect accord between the woody, sensual richness of oud and the smoky scent of balms and Bulgarian tobacco absolute. A luminous trail, imbued with an impertinent spirit and intense contrasts.. Maître-parfumeur : Bernard Maccini.

A spirited and enveloping fragrance. At the opening, an explosive, almost exuberant energy carried by pink peppercorn. Then comes a rosy, exotic heart, flirting with the beauties of the East. The aromas are sun-kissed and the trail sophisticated — making the essence all the more addictive.. Maître-parfumeur : Claire Chambert.

A spirited, vibrant, and soaring fragrance. Saffron, with its woody and gently leathery inflections, lifts the oud and bathes it in a purple glow. A bold perfume with a thousand smoky facets, elevated by the softness of rose.. Maître-parfumeur : Émilie Bouge.

An oud dressed in leather boots, a fragrance born from the encounter between two worlds. The first is round, comforting, wrapped in a vanilla veil. The other is darker, shaped by resinous nuances of incense and myrrh. A contrast that is both intriguing and captivating.. Maître-parfumeur : Philippe Romano.

Named after a Turkish sabre, this unexpected aromatic woody fragrance is an invitation to follow in the stead of Ottoman horsemen. The spicy patchouli, wood and musk accord reveals a temperament in keeping with this imaginary tableau: bewitching, surprising, warm and bold.. Dominated by cypress, its invigorating herbal accord is pierced by enigmatic frankincense: a bold combination that is confident and not afraid to be provocative. A virile and exotic olfactory signature.. Yatagan, the signature of a warm-hearted adventurer..

Parfum Sacré is a spicy floral amber fragrance made of highly concentrated precious ingredients. An explosive alliance of pepper and a singular myrrh absolute.. The exquisitely scented, almost erotic myrrh resin is enveloped in musk to warm the sumptuous floral heart where two queens of the flower world reign: a jasmine absolute and a rose essence of outstanding quality. The beauty of this fragrance also lies in its originality, which is achieved by a cocktail of pungent and radiant spices: fiery pepper, cinnamon, clove and coriander essences add even more heat to its enigmatic perfume trail.. The bewitching signature of an absolutely irresistible woman. This Parfum Sacré is an unsettlingly, sensual and divine nectar..

listings.rawTitle: Rose Ivoire De Caron 100 ml EdP
listings.description: Pure, gentle, soothing. Rose Ivoire enhances the charm of sensitive, delicate characters. Discreet, demure personalities, who exude serenity and kindness. Mysterious souls with a lush secret garden. It envelops them in a soft bubble, creating a gentle cocoon where dreams and imagination can flourish..

Fleur de Rocaille is the airy imprint of an independent soul. A spirit who lives unfiltered, awash in her many shades. With a heart stirred by feelings, she watches, vulnerable and discreet. Attentive and gentle, she appears as delicate as the petals of a lilac flower. Yet she is also a free spirit drawn to ever-larger territories. Effervescent, exalted, and radiant, her joy echoes through every corner of the world. She glows with a joy that commands every glance. Fleur de Rocaille is the scent of nuanced personalities, sunny and stirring, the essence of ultimate femininity..

Lady CARON is an dazzling perfume. Its flower and fruit pairing results in a daring and exhilarating blend of ingredients. Magnolia flower essence, a rare material from China, envelops the rosy hues of freesia, the freshness of neroli essence and the sweetness of Indian jasmine absolute. Deliciously subtle, a peach note adds a juicy colourful element of surprise, and carries off the magnolia in a whirlwind of light breathing irresistible joy into the fragrance. Almost intoxicating.. This Lady CARON is a joyful luminous aura and an ode to freedom..

Tabac Exquis is the secret of a playful soul.. One who loves, more than anything, to take on new challenges, reshuffle the cards of the world, and share life’s pleasures. It is the scent of audacious characters capable of inspiring infinite possibilities.. Their magnetic determination obsesses and reassures. Smiling, they take risks and stand out. With a single glance, they attract attention and anticipate desires. Tabac Exquis is a delicious vertigo of thrilling encounters, sincere laughter, and animated discussions, by which everyone longs to be carried away..

Pois de Senteur announces the arrival of a breathtaking personality. Her discerning and sophisticated appearance, curated down to the smallest detail, impresses all. Her instantly recognisable silhouette draws every eye, standing out from the crowd. We wait for her, we recognise her, she reassures us with her permanence. Her elegance is her self-assurance, her confidence in her every attribute..

Musc Oli is the scent of souls marked by quiet sensitivity. Those who know how to listen deeply, to hear their truest needs and connect inwardly. To find themselves in stillness. They rebuild their precious link between mind and emotion, iridescent. Reawakening each facet of their being. Thus, they are reborn, ready to offer their steady energy to the vastness of the universe..

In the brilliance of a mineral landscape, light pirouettes across the silvery steppes. The vast, clear sky stretches endlessly, a canvas for the soul. The air hums with a crystalline clarity, overflowing with new energy, like a gentle breath brushing against the skin. Space and time seem to pause in the grandeur of the surroundings. A moment of fulfillmentemerges, where absolute, anchored, and palpable freedom takes form. It is this first breath to which the fragrance owes its name: Atmah, inspired by the Sanskrit word Atman, a fundamental term that speaks to the vital essence, the innermost spirit of every living being. In Indian tradition, it embodies the connection between the individual and the universal, a primordial breath that transcends the boundaries of time.An invocation of energy and inner radiance. “For me, Atmah is the elegance of the soul, it elevates it with grace,” shares Olivia de Rothschild. The name also resonates with her family’s legacy. In 1898, Baron Edmond de Rothschild, Olivia’s great-great-grandfather, acquired a cruising yacht named Atmah. Emboding a spirit of freedom for the family, a spirit that this fragrance continues to reflect today..

Created in 1934, Pour Un Homme de CARON is the first men’s fragrance in the history of perfumery. Still regarded today as a masterpiece of modern perfumery, it remains a timeless symbol. Born from the bold marriage of radiant lavender and an exquisite vanilla note, it has since become synonymous with the olfactory heritage of Maison CARON. A creation of absolute modernity, cherished and passed down from generation to generation..

Comme des Garcons and indie fashion brand Denim Tears have created Tears, an eau de parfum composed around the scent of cotton. The fragrance draws on rural Georgia just after the rain, when heat rises off the red clay and the cotton fields sit wet and green. Perfumer Paul Guerlain built the musk floral as a dry composition with a hay-like warmth. The opening pairs green and resinous galbanum and sage, before revealing a grassy, powdery core of daffodil, jasmine, flouve and orris. Vetiver, hay, cypriol and musk lands a dry, earthy finish. .

listings.rawTitle: Very Bad Rice 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Very Bad Rice conjures a very good/nice tropical holiday in Southeast Asia. Smell your way to a change of scenery courtesy this fruity-solar freshie. Picture yourself on the beach, kicking back with an ube latte in hand, an ultra-creamy mango sticky rice on the go, an ice-cold piña colada coming up, and the sun warming your heart. . Perfumer: Ambre Bouchard . .

listings.rawTitle: Gueule de Bois 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: “Gueule de bois” is French slang for “hangover”, translating literally as “wooden mouth”. This extrait is olfactory “hair of the dog”: a boozy, smoky, spicy scent to revive you after the excesses of the night before. Here we have a comforting rum spiked with pepper, cinnamon and incense, mellowed with sandalwood and sweetened amber.. Perfumer: Amelie Bourgeois .

listings.rawTitle: God Bless Cola 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Yes you can smell the cola, but also the bubbles, the metal can, and the mouthful of caramel popcorn you’re about to wash down with the next swig. Movie night in a bottle. . Perfumers: Camille Chemardin and Elia Chiche . .

listings.rawTitle: Rital Date 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: This “Italian date” is a neo-lemon that surprises your nose with zigs and zags. This is an aromatic gourmand through the lens of Italian abundance, with notes of pesto, fennel, olive oil, oregano and pistachio. And don’t forget the scoop of ice cream! Very appe-teasing.. Perfumers: Camille Chemardin, Amelie Bourgeois, Elia Chiche .

listings.rawTitle: Culot The 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Culot Thé is French for “tea time”. This joyful jasmine and apricot-infused tea perfume is spiced up with a kink: notes of ginger, garlic and wasabi playing peek-a-boo with the fruit and floral. Sparkling and smile-inducing.. Perfumer: Anne-Sophie Behaghel .

listings.rawTitle: Сroissant Сafe 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A “life is good” perfume, conjuring the cozy pleasures of a French-style breakfast. Smell the milk in the cappuccino, the butter on the croissant. Roasted and toasted, with the wraparound warmth of salty/nutty tonka bean.. Perfumer: Margaux Le Paih Guérin .
Perfumer: Christophe Raynaud accepted the challenge of translating into a perfume the soft and sensual voice of Marvin Gaye singing Sexual Healing….
Perfumer: Frank Voelkl translated this captivating and romantic jazz piece with Jeff Buckley's interpretation in mind.. .

listings.rawTitle: Like a Virgin Unplugged 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Perfumer: Fabrice Pellegrin approached the song through the angle of a soft transition into a new era..
Master Perfumer: Alberto Morillas chose a subtle and literal interpretation of this iconic pop standard, while hinting at the irreverent touch Madonna instilled into the song..
Perfumer: Christophe Raynaud was inspired by the provocative screen interpretation of this romantic anthem by Sara Montiel..

The rose in Italian is “la rosa”. Reverse the perspective, come at it from a different angle, go right to left, and you get “Asoral”. This extrait burrows into the very essence of a young, dewy-petalled rose, taking you on a journey from the outside world to the inner you. This is achieved with a union of Turkish rose and Rosa Lani, a complex rose with vibrations of liquorice, tea and hay. Creamy magnolia, rosy-esque peony and soft musks add even more plushness, elevating Asoral to a radiant smile-bringer.. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali .

A place that is eternally cherished in the heart — its memory, the feeling. It may be hidden or obscured, but never erased. In this place, the wind carries myrrh, earth welcomes rain, and fire doesn’t burn but transforms. Outopia marries the ancient oils of myrrh, frankincense and opoponax with modern aromachemicals: the marine/anise of Naxolide and the woody/amber of Maderal. Cool, earthy, smouldering.. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali .

The most radical revolution is the one within. Re-Evolution surprises and liberates with its sweet earthiness. Muddy patchouli, the watery muguet of Aqual and the smoky leather of Orcanox align with amber and marine notes to lead you to the deepest transformation possible: inside the ocean of yourself.. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali .

An intense amber fragrance that smells like an early stop on the historical perfume timeline. Resinous labdanum, peppery elemi and spicy cardamom join forces like a Spice Trail classic, while hay-like yerba mate and fruity-floral osmanthus buffer the impact. Vetiver root supplies structure, before the whole caravan softens into an exotic skin scent..

This enigmatic creation shimmers between dusty chocolate leather and rain on warm concrete. Rare Tuscan orris lends a soft, mineral veil; dark cacao casts a velvety shadow. Vetiver, copaiba wood and oak moss create a tough, leather-adjacent effect. Unplaceable yet comforting. .

listings.rawTitle: Special Edition Neroli+Cannabis 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A moody interpretation of neroli, where time slows and senses gently drift. Bright Moroccan neroli blossoms entwine with the dark, green fog of cannabis leaf. This coupling is enriched by the animal funk of beeswax absolute, poshed up by elegant orris root. Zesty green mandarin and honeyed orange blossom water float the composition on a sparkling cloud of citrus. Space out in a fragrant haze. . This perfume contains beeswax and thus is not vegan. .

A commanding scent that opens with a leathery lick of nargarmotha root and dark, aromatic patchouli leaf, with a hit of sharp makrut lime leaf. All of this sets the scene for the uncompromising raw green of vetiver root, while Somali frankincense and Moroccan Atlas cedarwood provide venerable ballast. Sensual, earthy, authoritative. This is the perfume that launched Ra:er..

listings.rawTitle: In principio V2 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: According to ancient religious scriptures, Mary mother of Jesus was informed of her destiny by the Archangel Gabriel when she was about 13 years old. Artists over the centuries have been captivated by the idea of this scene, a startled schoolgirl recoiling in shock from the supernatural being. The lily, symbolizing purity and innocence, is not only a common element of these artworks, but is also the inspiration for this extrait. In principio, Latin for “in the beginning”, is a meditation on the creamy radiance of lily, supported by the down-low sensuality of ylang ylang. Mace, sweeter than nutmeg and softer than incense, lends clarity, while sweet/tart kumquat sharpens the focus.. Limited to 58 bottles, 48% extrait.. Blended with:. White lily absolute, Kumquat essential oil, Mace absolute, Nutmeg tincture, Bitter orange essential oil , Ylang Ylang essential oil, Elemi essential oil, Tuscan cypress essential oil, Pompia essential oil, Turkish rose absolute, Rosewood essential oil, Frankincense rivae, Juhi jasmine absolute, Cistus tincture, Ambergris. . . Important notice: . Zanini blends are living botanical compositions, crafted entirely from natural materials and free from synthetic fixatives or stabilizers. As with all things living, subtle variations are part of their nature: over time, you may notice a gentle evolution in colour, texture, or the appearance of natural sediment. These are not imperfections, but part of the character of the raw materials themselves.. These blends are olfactive smellscapes (but neither aromatherapy, nor ‘spray-and-go’ perfumes) and sensory experiences, closer to works of art created in the scented plane (rather than, say, visual or audio).. Certain essential oils and absolutes that are used in Zanini’s 100% natural blends may potentially cause allergies in some people. Please spray Zanini’s blends on fabric (on sleeves, scarves, etc.). . Zanini advise that those who are prone to allergic reactions, pregnant and nursing women, as well as people with chronic illnesses to be extra careful. Before trying natural blends, study the list of ingredients and consult with a doctor if you are not sure or a had a history of allergies. If you do decide to put these blends on your skin (unable to resist the temptation) always test the blend on the inside part of your elbow first and wait.. Do not spray these blends liberally as a cloud in the way you would spray a conventional perfume. Zanini’s smellscapes need to be… carefully applied and experienced. Be mindful that some oils can also make your skin hyper-sensitive to UV..

listings.rawTitle: Rosa umami V2 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The open salvo of Rosa umami is UMAMI in all-caps: salty, rich, tangy and borderline bitter. Before it goes full fermentation freak-out, this extrait changes course and settles into a bouquet of roses: rose de mai, Bulgarian, white rose, rugosa. Luxury darkness.. Limited to 59 bottles, 48% extrait.. Blended with:. Giuseppe Arcimboldo was the 16th century Italian painter famous for his fantastical portraits of human heads composed of vegetables, flowers, fruits and books. In this extrait, the grill is a canvas, delicately charring an abundance of greenery. There’s the bitterness of artichoke, the aquatic gleam of celery, the sweetness of tomato, the richness of carrot, the umami of mushroom, the spearmint of nepetella, the fresh-cut grass of bell pepper. Rosa cymosa’s syrupy compote nuance brushes a jammy glaze across this artwork. . Limited to 35 bottles 38% extrait.. Blended with:. Rosa cymosa absolute, . May rose absolute,. Bell pepper tincture,. Inspired by the concept of amuse-bouche, a single bite designed by the chef to awaken the palate before the main course. Ruby Glazed captures that moment with a vibrant composition that unites lemon drizzle with an almond bite and a metal sheen. Liquorice-sweet star anise chafes beautifully against a raspberry coulis accord, made sensuous with orange blossom. A saffron-inflected vanilla renders the dry down golden and warm.. Perfumer: Sébastien Cresp .

At the heart of the course, the table meets fire.. Black pepper is freshly crushed, chestnuts are slowly roasted, and sea salt and crispy seaweed are transformed over open heat.. Charred Wood is the main course of The Table Collection, inspired by ingredients elevated through fire, smoke, and time.. The fragrance opens with the dry heat of black pepper. Roasted chestnut adds a comforting nuttiness with a subtle sweetness, while smoked sea salt introduces mineral facets and smoky texture, giving the composition a bold, defined structure.. At its heart, slowly brewed fermented tea unfolds with deep, earthy richness. Korean seaweed crisp brings a delicate roasted salinity, transforming familiar ingredients into something darker, more textured, and unexpectedly sophisticated. Incense resin and myrrh deepen the composition with warm resinous notes, while clove leaf adds a refined touch of spice that keeps the fragrance vibrant and alive.. The base settles into the dry warmth of charcoal and the clean grain of hinoki wood. Amber wood glows like embers long after the flames have faded, while patchouli and vetiver anchor the composition with the quiet depth of earth and roots.. The fire has disappeared, but its warmth lingers on both the plate and the skin. Charred Wood is the main course of The Table Collection, capturing the deepest flavors born from fire and smoke.. Perfumer : Christian Provenzano .

This is a beautifully rounded fig on the mellow end of the spectrum. Bright bergamot, cardamom and galbanum open the fragrance with confidence, leading into a smooth fig accord layered with iris, cypress and soft floral nuances. The earthy, woody base glows with subtle musk.. Perfumer: Ralf Schwieger .

The moment when the night draws in close, hugging the deliciousness of the evening towards you. Cognac, crème brûlée and coffee blur into guaiac wood and oak, releasing vanilla-tinged smoke in a haze of pleasure. An echo of warmth in the darkness..

Glowing red in the dusk, this latex cherry is spiced with clove, dusted with heliotrope, rolled in vanilla, smoked in tobacco. It’s cushy and cozy, but just a little wicked. 20359 is the postcode of St Pauli, the Hamburg district where 32.JULI was founded. For centuries, sailors arriving through Hamburg's harbour, artists, musicians and night owls have shaped the neighbourhood's unmistakable character. Known for its independent spirit, iconic nightlife and historic red light district, Sankt Pauli is a place where stories begin. The fragrance captures the anticipation of an evening just unfolding, lifting the cocktail cherry from the first drink of the night..

Like late summer afternoon in a garden, when light, air and nectar merge into one another. May rose is given extra oomph with the fruity fullness of pear and cassis blossom. Sandalwood and ambrette suggest bare, kissed skin..

Light, sand, dreams of faraway places. This creamy tropical floral is built around insinuating jasmine sambac and tiare, fleshed out with coconut and vanilla. A sun lotion accord conjures bare skin gleaming on the beach, while sandalwood lends comfortable milkiness..

A mineral mood at the intersection of bright green galbanum, sour-fruity verjus, and earthy-celery angelica. Like a clear morning on the shore, when water hits stone and mist hangs in the air. Dew glistens on the foliage..

Andevalo was born under the blazing sun of western Andalusia. A land where cistus shrubs exude a thick, resinous gum saturated with heat and light. This extrait is built around a trio of labdanum extracts, expressing their full ambery depth. Strawberry CO₂ extract, along with raspberry and black cherry accords, bring a pulpy, sensual brightness, quickly absorbed by supple leather and mineral warmth. Enveloping dark woods and patchouli leave a dense and long-lasting trail of smoke and dark sweetness.. Perfumers: Coralie Spicher and Fabrice Pellegrin .

Andevalo was born under the blazing sun of western Andalusia. A land where cistus shrubs exude a thick, resinous gum saturated with heat and light. This extrait is built around a trio of labdanum extracts, expressing their full ambery depth. Strawberry CO₂ extract, along with raspberry and black cherry accords, bring a pulpy, sensual brightness, quickly absorbed by supple leather and mineral warmth. Enveloping dark woods and patchouli leave a dense and long-lasting trail of smoke and dark sweetness.. Perfumers: Coralie Spicher and Fabrice Pellegrin .

A surround sound symphony of uplifting tea and apricotty osmanthus. Frangipani and orange blossom smile in the opening, while oolong tea swirls to the surface in this subtle brew. Osmanthus, the flower that bridges the gap between apricot and tea, joins forces with guaiac wood for a delightfully smooth and happy smellscape.. Perfumer: Kong Dexing .

Le Régent explores the origins of the Maison Oriza L. Legrand, back in the 18th century when it was called Parfumerie Oriza de Fargeon-Aîné at the “Perfumed Court” of King Louis XV. This luscious, powdery amber harnesses Peru balsam with its sweet smoky warmth, along with Tolu balsam’s dark vanilla resin. Benzoin extends the puffy-wuffiness, while guaiac wood and leather solidify the softness.. Perfumer: Hugo Lambert.

The name Alyazia is associated with a rare and delicate gazelle, symbolising grace, elegance and natural beauty. With its traditional Bedouin roots, the name has a strong connection to the heritage of the Arabian Gulf. The fragrance opens with plush, tender violet, illuminated by a solar heart of wild strawberry and orange blossom. The cushioned base of iris, vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood extends the “ahhhhhhh” of this comforting scent..

An electric collision of molecules: the effervescence of spicy pepper seeds suspended within darkness. Dry, fizzing Madagascan pepper cracks open against fiery cedarwood. Rich Akigalawood (upcycled patchouli with a peppery/woody profile) blends in blazing harmony with the caramel powderiness of tonka bean. A musky accord softens any sharp edges. . Perfumer: Antoine Maisondieu .

Ambergris has long been revered as one of the most precious materials in classical perfume, owing to its beguiling complexity. Musky, marine and earthy, this digestive byproduct of the sperm whale is known as “floating gold”. Veiled Ambergris unfolds on an abstracted bouquet of plum blossom, gardenia and rose, made more insinuating with the overripeness of mimosa. Gradually, ambergris makes itself known, its animalic resonance deepened with musk and castoreum.. Perfumer: Jin Yongshan . .

listings.rawTitle: Love In A Mist 30 ml EdP
listings.description: This fragrance captures the essence of a Chinese summer — the tingling mint and cool eucalyptus of dusky mountain air, the aromatics of shiso, lavender and chamomile as the darkness deepens, the grounding woods and greens of cypress, vetiver and galbanum. A dream of summer rewritten — nostalgic and gently magical.. Perfumer: Jin Yongshan .

Perilla Peach & Ginger is inspired by a Hunan summer drink of lime, herbs and honeyed fruit, served in a green glass jar as a little ritual against the heat. This vivid EdP opens on a lively burst of Thai lime and aromatic perilla leaf (shiso), layered with warm ginger and ripe peach. Gentle gardenia melts into a clean trail of white musk and warm labdanum.. Perfumer: Liu Yang .

Bamboo captures the tranquil greenness of spring and summer in Zhejiang — a vision of misty hills and swaying bamboo after the morning fog has lifted. The breeze carries fresh green leaves through a soft haze of lily of the valley, jasmine and geranium. A breath of earth is suggested by vetiver and patchouli, while ambergris and cypress wrap the scent in a warm, resinous calm.. Perfumer: Juan Liu .

An intense incense that shapeshifts between cold/smoky and warm/creamy. This dream belongs to the mythological Irish warrior poet Ossian, who inspired the Romantic literary movement across 18th century Europe. Rêve d'Ossian conjures misty midnight forests with smouldering notes of pine, frankincense and myrrh, before calling forth the benevolence of Celtic fairies with mellow tonka bean and vanillic benzoin.. Perfumer: Hugo Lambert.

After the first rains of autumn, the woods exhale salubrious scents of peat, moss and petrichor — the ideal antidote to the scorching summer heat. Chypre-Mousse was first launched in 1914 for the dandies of the new century, and this iteration reinterprets a classic fougere with contemporary materials. This explosively aromatic blend hums with wild mint and fennel in a swirl of earthy oak moss, peppery green angelica and fresh pine. Bring the outdoors in with Chypre-Mousse.. Perfumer: Hugo Lambert.

Following in the tradition of the iconic lily-of-the-valley perfumes Coty Muguet des Bois and the original Dior Diorissimo (both long gone), gorgeous Muguet Fleuri is the modern day standard for muguet soliflores. In the wild, this innocent-smelling flower is highly poisonous, but in its perfume form, the only danger is its aura of fresh-faced naughtiness. Muguet Fleuri places lily-of-the-valley in a dewy, garden green setting, grass freshly cut. After all the crisp brightness, the drydown is creamy and sensuous.. Perfumer: Hugo Lambert.

The abandoned chapel of a Cistercian abbey. Cold stone walls, covered in moss. The waxen wood of ornate pews, the linseed oil of an unfinished painting. Myrrh and frankincense linger in the air, along with . spicy white lilies. The subtle scent of golden pollen mingles with that of solemn green leaves. The call of the divine.. Perfumer: Hugo Lambert.

An enigmatic white floral that flickers between vintage and futuristic. Sky-high aldehydes on the opening thicken with the bracing effect of eucalyptus and pepper. Ylang-ylang and rose beckon the nose closer, the plushness enhanced with get-with-me benzoin and musk.. Perfumer: Hugo Lambert.

Beso Deseo es el instante previo. La tensión que se construye en silencio antes de que todo ocurra. . Una fragancia que une la intensidad del oud con la luminosidad de las frutas — sensual, elegante y profundamente adictiva. La chispa invisible entre dos miradas hecha perfume. .
Moonlight on wet cobblestones. A bottle of white wine in the pocket of a suede coat. White flowers and kissed skin. Cherries and cigarette smoke linger on warm hair. The punks are in charge..

“Zelen” translates to “green” in Serbian. This is vetiver as it was meant to be celebrated, energised by the natural world. The emerald earthiness of vetiver is lifted toward the sun on a cloud of lime, bergamot and pink peppercorn. Green cardamom and beeswax absolute deepen the allure of Mysore sandalwood and Virginia cedar. This composition is 25% parfum concentration, of which nearly 75% are natural ingredients. Capped with Italian Carrara marble in a delicately etched glass bottle. .

“Suze” (SOO-zeh) translates to “tears” in Serbian.Tears may not have a physical scent, but they release an emotional essence that lingers in the air like an unspoken perfume. This emotional extrait is a strange swirl of spearmint and ghostly flowers: pale jasmine, magnolia and lily-of-the-valley. Orris butter upholsters the complexity, while a solemn base of benzoin and fossilised amber grounds the experience.. This composition is 25% parfum concentration, with 88% natural ingredients. Capped with Spanish Nero Marquina marble in a delicately etched glass bottle. .

“Živeli” (ZHEE-vuh-lee) is a common Serbian toast used to wish good health and a long life. In this extrait, a juicy burst of plum brandy melts into a leathered tobacco, encapsulating a celebratory night out with friends. Giddy joy is further fluffed by cherry and raspberry notes, while the leather aspect is warmed by honey, saffron and labdanum.. This composition is 24% parfum concentration, with 70% natural ingredients. Capped in Mexican Riviera Gray marble in a delicately etched glass bottle. .

listings.rawTitle: Devoti Peccatori 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The name means “devout sinners”, conjuring that delicious tension between our best intentions and our wicked ways. In this parfum, syrupy caramel drizzles over rich osmanthus, dark cocoa twins with ambergris’ sweet earthiness, bright orange dances with leathery cypriol. Precious mysore sandalwood underpins the composition. An invitation to lead with the soul.. Perfumer: Xavier Blaizot.

listings.rawTitle: Amori Peccatori 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The name means “sinful loves”, but there’s no sin in loving a perfume as irresistible as Amori Peccatori. This parfum deposits a quick kiss of fresh grapefruit and pink pepper before getting straight to the point: a plush pillow of orris, tonka bean and vanilla. The base of patchouli, amber and animalic musks lets people know you mean business.. Perfumer: Maud Chabanis.

The name means “dominant saints”, and the angel in charge here is Tunisian Orange Blossom Absolute, flying in clouds of amber, vanilla, and a touch of crème brûlée. A distinctive salted skin accord, along with a gourmand-ified patchouli, adds a rasp to the sweetness.. Perfumer: Maud Chabanis.

The name means “immortal saints”, and this eau de parfum is a timeless white floral that conjures sunshine and joy. Blood orange and Champagne fizz out of the top, swirling around lavish tuberose and heady jasmine grandiflorum. The holy trinity of Cashmeran, ISO E Super and ambroxan creates a base that clings to skin, fabric and memory. . Perfumer: Maud Chabanis.

Spiritually, four symbolizes the wholeness of the universe, four elements, four seasons, four cardinal points, connecting us all. Kajal IV spirits us to the wilderness of the African savannah, drawing a straight line between the dawn of humans to our ever-expanding world. The undulating golden panorama caressed by sultry heat is expressed by date-sweetened leather, studded with cardamom and brushed with rum. Vanilla and musk softens and beckons.. Perfumer: Kevin Mathys.

Symbolically, three is a powerful number which represents the wholeness of a completed cycle — the past, the present, the future. We are not defined by our hardships, but by how we confront them: the discipline of optimism, the courage of resolve. Kajal III, with its burst of ginger and citrus anchored by cleansing lavender and enfolding amber, has been created to honor all forms of determination and fortitude.. Perfumer: Kevin Mathis.

Spiritually, number two symbolizes balance, a reminder that we are all connected. When we attune our inner self with our outer experiences, a profound equilibrium emerges. Kajal II, with its peach and bright aromatics playing against deep oakmoss, sandalwood and musk, is a tribute to this serene duality.. Perfumer: Rosendeo Mateu.

Spiritually, number one represents beginnings, focus and determination. Kajal l, with its fresh, engaging warmth, has been crafted to underscore one’s innate dignity and charisma. Cassis, grapefruit and mandarin provide the big “hello!”. Guaiac wood, cardamom, orange blossom and cashmeran draw people in, while a soft vanillic cloud of sandalwood and oud extend the allure.. Perfumer: Christian Carbonnel.

listings.rawTitle: Le Réveil 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Le Réveil (the awakening) is an olfactory hallucination involving an Alpine mountain goat making a mess in a vat of strawberries and cream. Proving there’s no such thing as too much “too much”, this extrait pumps up the strawberry with waxy white chocolate and wine dregs, while amping ibex realness with oud, goat hair and animal notes. Remember, someone’s yuck can always be your yum.. Stone Cap: 100% Howlite.

listings.rawTitle: Suavis Corium 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Dark and magnetic, Suavis Corium (Latin for “soft leather”) is a scent built on tension — beauty vs danger, control vs chaos. The opening is provocative: vintage medicine…olives…WD-40. The illusion is created by a clash of black pepper and red berries, leavened with juicy pear smoky Siberian birch. As it unfolds, wild honeysuckle and lily of the valley bloom over dry hay and red thyme, evoking sun-scorched fields and untamed energy. The base strikes with elemental force: Guaiacwood from Paraguay smolders alongside moss and Indonesian patchouli. Smoky, earthy, animalic, it moves with silent force..

listings.rawTitle: Tropicum Luminis 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: An invisible tattoo of the tropics, glowing on warm skin. Latin for “tropical light”, Tropicum Luminis begins with a soft rush of cassis, coconut, apricot and plum — juicy but restrained — lifted by fresh aloe vera from the Canary Islands. The heart is floral, earthy, gently alive, with green pepper flickering amid ylang-ylang and peony. A woody resolution of Mysore sandalwood and Cambodian oud grounds this extrait alongside tonka bean and musk..

listings.rawTitle: Nebula Viridis 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Nebula Viridis is Latin for “fresh mist”, and this extrait billows with hazy radiance. A luminous opening of Sicilian lemon and Calabrian bergamot cuts through the air like sunlight, sharpened by saffron and the rich depth of labdanum. The effect is crisp, golden. Warm woods glow in the heart, including guaiacwood, patchouli and Caledonian sandalwood, before vanillic benzoin and amber assert their sensuality..

listings.rawTitle: Divina Flora 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: This “divine flower” is a luminous, untamed floral that captures the serenity of nature in motion. It starts bright and light: lemongrass and passion fruit, opening up to peony and lily of the valley. Watery, ethereal cyclamen drenches the richness of jasmine, ylang-ylang and narcissus like dew over a meadow. The drydown is green, a mingling of eucalyptus and sage with peppermint, juniper and pine, grounded by Mysore sandalwood and a hint of vanilla bourbon..

listings.rawTitle: Astra Infinita 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Astra Infinita is Latin for “endless stars”, and this extrait is a celestial blend of brightness and depth. It opens with a citrus supernova: Sicilian lemon, bitter orange and Calabrian bergamot, softened by the golden ripeness of mango and the narcotic bloom of Reunion ylang-ylang. Then Siberian birch and Indonesian clove meet black pepper and cedarwood, a core that feels both grounded and otherworldly. The base is slow-burning and eternal: Spanish labdanum, Cambodian oud, Mysore sandalwood and Bourbon vanilla. These stars are not distant. They’re drawn to you..

listings.rawTitle: Gratia Aestiva 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Gratia Aestiva is Latin for “summer grace”, and this extrait is an absolute abundance of sundrunk fruit. Punchy pineapple, melon and strawberry wave a big HELLO right out of the bottle, while passion fruit, with its tangy, grapefruit bite, tempers the sweetness with rawness. Indian jasmine adds floral fullness on a spiced bed of coriander and ambered woods. On the right side of too much..

listings.rawTitle: Misty Cypress Ash  青岚柏烬 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Misty Cypress Ash captures a mountain landscape with swirls of smoke rising from smoldering cypress branches amid the forest mist. Opens with an herbaceous, slightly bitter green haze of absinthe and wormwood, transitioning into a warm, spicy and woody heart of cypress and rich tobacco. Finally it settles into a comfortable, earthy and mineral-smoky finish with rooty vetiver and austere cedar.. Perfumer: Yang Liu.

listings.rawTitle: Distant Hills in Silence 远山听寂 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Distant Hills in Silence is a meditative, woody-aromatic perfume inspired by twilight on a mountain peak and the quiet whispers of wind through the pines. It opens with resinous frankincense and elemi blended with clean green leaves and clary sage, before shifting into a bright citrus clash of mandarin, bergamot and lemon. Chilly black pepper sharpens the feel, before a mossy and powdery fusion of patchouli and violet lends a cold shadow to the composition.. Perfumer: Maxime Exler.

listings.rawTitle: Celestial Robe 羽衣 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Within the grand halls of the Tang dynasty, a solitary dancer, Yuyi, steps into the light. Her grace feels almost celestial, a fragment of heaven quietly descended into the mortal world. One dance is enough to captivate an entire city. Celestial Robe traces her steps with this fougere, starting with the zesty opening movement: tart orange, lemon and rhubarb, with pine and grapefruit adding sharpness and clarity. Galbanum underscores the green aspects, as a bouquet of woods (cedarwood and guaiac wood) and plush musk and ambergris round off the choreography.. Perfumer: Fanming Meng.

listings.rawTitle: Abode of Brahma 梵天境 50 ml EdP
listings.description: In the Hindu tradition, Brahma is the creator god, responsible for knowledge. Abode of Brahma conjures bright alertness with spiritual stillness. Starting open and alive with a luminous burst of sharp basil and tart rhubarb, it softens with the diffusive green of galbanum mixed with delicate white florals. Grounding the experience are transparent threads of incense, sandalwood and ambergris.. Perfumer: Maxime Exler .

listings.rawTitle: Beyond Lethe 不忘川 50 ml EdP
listings.description: In Greek mythology, the Lethe is the River of Forgetfulness in the underworld of Hades. In this shadowed realm, the crimson river coils like a ribbon through clouds of dark smoke. To ford the Lethe is to overcome the thunder and silence of solitude, reclaiming your name that burns like an eternal fire. Beyond Lethe starts this fire with the warm spice of nutmeg, softened by the herbal depth of mugwort and sage, creating a mysterious and contemplative beginning. Geranium and thyme unfold with a subtle aromatic clarity, before patchouli, incense and cedarwood deepen the composition, leaving a dark, meditative trail that feels ancient and enduring.. Perfumer: Ugo Charron.

Inspired by Tawain’s blockbuster beverage: sweet milk tea shaken with tapioca pearls. This eau de parfum suggests the drink's complex flavors: roasted black tea, rich brown sugar, creamy milk and soft, chewy boba. A dusty, honeyed floral note lends sensuality..

listings.rawTitle: 005 Riviera Absolue 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The Riviera. The Mediterranean fills the horizon. You’re driving along a coastal road with the roof down, feeling free. In this extrait, lemon caviar, zesty ginger and icy cardamom puts jut in your strut, while tomato leaf, neroli and black tea summons an aromatic dance. Frankincense and cypriol offer shade in the sunshine.. Perfumer: Paul Guerlain .

Organic disobedience from Crazy Nose Alessandro Gualtieri. Micodelerio is a fantasy of mushrooms in their natural environment: clustered among the wet soil and decaying leaves of the forest floor. Earthy/sweet beetroot plays against moss and a ticklish saltiness, before woody patchouli asserts itself. The strangeness resolves into a petrichor-drenched amber. .

With a cap inspired by the candy floss pink of salt flats in the Carmargue and Puerto Rico, Beso de Sal summons mineral crispness with a go-with-the-flow blend of citrus and woods. Marine notes are the connective tissue between lemon, tangerine and savory/minty shiso leaf. Sage heightens the aromatics, while peppery cedarwood calls to mind sun-bleached driftwood.. Perfumer: Alberto Morillas .

This is an after-dark jasmine that smoulders, thanks to shadow-dwelling frankincense spiced up with Guatemalan cardamom and Madagascar black pepper. The charm of the char continues with cedarwood and cypress.. Perfumer: Alberto Morillas .

Fig Lemonade is fizzy and juicy, shimmering with sunshiney Italian lemon oil and Calabrian bergamot. Things get interesting with the fig leaf accord, which is built around buchu, with its green and borderline blackcurrant facets. The result is an appealing sweet/sour freshy with a subtle woody spine of cedarwood..

Shaped by French beauty influencer and tech academic Mia Fall (@socharmante), Vanilla for Breakfast is an olfactory confession of her deepest obsession: vanilla. Sweet almond extract, milky and tender, harmonizes with creamy benzoin as not one, not two, not three, but FOUR different vanillas assert themselves. A vanilla tincture lifts first alongside the sweet almond. Vanilla CO2 bridges the top to the heart. Vanilla absolute from Madagascar settles into the heart and base. And finally, a twentyfold concentrated vanilla absolute, the most enveloping of all, stays with you forever. Roasted tonka absolute underscores the message with its toasted depth. Most vanillas take their time. This one wakes up early!.

A soft veil of smoke slowly settles over the darkness. Cinnamon and black pepper sharpens the silhouette, dry wisps of elemi and incense unfold, rosemary anchors. Leather, woods and earthy tones seep in with silent depth. By the end, a restrained warmth lingers like an afterglow. All Black reveals without showing. . . .

Like your favorite jeans, faded to perfection, or that linen shirt, softened by years of wear, this is a scent that snuggles comfortably into any mood, any occasion. The first note feels like air before a conversation — citrusy, spiced and sharpened, just enough to hold attention. It opens up into the aromatic smoke of sage and incense, while patchouli and a trace of ambroxan suggest sun-dried earth and aged wood. . . .

Inspired by the haptic qualities of velvet and red wine, Chateau de Velours is a-swirl with red fruits. Raspberry, blackcurrant and wild strawberry blur their berry best with the boozy plumminess of davana. Honey and chocolate imbue this eau de parfum with animalic sweetness. Oakmoss and patchouli suggest the subtle earthiness of Pinot Noir, without interrupting the smoothness. . . .

In your dream, you’re behind the wheel of a bright green car, the hot pink leather interior speckled with black dots. With a shock, you realise you’re driving a giant watermelon. A zesty orange air freshener dangles off the rear view mirror, and the interior fills with the hallucinatory aromas of watermelon, citrus and leather. This is sweetness with shadows, technicolour fruit leather.. . .

Midday light, clean dry air, the feel of sun-dried cotton against skin — Sun Bleached hovers like an atmosphere. Citrus and ginger snap like fresh laundry in the breeze. Ylang-ylang, jasmine, and magnolia glide smoothly through the warmth. Ambroxan and white musk conjure neither powder nor soap — just a clean-skin aura. . . .

Vanille Glacé is a marron glacé finished with vanilla in place of chestnut. The sugar isn’t in a hurry. It soaks in one layer at a time, finishing with a glossy sheen. The first impression is brown sugar syrup, with cinnamon drawing the syrup into sharper focus. At its heart, the vanilla leans heavy rather than white and airy. Freshly baked madeleine adds soft warmth, and espresso casts a thin, bitter shadow at the edge of the sweetness. The drydown gives full reign to blond woods, tonka bean and musk, lending reassurance to the indulgence. . . .

Just-picked leafy greens and herbs piled high, topped with yuzu peel and runny honey. Raw and green, the smell that bursts when a leaf is bruised between the fingers. Tea leaf is the most bitter, holding the balance against grape skin and wild thyme. Neroli adds floral brightness, while oakmoss and patchouli root the fragrance. White musk and tonka bean tenderly infuse the composition.. . .

Cool herbs, the sweetness of anise, the warmth of a boozy flame at the bottom of a glass. Blue Flame begins in that glass. It opens bright and bitter, like lemon peel twisted between the fingers. Mint leaves and dry coriander seed steadies it. Then comes sambuca, the anise liqueur that lingers with chilly sweetness, shadowed by bitter/herbal Mugwort. Vetiver and cedarwood trace the outline of dry wood, and benzoin resin adds a low hum. Finally, white musk emerges, turning this cool customer into a warm, languid skin scent, its sweet herbs still held within..

A vivid burst of green/fruity rhubarb and watery/rosy lychee sets the weekend mood. It’s pink sweatshirt day, and the scent matches the vibe. Witty, not cute — we’re not trying too hard, here. Sour cranberry cuts strawberry’s sweetness, and Champagne crispness is offset by white musk. You catch yourself in the mirror: “I’m good like this.” .

The closer you get, the finer it feels. Orris and honeysuckle mingle in a powdery hush, beckoning the nose towards downy white musk and sandalwood. Vanilla and humid mangrove wood leave a lasting warmth. Projection stays soft, humming quietly — a fine-gauge knit that rests gently on skin. Cashmere is less a perfume than a feeling: a quiet murmur, a soft breath in the warm night. .

In this jungle, nature holds absolute power. Vines coil overhead, hiding the sky. Darkness drapes the woods, and every shadow conceals a predator. The perfume jungle that is Woodoo opens with notes of Nigerian ginger, along with Somalian olibanum, with its facets of vibrant green incense, fresh citrus, peppery spice and balsamic woods. Powdery iris and balsamic cistus lurk in the heart. The complexity deepens with a furry base of musk, benzoin, tonka bean and cypriol. Subtly powerful. . Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

Enter the realm of dangerous flora, where flowers bloom hungrily and fatal nectar beckons. Beneath smooth leaves, sharp thorns await. This is nature’s exquisite revenge, where beauty becomes an irresistible danger. This fragrance opens with the peppery-lemon of elemi and bitter green artemisia. A bloody rose unfurls alongside its scent kin Egyptian geranium, their metallic facets softened by velvety osmanthus. Resin, incense and woods lends authority. . Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

Hands in the soil. Fruits, vegetables and flowers mingle in the joyful disorder of a sun-drenched family garden. Daisy bouquets, juicy mirabelle plums and sweet raspberries. A harvest of crunchy beans and a table decorated with roses, freesias and hydrangeas. A sheen of green: green grass, green beans, green sap.. .

Late summer on a wild beach: blackberry bushes in the coastal dune grass, iodine on the lips, fingertips stained purple. The vertigo of standing on an ocean clifftop, the invigorating north wind. The fragrance unfolds: salted rock, caressed by tangy blackberry and swept by sea spray. Pebbles warmed by the sun, a sap of mineral roses. Deep breaths..

listings.rawTitle: À Pas De Loup (On Tiptoe) 100 ml EdP
listings.description: The primal sap of the forest. The dew-soaked ground releases the smell of damp earth that awakens an animal joy. A soft cloud of oak moss and mushrooms rises. Sandalwood envelops, clary sage enlivens. The benzoin drydown reveals amber and resinous notes, prowling like a wolf..

An ode to the Normandy countryside. Linden blossoms, fresh apple, sweet almond, radiant jasmine. Soft musk and suede. A golden sap of dried hay and ripe wheat evokes the pastures. And outside the farmhouse, sun-dried linens flutter on the line. All is well..

In the understated chic of Parisienne style, it’s details that matter: the perfect red lipstick, a delicate gold necklace, the right perfume. And this is the right perfume — a sparkling floral and patchouli confection that is lush but not overstuffed. Jasmine and rose meets raspberry and vanilla for put-together prettiness..

Brocéliande is a bewitching concentrate inspired by the enchanted forest of Arthurian legend. Combining the power of the forest with the magic of the animal world, this extrait’s bergamot and lime opening leads to an unexpected wander through ginger, cinnamon and iris. A whisky sweetness rubs up against the velvet leather of civet and castoreum. .

This extrait is named for the archipelagic country in the South Pacific Ocean, source of the sandalwood in the base. Vanuatu is a lively, confident blend of spices (black pepper, cardamom, cumin) dappled across characterful woody materials (sandalwood, patchouli, cedar and papyrus). Putting meat on the bones is fig milk, with violet leaves adding sharp sparkle. A fragrance for unexpected adventures. .

Kamel was the friend who entrusted Sora Dora founder Antoine with the secrets of the oriental olfactory universe, embodied in this namesake perfume. Built around the clean woodiness of Laotian oud, this extrait contrasts the dirty spice of cumin with sweet raspberry and syrupy rose. Smoky and spicy, Kamel Oud will enhance your next 1001 days and 1001 nights. .

Lü Bu is a formidable Chinese warlord, tiger-fierce but volatile. At the end of his last battle he is a folded shadow. The once most-feared man of the Empire, son of iron and fire, is devoured by his own legend. This olfactory scar of a perfume opens with vivid, tannic clove, like the acridity of blood on a still-warm blade. On a forgotten altar smoulders the benzoin beauty of papier d'Arménie, while iris, noble and powdery, whispers the hero's solitude. More than glory and power, Lü Bu speaks of sacrifice and memory. Loyal to all those who wear their shadows with pride. .

Mallow is the story of a candy flower that explodes in the infinite sweetness of violet powder. You do more than smell Mallow. You listen to it, you see it, you drink it and you touch it. Borne aloft by the vanilla-marzipan of heliotrope and plush sunshine of orange blossoms, this extrait is a haze of violets softly radiating from your magnetic self..

A mouth-watering gourmand inspired by the baking prowess of Jany, one of the daughters of Sora Dora flounder Antoine. We envision Jany busy in the kitchen, dusted in sugar and flour, preparing tarte tatin. The butter melts on the hot glass dish, dissolving brown sugar into syrup. The aroma swirls around the room, billows to the veranda, travels to the garden. Baked apples and cinnamon sticks merge into exhalations of puff pastry. Then come caramel, almonds and vanilla, powerful aromas that linger into the evening..

Warm, spicy and friendly, this extrait summons the good and protects you from the bad. A nutty haze of coconut a-swirl with cardamom, walnut and nutmeg soon deepens with the plush lushness of jasmine and iris. Fig, richly sweet and vegetal, adds contrast, while sandalwood provides cozy, just-out-of-focus grounding that is mellow and milky. .

Kumaru is the name of the tree that produces the star of this composition: the incredibly expressive tonka bean. This sensual and comforting fragrance is built around this versatile material in all its facets: woody, balsamic, vanillic and almondy, with hints of tobacco and hay. Cardamom, roasted barley and amber add a gourmand texture that shimmers between touchable and lickable. Musks heighten the addictive quality.. Perfumer: Céline Perdriel .

A kinky take on vanilla that laminates the complexity of no less than three different Madagascan vanillas with a slick pleather coating. “Carbone” is French for “carbon”, and here the black stuff is conjured with leathery labdanum and the vanilla vinyl of styrax. Vibrant, dynamic and beautifully weird.. Perfumer: Natalie Gracia Cetto .

Taiji, the symbol of Yin and Yang, refers here to the light and dark facets of the narcissus flower. This complex floral shimmers between the green of freshly-snapped stems and an animalic honey facet. Narcisse Taiji is a darkly luminous wonder, its narcotic allure underscored with leather and patchouli accents.. Perfumer: Marie Hugentobler .

listings.rawTitle: Black Oregano 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: An iconoclastic perfume built around the aromatic intensity of oregano, an unexpected raw material that conjures sun-scorched leather. The opening salvo of this extrait is sharp and fresh: lime, cardamom and rosemary. As the oregano emerges, arid and fierce, it’s offset by creamy Australian sandalwood and smoky vetiver, adding tension and depth. The trail then turns darker, denser, with Indonesian patchouli, cistus labdanum and oud wood.. Perfumer: Céline Perdriel .

listings.rawTitle: Néroli Hasbaya 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Hasbaya is a city in Lebanon, and Néroli Hasbaya is inspired by a Lebanese dessert called mouhalabieh, a milk pudding flavoured with orange blossom and pistachio. This extrait opens with incandescent neroli, wrapped in nutty’n’buttery hints of pistachio and almond. Orange blossom reveals its full depth in the base, and the creamy richness of sandalwood and Peruvian balsam enhance the enfolding trail of this radiant perfume.. Perfumer: Céline Perdriel .

Konya Kolonyasi opens with a bright burst of bergamot. Crisply fruity and aromatic, it evokes old Turkish barbershops.. Then there is the juicy technicolour cherry note inspired by the orchards surrounding the city of Konya in the blessed Central Anatolia. . In the base, black tea settles softly on the skin, recalling the endless glasses of Turkish çay (chai) shared throughout the day. . Deep, comforting and slightly bitter..

listings.rawTitle: Iris Trousseau 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Named after a rare, indigenous red grape variety from the French Jura, this sensual, enveloping iris composition is built on an overdose of Bavarian iris germanica Danner. This varietal is characterized by extreme powderiness and strength. Its fruity-sweet and floral-violet notes are enriched with rare Piedmontese hazelnut extract, tonka bean absolute and sandalwood oil for depth and drama. Cat’s paw softness with all claws hidden..

listings.rawTitle: Iris Poulsard 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Named after a very old native red grape variety from the French Jura, this sophisticated gourmand iris is built on an exceptionally high concentration of Bavarian iris germanica . This iris glows with woody and fruity-floral notes — and hints of cocoa and coffee. The effect is enhanced with essential oils of cedar wood, green mandarin and cinnamon absolute, resulting in a luxury treat that feels indulgent and comforting at the same time.. Perfumer: Antoinie Lie .

listings.rawTitle: Iris Altesse 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Named after a rare, indigenous white grape variety from Savoy, this cool, modern iris interpretation is built on the brand’s highest-dosed and rare Bavarian iris pallida. Based on standard iris concentrations of around 0.1% in the fragrance oil, Iris Altesse contains an approximately 26-fold higher dose of iris butter and iris extract. Here, iris root revels in its chalky, clean leather side, with a fruity flourish supplied by jasmine sambac and cassis. Classy and hip.. Perfumer: Antoine Lie .

Raíces, Spanish for roots, is a perfume that summons the force of the earth with a botanical bounce. The rain-soaked smokiness of vetiver twins with the glacial green of peppermint for a bright-eyed, vibrant persona. The persona shifts with unexpected sparks: black and pink pepper, orange blossom and ginger, rose and saffron.. Perfumer: Paul Guerlain.

Lances is a Spanish word that means the fleeting but decisive moments that change everything ever after. Risks are taken, character is forged. This extrait embodies this risk and reward dynamic with the high-contrast tension between hazelnut and four varieties of lavender. The effect is intriguingly ambiguous, simultaneously pulled towards the gourmand with the help of vanilla and sandalwood, while maintaining an aromatic aloofness thanks to the lavender and cedarwood.. Perfumer: Jean-Christophe Hérault .

listings.rawTitle: El Caminante 40 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: El Caminante, Spanish for “the wanderer”, is a nomadic fragrance that pays tribute to the flâneur’s stroll, the urban pilgrimage in search of self-knowledge. This extrait is an invitation to travel, to seek experiences, thanks to the propulsive cadence of Ceylon black tea and a lightly smoked suede. The experiences along the way include cardamom and saffron, with fruity nuances of dried plum, date and honey. Luxurious iris absolute adds depth, accompanied by vetiver, sandalwood, tonka bean and labdanum.. Perfumer: Mathilde Bijaoui .

Merina, referencing the lushness of Spanish wool, opens with a blissful puff of almond that shapeshifts between floral heliotrope and creamy vanilla. Fennel adds structure to the softness with its delicate aniseed character. Almond and fennel continue to shimmer against each other as heady jasmine and powdery iris gently pulse. The whole effect is intimate and refined, leaving a skin-close trail that wraps you like a veil.. Perfumer: Caroline Dumur.

Lumières connects a cultural and spiritual duality: the zest of Madrid and the elegance of Paris. This extrait is a dance between cheerful pink pepper and an unusual mineral musk, resulting in a quietly radiant woody/rosy glow with a sensual undertone. Iris and cedarwood enhance the your-skin-but-better feel.. Perfumer: Gaël Montero .

Arcadia takes its name from the mythical paradise of ancient Greece. Two essential materials shape this perfume: iris and olibanum. Iris, with its powdery texture, offers a serene, almost mineral elegance anchoring the perfume to the earth. Olibanum’s burning resin envelopes the composition in sacred stillness, an appeal to the heavens. Bittersweet tonka bean and smoky vetiver weave in additional mystery.. Perfumer: Paul Guerlain.

Zagal is the Spanish word for a shepherd’s apprentice, a figure that embodies discovery and innocence. This namesake fragrance invites you to approach the familiar with fresh eyes. Zagal is a dialogue between saffron’s dry, subtle bitterness, and fig’s fleshy, vegetal sweetness. Rose, jasmine, sandalwood, myrrh and vanilla provide deeply cushioned upholstery, rendering Zagal as a contemporary oriental.. Perfumer: Gaël Montero .

A cool, weightless breath that glides over the skin like the crisp poplin of a freshly-tailored shirt. Air is fashioned through contrasts: an ozonic accord swirling through the dissonant tang of blackcurrant and lime. This dark, metallic fruitiness cuts through the composition, enlivening the woody/amber base with a juicy green tension.. Perfumer: Alex Lee .

listings.rawTitle: The Geisha’s Secret Garden 100 ml EdP
listings.description: A modern interpretation of a classic chypre, this is an unapologetic abundance of statement florals: hyacinth, rose and narcissus. The entrance to this hidden garden is garlanded with the herbal bitterness of galbanum, cushioned by a dark green carpet of vetiver and moss. Like a geisha’s serene beauty that hides her inner power, this extrait de parfum is a statement of mystery and strength.. Perfumer: Ralf Schwieger .

The wild and free spirit of a lost island captured in a fruity and sweet perfume with notes of icy pear, soft iris and creamy vanilla. Happy and juicy, Isla Bohemia slows its roll into a mellow base of sandalwood and musk. .

The wild and free spirit of a lost island captured in a fruity and sweet perfume with notes of icy pear, soft iris and creamy vanilla. Happy and juicy, Isla Bohemia slows its roll into a mellow base of sandalwood and musk. .

A relaxing beach day: bright skies, gleaming skin and hot sand under your feet. La Playa summons the sun in a fruity and sweet perfume that launches with shimmering orange blossom and lemon. Creamy coconut, rich pistachio and vanilla are enhanced by the varied wonders of tonka bean. Tonka does an intriguing little shuffle through dry hay, powdered milk and coconut flesh, enhancing the feel-good beachiness. .

A soft warmth on the skin. A fading light. Voices blending with laughter.. Goldfawn combines the woody depth of cedar and sandalwood with the enveloping softness of warm, textured vanilla. The composition unfolds gradually, becoming denser and more sensual, until it forms a rich and addictive trail.. A fragrance designed like a comforting and reassuring embrace..

A road lined with cedars. The fresh morning air. The dense silence of the forest. Blueforest blends the dry freshness of cedarwood with the vibrancy of black pepper, creating an immediate woody-spicy tension. Musk softens the composition with a clean, enveloping sensation, giving the fragrance its second-skin character..

The Los Angeles night. Rivers of white headlights and red taillights surge down the Sunset Strip. Searchlamps sweep the sky, neon signs blink a warm welcome. Pinkfire blends juicy pomegranate and velvety raspberry in an radiantly fruity opening, exploding like a paparazzo flash on sunglasses after dark. The fruity freshness becomes ever more sensual and vibrant, before melting into a deep woody amber that clings to the skin like the heat of Hollywood..

Warm sand. Skin slathered in sunscreen. The sound of waves. The Malibu sun bottled. Mahoganysun combines the milky roundness of fig with the solar exoticism of frangipani, on a creamy and addictive vanilla base. A warm, enveloping, and sensual composition that naturally blends with the skin. Like a day at the beach that never wants to end. .

A game that begins without warning. The urge to break the rules. A gaze that holds. Azureblush bursts with the tangy brightness of rhubarb with the juicy sweetness of lychee. Peony then softens and rounds the composition with a sunny floral facet, giving the fragrance its luminous and addictive dimension..

The first hours of the day. Thoughts already in motion. The urge to move forward.. Tangerinepearl combines the sharp intensity of grapefruit with the liveliness of fresh ginger, creating a tonic and luminous opening. Gradually, the fragrance softens with powdery iris accents that add depth and subtlety to this vibrant freshness.. A fragrance designed like the energy of a new beginning, when everything still feels possible..

Sometimes, where you are is where it’s at. Nothing to add, everything to savour. Inspired by suspended moments, Ivorysky finds its balance between the citrus freshness of bergamot, the woody nuances of vetiver, and the creamy softness of sandalwood. Delicate powdery notes bind everything together, creating a harmonious trail between freshness, warmth, and softness..

Skin, salt-kissed by the ocean. A white T-shirt, warmed by the sun. Dreaming, bare feet in the sand. Inspired by the vast beaches of the Southern Californian coast, Whitedenim opens on the salty, iodized notes of sea air. Gradually, the fragrance reveals an enveloping milky facet before melting into a creamy sandalwood base. Fresh, comforting, luminous. .

listings.rawTitle: 火马 - Cavallo di fuoco 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The largest Chinese community in Italy is located in the Tuscan city of Prato. The main drag, Via Pisoiese, is an “everything everywhere all at once” bustle of Chinese signs, 24-hour restaurants, holiday-bright colours, white Porsches emblazoned with Hello Kitty. The street is accidentally hipster, underground on purpose, eccentric by nature — reflected in this fire horse of a perfume, Cavallo di Fuoco. In it, mint and celery lead unexpectedly to a hurly-burly blend of pomelo, ginger, Chinese jujube and honeyed Chinese oud. Just like the dynamic fire horse in Chinese astrology, this smellscape is bold, untamed and full of life.. Limited to 36 bottles, 38% extrait.. Blended with:. Pomelo tincture, Osmanthus absolute, Chinese Jujube absolute, Persimmon fermented tincture, Sichuan Pepper tincture, Ginger essential oil, Kaffir Lime tincture, Rose Buds absolute, Ginseng tincture, Celery tincture, Bamboo tincture, Clove tincture, Mandarin essential oil, Wild mint tincture, Chinese oud.. . Important notice: . Zanini blends are living botanical compositions, crafted entirely from natural materials and free from synthetic fixatives or stabilizers. As with all things living, subtle variations are part of their nature: over time, you may notice a gentle evolution in colour, texture, or the appearance of natural sediment. These are not imperfections, but part of the character of the raw materials themselves.. These blends are olfactive smellscapes (but neither aromatherapy, nor ‘spray-and-go’ perfumes) and sensory experiences, closer to works of art created in the scented plane (rather than, say, visual or audio).. Certain essential oils and absolutes that are used in Zanini’s 100% natural blends may potentially cause allergies in some people. Please spray Zanini’s blends on fabric (on sleeves, scarves, etc.). . Zanini advise that those who are prone to allergic reactions, pregnant and nursing women, as well as people with chronic illnesses to be extra careful. Before trying natural blends, study the list of ingredients and consult with a doctor if you are not sure or a had a history of allergies. If you do decide to put these blends on your skin (unable to resist the temptation) always test the blend on the inside part of your elbow first and wait.. Do not spray these blends liberally as a cloud in the way you would spray a conventional perfume. Zanini’s smellscapes need to be… carefully applied and experienced. Be mindful that some oils can also make your skin hyper-sensitive to UV..

listings.rawTitle: Fermo pesca 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A rustic sauna on a windswept beach. Outside, the air carries salty ocean waves and the bitter burnt wood of extinguished bonfires. Inside, there’s mineral steam, herbal tinctures and damp skin. Rare ambergris and a cluster of exotic ouds suggest seaweed, leather and sex. . Limited to 40 bottles 58% extrait.. Blended with Natuna wild oud, Pontianak wild oud, Vintage Merauke wild oud, Ambergris absolute, Immortelle essential oil, Myrrh tincture, Okoume tincture, Buckwheat tincture, Caper absolute, Marigold absolute, Aloe resin tincture, Salsola soda tincture, Seaweed absolute, Onycha absolute, Robinia pseudoacacia tincture, Gardenia absolute, Jasmine sambac absolute, Myrtle tincture, Citron essential oil. . listings.rawTitle: Ortica Ortica 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: "Tall nettles cover up, as they have done These many springs, the rusty harrow, the plough Long worn out, and the roller made of stone: Only the elm butt tops the nettles now. This corner of the farmyard I like most: As well as any bloom upon a flower I like the dust on the nettles, never lost Except to prove the sweetness of a shower.". Tall nettles, Edward Thomas. Green and sweet in one bottle. The damp, breathing sensation of nettle follows a stony path to the coconut/sandalwood effect of massoia bark. The result is a sharp green flicker highlighting a dusty cherry oud.. Limited to 75 bottles, 40% extrait. . Blended with Nettle tincture, Cherry absolute, Vanilla absolute, Lokoloko attar, Bishara attar, Tagetes tincture, Fig Leaf tincture, Valerian essential oil, Ylang Ylang essential oil, Linden Blossom absolute, Massoia CO2 extract, Litsea tincture, Geranium essential oil, Galbanum essential oil, Pink Pepper tincture, Dragon’s Blood tincture, Peru Balsam essential oil, Violet Leaf absolute, Lilium aurantium absolute, Carob tincture.  . Inspired by flowers frozen in ice and dramatic winter skies transforming into spring — a fleeting moment captured in scent. The crisp, green effect of cassis leaves is overlaid with blackcurrant sparkle, adding buoyancy to the syrupy rose. Matcha tea lends a brewed, vegetal quality..

An involving fragrance inspired by a cherished love poem — Shakespeare’s Sonnet 116. This sublime ode to the enduring nature of devotion and emotional connection is interpreted here as a sueded blur of amaretto and patchouli. Orris and labdanum further deepen the union of souls.. SONNET 116 Let me not to the marriage of true minds Admit impediments; love is not love Which alters when it alteration finds, Or bends with the remover to remove. O no, it is an ever-fixèd mark That looks on tempests and is never shaken; It is the star to every wand’ring bark Whose worth’s unknown, although his height be taken. Love’s not time’s fool, though rosy lips and cheeks Within his bending sickle’s compass come. Love alters not with his brief hours and weeks, But bears it out even to the edge of doom: If this be error and upon me proved, I never writ, nor no man ever loved . .

Inspired by new ways of seeing, Lucienne — meaning light — is an exuberant moment of clarity. Pomelo, lemon zest, and dragonfruit reflect against impressions of creamy magnolia, waterlily and shimmering marine waves. .

There is a California artist enclave where residents regularly remove the road signs to get there — a hidden bohemia. Redwood pine, cedar and guaiac wood evoke the coastal forest. Incense, tobacco and vanilla beans bring the town to life. Wear Bo for IYKYK mystique..

Inspired by a typographer’s mark and the detailed study of a blossom. A prismatic sheen washes over a lively conversation between flowers, penned in iridescent ink. This impression is brought to life with tender honeysuckle, voluptuous jasmine sambac, and creamy, apricot-esque mirabelle plum.. Perfumers: Céline Ellena and Jean-Claude Ellena .

Inspired by Virginia Woolf’s A Room of One’s Own —the practice of taking space for yourself to think or create. Succulent pear and cozifying ambrette notes form a bright pool of sunlight around carrot seed, orris and warm cashmere. A melting embrace..
Extending a moment held in time. At dawn, hand in hand. Images cross and softly intertwine. Zesty tangerine, fresh eucalyptus, enveloped by cocoa. A loving memory..

A voluptuous amber built around the formidable floral trio of magnolia, peony and Bulgarian rose. Adding spice to the headiness is nutmeg and cardamom, and the lusciousness is heightened by a custardy vanilla, with a playful wink of tangerine. Tender orange blossom further encourages the decadence. Laetitia features millesimé notes: like in fine wines and liqueurs, these are the extracts obtained from the best years of production..

The opening of Élise summons a Tuscan sea breeze, mingling with a smile of citrus. Neroli and rose intertwine with crisp eucalyptus, the perfect balance between floral and green. Marine notes gradually surrender to the warm base of musk, patchouli and amber.. Perfumer: Chris Carbonnel. . . .

Hélène Napoleone was the daughter of Napoleon’s last lover, Albine de Montholon, and although it was never confirmed if the now-exiled Emperor was indeed her father, he did give her his name, so…? Her namesake fragrance is a vivacious bouquet of fruits and florals, headlined by sparkling pear and creamy magnolia. The charm deepens with the amber base, warmed by sandalwood and patchouli. .

The sensual and timeless allure of Joséphine, the woman most loved by Napoleon, is the soul of this namesake perfume, Here Joséphine is reborn as an enveloping floriental. In the opening, the fruity syrup of Bulgarian rose mingles with violet, complicated by the ripe musk of hawthorn and the caramel spice of opoponax. The velvety background of amber is warmed by the resinous tones of Oman incense..

Matilde Bonaparte, niece of Napoleon I, was known for her breasts (“le plus beau décolleté”) and her talent as a painter. She also hosted a celebrated 19th-century Parisian salon attended by the greatest artists and writers of her time. This namesake perfume is an olfactory salon of provocative white florals (ylang-ylang, narcissus, jasmine) given tropical succulence with passion fruit and papaya. Mathilde’s heady brightness is softened by iris and sandalwood. .

An olfactory portrait of Desirée Clary, the 16-year-old beauty who first captured Napoleon’s heart. This is a generous gardenia and rose, full and warm, made playful with grapefruit, pink pepper and passion fruit. A chord of amber and musk cushions the pleasure. .

An olfactory poem in praise of the rugged elegance of vetiver. But despite being the subject, in this composition vetiver’s rich’n’rooty pleasures are folded into a harmony of resinous allies: the honeyed spice of opoponax and the licorice syrup of myrrh. Black pepper and thyme spike the flow, while musk and amber accords smooth the final stanzas. .

White Blood refers to the pale, living fluid in the stem of a flower. In this case, an imaginary flower with opalescent petals. Seemingly a “nothing” colour, here white reveals itself as the sum of a thousand shades: layered iridescences, light diffracting at every angle. A crisp, appealingly sour opening of starfruit launches into a dense tropical juice of tiaré and watery pink lotus. Like the kaleidoscopic pastels of an opal, a rainbow of scent impressions drift by: is that rose? Ylang-ylang? Kiwi? The enigma continues through the drydown, which stays intriguingly cold and refreshing..
