Glorious sunsets, black sand beaches, whitewashed buildings, blue-domed churches, volcanic cliffs — the Greek island of Santorini is supernaturally beautiful. This namesake fig and sandalwood fragrance conjures its escapist allure with earthy green coconut, luxury orris and sensual musk. .

Travel to glorious Florence via the waftings of Firenze, an amplified interpretation of a classic Italian cologne. Bursting with fresh citrus, including bergamot, bitter orange, and lemon, it’s a match for you at your radiant, vibrant best. The Tuscan sunshine softens into Tuscan woods with dusky sandalwood and vetiver upholstering the gleam with velvet..

California is a land of abundance: sunshine, flowers and fruits. The fragrance is a sunny swirl of magnolia, apples and lemons, all of which flourish in this west coast wonderland. Sandalwood and musk bridges the flora to the skin, turning you into a delivery system for smiles. .

The Italian “fishing village” of Portofino is a jet setter’s playground where luxury yachts line the picturesque harbour. This eau de parfum is a stealth wealth blend of uplifting aromas: lemon, ginger and pink pepper, paired with the woody elements of dry amber and cedar. .

Nagi are divine female half-human, half-serpent beings from Hindu and Buddhist mythology, revered as guardians of treasure. The Nagi opens with the creamy sweetness of coconut and the verdant freshness of fig leaf, evoking the primal vitality of the serpent. Steamed Indian rice and spicy clove create a scent of profound warmth and comfort. Clean musk unfolds like the softness of a serpent’s renewed skin after shedding, blending seamlessly with sun-kissed warmth — tender, pure and familiar. .

Naga are divine male half-human, half-serpent beings from Hindu and Buddhist mythology, revered as guardians of treasure. In this eau de parfum, saffron's glowing spice and fiery Sri Lankan black pepper awaken the scent. Out of this heat, Indian cypriol root arises, shapeshifting between leather, frankincense and vetiver. This is where the snake coils back on itself, entwining with the powdered caress of orris absolute and musk. .

In Buddhism, the ultimate aim is Nirvana, which refers to liberation from suffering and the attainment of peace. Find your peace with this enfolding eau de parfum, with the freshness of mandarin surrounded by waves of black tea and jasmine sambac. Go from floating in the clouds to drifting through the universe. .

The Buddhist idea of Bodhi is about awakening to the profound understanding of the true nature of reality, free from ignorance, want and pain. This eau de parfum accompanies you on your path to supreme wisdom, protecting you in a clarifying cloud of incense brightened with ginger, sage and vetiver, and softened with sandalwood and musk. If you’re liberated from ignorance, then all of your choices are right. .

The ancient Hindu concept of Kama is about savouring life with every sense: feeling, hearing, seeing, tasting, smelling, in harmony with one's mind and soul. This eau de parfum satisfies your desires with a sultry union of tuberose, sandalwood, patchouli and incense. Wearing The Kama places you in emotional connection with yourself, and so with the world, magnetically summoning only the best outcomes. .

A mandala, Sanskrit for "circle," is a sacred geometric symbol representing the universe, wholeness and the self in Buddhism. This luminous eau de parfum opens the window to your inner garden, redolent with peachy osmanthus, crushed leaves and the apple-and-hay joy of marigold. Green mango draws you outward, and the creamy-salty notes of sun-kissed skin pulls you back into yourself. Abundant and hopeful. .

listings.rawTitle: Soap Bubble 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Inspired by the delicate beauty of the Soap Bubble Nebula, known for its spherical, iridescent appearance, Soap Bubble is an airy yet present scent that blends purity with playfulness. Sparkling aldehydes meet creamy, peachy and musky notes, creating a modern interpretation of freshness. A fragrance for those who don’t need to shout to be heard..

listings.rawTitle: Eastern Veil 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Inspired by the filigree formation of the Eastern Veil nebula, this extrait captures the interplay of light, darkness, sweetness and depth. Warm, salty-gourmand accents of popcorn and maple syrup meet subtle spices, while soft woody and iris notes give the scent a weightless structure. Like the nebula itself, Eastern Veil is a play of shimmering facets that continuously reveal new dimensions. A fragrance for those who seek to throw their glow into the darkest corners..

listings.rawTitle: Eye Of God 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Inspired by the majestic Helix Nebula, known as the “Eye of God,” this extrait captures the mystical balance between infinity and the now. Radiant spice notes open the experience, followed by a complex heart of smoky buddhawood, charred birch tar, earthy moss and leathery oud. The chorus of woods is unexpectedly tenderised with cotton candy and vanilla. A metallic coolness adds an almost otherworldly aura to the composition. A fragrance for those who seek to be present in the deepest aspects of their lives..

listings.rawTitle: Tears On Mystic Sands 100 ml EdP
listings.description: This fragrance evokes the bittersweet beauty of love lost and longed for. The complex sweetness of lychee and davana lead into the plush pleasures of rose oil, oud, leather and musk, sharpened with incense. The poetry of memories.. Perfumer: Mark Buxton.

This fragrance summons the strength and elegance of a modern ruler.. Spicy saffron, cardamom and clove boldly herald the main event: an oud rose sexed up with musk. A hint of raspberry and caramel makes you lick your lips. Power meets seduction.. Perfumer: Mark Buxton.

listings.rawTitle: Nightfall in the City of Kings 100 ml EdP
listings.description: Twilight to moonlight in an ancient city. Cumin, peach and cedarwood in an intimate embrace, summoning the smell of skin seasoned by passion.Turkish rose surrenders to a velvety bed of amber, patchouli and sandalwood. For lovers of Féminité du Bois, the groundbreaking niche perfume created by Christopher Sheldrake with Pierre Bourdon.. Perfumer: Mark Buxton.

Under the luminous moon, smouldering embers glow with the mystery of ancient night rituals. This is a ceremony of smoke upon smoke upon smoke: birch tar, black tea, leather, frankincense. The austerity is softened by notes of amber and labdanum, deepening the mystery of the enveloping darkness.. Perfumer: Alexandre Illan.

In the beginning, there was confinement. Arbitrary walls and borders. Then you woke up, and you were no longer locked in a box you didn’t make. Now you’re in a forest temple breathing in the heart-opening smells of sandalwood, spices and violet leaf. No one will contain you ever again.. Perfumer: Angéline Leporini.

In the beginning, there was doubt. The burden of being different, scorched by every curious gaze. But then you harnessed your energy, understanding how to Brace yourself in the chaos. Now you’re the serene eye of every storm, drawing the world to you with grounding sandalwood, cozy labdanum and sensual musk. You are powerful with inner calm.. Perfumer: Olaf Larson.

In the beginning, there was emptiness. Questions with no answers. But through seeking came Saĝo, Esperanto for “wisdom”. Wise indeed, but the perfume might also suggest the palm starch sago, with its sweet and earthy pearls. Now you’re in a snug wooden cabin fragrant with fresh palo santo, rich hazelnut and creamy tonka bean. Trust your inner voice.. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour .

In the beginning, there was disorder. The world seemed jagged, unconnected – until your spirit found a way to soften with Flow. Now you’re under a wide open sky filled with the breath of flowers and distant musk. Wherever you are is always the right place.. Perfumer: Lucas Sieuzac .

Separately, the aromas of rose, pear, patchouli, strawberry, vanilla and sandalwood are objectively appealing. But combined with fecal civet, rotting cucumber and burnt rubber, V.I.T.R.I.O.L. evokes the odour of a garbage dump where a man is digging his own grave. .

listings.rawTitle: Rigor Mortis 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The setting: the aftermath of an unnamed catastrophe. The smell: the sweet meat smell of “just off” corpses, sloppily preserved with embalming fluids. The air fills with the uncomfortable energy of the formerly alive, transforming vitality into a haze of bilge water, metallic discharge and dried saliva. In Rigor Mortis, the mix between indolic florals, seaweed, and animalic beeswax and civet creates an emotional fragrance that needs to be discovered slowly. .

Arc is a natural fougere with a concentration of around 40%. Perfumer Rajesh Balkrishnan has summoned a glorious symphony of sunkissed herbs, lavender, jasmine and pine, grounded by the deep earthy richness of oakmoss. The cinnamon spice of styrax and the smoky vanillic sweetness of benzoin assist the joyful lift-off..

An airy mountainous rose-oud that takes you to new spiritual heights, the fifth collaboration between Antonio Lasheras and doctor-turned-perfumer Rajesh Balkrishnan. Ora combines exquisite absolutes from the east and west to create an austere, delicate floral-woody experience. The brute power of rose and oud absolutes from various regions of the world have been tamed here into sophisticated serenity. Peppery pine intertwines throughout, rendering Ora tranquil and uplifting..

Aragon is an olfactory tribute to the Aragon region of Spain, the birthplace of Mallo. A unique aromatic fougere, the scent showcases local aromatic plant extracts from cypress, basil, thyme, rosemary and artemisia. Added to this busy mix is the pipirigallo flower, exclusive to the region. The scent is rounded off by mossy, resinous elements for a warm, enveloping feel..

On an empty street in a city, a lone tree stands, bare and forlorn. You tenderly stroke the trunk with your hand and then hug it tightly, listening as it whispers of long-passed time. A fog lifts and you look down at your hands, which are covered in the cool, damp feel of moss. Lost Generation is a tone poem in scent, resinous hinoki lightened with grapefruit, deepened with leather..

A beach bungalow on the South China Sea is the setting for this gently uplifting eau de cologne. The honest earthiness of lemongrass launches the scent, enriched by sweet orange. Grassy and camphoraceous spike lavender adds structure, while vetiver and patchouli provide depth. Sunny and reassuring..

As the blare of a jazz band fills the room, sensual wafts of rose and tonka bean arise from the flushed skin of couples on the dance floor. Invigorating sage intertwines with the percussive patterns of the dancers. This dazzling night doesn’t last forever, but it leaves behind a musky memory that makes you want to do it all over again..

The tart sweetness of bergamot and yuzu is the pale moon rising over a landscape of aromatic lavender and silky sandalwood. The sharpness of cedarwood begins to subtly assert itself, underscored by a violet echo of orris, inviting you into a realm of serene oblivion. .

listings.rawTitle: Kopi Luwak 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The lush Indonesian rainforest is home to the palm civet, a small mammal that eats coffee beans which, once excreted, are harvested for their malty flavour. Kopi Luwak is inspired by this connoisseur’s beverage, with rich coffee notes mingling with animalic civet. Incense and oud underscore the fermented darkness, with dark amber and aged vanilla adding a sweaty sweetness.. Stone Cap: 100% Picasso quartz.

listings.rawTitle: The Serpent’s Orchard 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: In a garden long unguarded, where fig trees ripen past reason and the perfume of crushed blooms rises from the warm ground, Eve returns to Eden, empowered. The Serpent’s Orchard is a heady surge of wine and rose, honey and myrrh, jasmine and sandalwood. Look out for the snake among the figs.. Stone Cap: 100% peacock quartz.

listings.rawTitle: Solar Wind 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Solar Wind transcends citrus, capturing the celestial journey of the sun's charged particles across space. Fiery orange and rhubarb erupt, mimicking solar flares, before cascading into a radiant sparkling heart of guava and strawberry.. Stone Cap: 100% strawberry quartz.

listings.rawTitle: Naju Spring 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A perfume inspired by a spring picnic in Naju, South Korea, known for its pears, lush forests and blossoming Buddhist gardens. The opening of matcha tea, pear ice cream, ginger and almond evokes a picnic on pagoda steps. Delving deeper, jasmine, hinoki wood and toasted rice envelop the senses. Woolly castoreum and a meaty accord of goji gui offer a surprisingly savoury drydown.. Stone Cap: 100% rose quartz.

listings.rawTitle: Rusalka’s Embrace 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The tragic water spirit moves between rivers and seas, luring the man who has wronged her to his last sleep. Rusalka’s Embrace embodies the final breath before the depths close in: the slow sway of seaweed, a gasp of peppermint and pine, the frankincense waft of propolis, the clammy musk of drowned skin, and all the flowers he never lived to smell.. Stone Cap: 100% blue calcite.

A bitter blend of pine and blackcurrant, evoking a zesty walk through a shadowed forest. Inspired by the Slavic witch Baba Yaga, a mercurial nature spirit who bestows either power or death on those who come to her for help. Green, fruity and untamed..

listings.rawTitle: Old Library 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: In an old monastery's library, where shelves of ancient, leather-bound volumes stretch into shadows, the air is thick with the scent of musty parchment and whispered secrets. One fateful night, a scholar discovers a hidden chamber behind a sliding bookshelf, revealing a sinister tome bound in black, its pages filled with arcane symbols and dark prophecies. As the scholar reads, the library itself seems to breathe with an unsettling presence. When he finishes the book, he vanishes, becoming part of the shadowy library forever, leaving only a haunting silence — and the smell of vetiver and dusty pages..

listings.rawTitle: Haunted Circus 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Portrait of a creepy abandoned circus in the clearing of a forgotten forest. Haunted Circus opens on wet cardboard and the powdery, rubbery nuance of dead balloons, unfolding into buttery, salty-sweet popcorn and caramelized vanilla. The smell of decomposed pleasures..

The townsfolk whisper of Nosferatu, a name carved into the jagged stones of the deserted abbey, its meaning lost to time but heavy with dread. On moonless nights, travelers claim to hear the faint echo of hollow footsteps and a low, guttural moan rising from the crypt. Nsfrta is a dark and complex perfume, an unsettling summoning of winey rose, metallic dried blood, herbaceous absinthe and smoky leather..

listings.rawTitle: Noir Cacao 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A deep, velvety blend of cocoa, coconut and dark rum melts into creamy vanilla, ylang-ylang and smooth woods. Smoky tobacco marries the almond-honey facets of tonka bean in this sensual gourmand..

listings.rawTitle: Iris Poudre 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A cool, silvery veil of iris and chamomile drifts over blue cypress and whispering woods, softened by airy musks and cashmere warmth. Hints of incense and quiet florals create a serene, contemplative aura — pale and softly haunting..

listings.rawTitle: Skandal Rōse 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A lush, dewy rose unfurls in shades of crimson and blush, laced with jasmine, magnolia and a breath of hyacinth. Smooth sandalwood, treemoss and ambergris deepen the petals, while soft musks and warm woods create a radiant, sensual bloom that lingers like a rose garden at dusk..

Mango Sticky Rice pays homage to Thailand’s most beloved dessert, enjoyed for generations at temple fairs and family gatherings. This scent celebrates the harmony of juicy mangoes, tender sticky rice, and creamy coconut milk. Buttery, luscious and mellow. .

listings.rawTitle: DIA x MEG WEBSTER 50 ml EdP
listings.description: This collaboration with Dia Art Foundation and American artist Meg Webster is an earthy, layered scent. Notes of geranium and frankincense sit on top of a mushroom accord that feels plucked from the dirt. Madagascar patchouli and sandalwood envelop green organic notes.. Meg Webster is best known for her sculptures composed of salt, earth, sand, and other natural materials, powerful statements built to disintegrate. The dramatic silver pyramid packaging is a work of art in itself, referencing Webster’s sculptural vocabulary. The mirrored surface nods to ephemeral encounters with nature, while the bracketed pictogram emblazoned on the packaging references a motif from her early works. . Perfumer : Emily Coppermann.

This EdT plays it dark but bright. A spiky black pepper opening commands attention, before being volumised by an ebony chorus of black tea, birch tar and incense. Tree moss and violet lend a perfumed earthiness.. Perfumer Antoine Maisondieu .

How many greens can fit in a bottle? This edt amps nature with vibrant and herbaceous lentisk and basil, along with head-clearing spearmint and juniper. Lime and vetiver adds treble and bass. You can’t say “Play Green” without smiling. . Perfumer Antoine Maisondieu .
This edt is a bouquet of all the reds: red mandarin, pink peppercorns, red cherry, saffron, geranium, cinnamon. Myrrh and tolu balsam give it a rich stickiness. . Perfumer Antoine Maisondieu.

A dazzling fusion of organic and mineral, of freshness and depth. A shimmering rainbow of greens, from green pepper, ivy and coriander, to gunpowder and vetiver. A blast of green energy.. Perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault .

A dynamic and utterly unexpected swirl of dry, smoky incense and earthy-sweet beets. The loamy allure of beets is a surprisingly successful match with bright ginger and geranium, before taking a so-wrong-it’s-right plunge into leathery labdanum and ozonic incense. Strange and satisfying..

Comes on juicy and fluffy before revealing its true character. Co-created by Allie Goodbun, a showgirl at an iconic Parisian cabaret, Pear Pavlova mirrors her qualities as a dancer: the duality of lightness with strength. Aquatic pear and airy meringue are anchored by musky ambrette seed and heady jasmine sambac to give it unexpected va-va-voom..

A shot of fruity mezcal collides with precious cacao absolute for a fragrance that’s fiery and intoxicating. Mezcal Chocolate is shaped by Mathis Molinié, digital tastemaker and head chef at Restaurant Philippe in Rouen. It opens with sparkling lime oil and chili pepper, deepened by olibanum from Somalia and an ultra-rare Rhum extract. The cacao’s creaminess melts into a bed of woods: Virginia cedarwood and cypriol oil from India, adding a dark, earthy glow..

Succumb to the indulgence of Vanille Crème, a gourmand evoking the richness and tenderness of homemade custard. The bergamot and cream opening recalls the velvety scent of freshly made crème anglaise. The heart reveals vanilla, enhanced by a touch of caramel and buttery notes. In the base, enveloping notes of vanilla, musk, and sugar snuggle with sweetness..

Inspired by the traditional Provençal sweet Calisson, an almond-shaped paste of candied fruit topped with fondant icing. This edp launches with bergamot and sugary milk. Fresh orange blossom radiates from the heart, supported by a warm and creamy sandalwood. Base notes of caramel, vanilla and musk complete the mouth-watering effect..

French Macaron captures the essence of its namesake French pastry. The opening notes of warm milk and almond offer a comforting sensation, like a freshly baked macaron. The heart reveals a fruity raspberry, balanced by a biscuit note. The caramel and vanilla base is a sweet and smooth sign-off..

listings.rawTitle: Fathom V Director's Cut 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: To commemorate a decade of Fathom V, Beaufort has produced a limited edition ‘Directors Cut’ extrait version of the scent: the ‘big green beast’ retooled in an ultra-strong variant at a 150% higher oil inclusion.. This ‘extended’ version brings to life the more muted aspects of the original, heightening the spices and turning the flower shop plant stems aspect into a fallen forest of green. Incredibly powerful and extremely long-lasting. Each all-black bottle is individually numbered, with the edition running to only 1000 pieces worldwide. Each box contains a hand-signed note of authenticity..

listings.rawTitle: Oriental Casbah 100 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: An “angels with dirty faces” patchouli that contrasts its syrupy richness with an appealing damp earth undertone. “Casbah” is a North African fortress, and here a citadel of camphoraceous eucalyptus twins patchouli’s counterintuitive haze of freshness, while the base of cistus and sandalwood adds animal warmth. A rugged patchouli in extrait strength..

listings.rawTitle: Via dell’Incenso 100 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: The Via dell’Incenso was an ancient trade route for the passage of incense, spices and other luxury goods from South Arabia and the Horn of Africa to the Mediterranean world. This namesake perfume evokes the storied journey with a dance between chilly incense and cushy cashmeran. The result is a cold fire beneath incense, lemony elemi, brisk pine and charred guaiac wood. Any sharp edges are padded with cashmeran, ambered and velvety. .

listings.rawTitle: Via dell’Incenso 50 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: The Via dell’Incenso was an ancient trade route for the passage of incense, spices and other luxury goods from South Arabia and the Horn of Africa to the Mediterranean world. This namesake perfume evokes the storied journey with a dance between chilly incense and cushy cashmeran. The result is a cold fire beneath incense, lemony elemi, brisk pine and charred guaiac wood. Any sharp edges are padded with cashmeran, ambered and velvety. .

listings.rawTitle: Via dell’Incenso 10 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: The Via dell’Incenso was an ancient trade route for the passage of incense, spices and other luxury goods from South Arabia and the Horn of Africa to the Mediterranean world. This namesake perfume evokes the storied journey with a dance between chilly incense and cushy cashmeran. The result is a cold fire beneath incense, lemony elemi, brisk pine and charred guaiac wood. Any sharp edges are padded with cashmeran, ambered and velvety. .

Bergamundi (a Latin-esque name meaning “bergamot of the world”), starts bright and fizzy with bergamot, tangerine and lime. This eau de parfum is fleshed out by smiling magnolia and orange blossom, and anchored by airy musk and cedarwood. .

Bergamundi (a Latin-esque name meaning “bergamot of the world”), starts bright and fizzy with bergamot, tangerine and lime. This eau de parfum is fleshed out by smiling magnolia and orange blossom, and anchored by airy musk and cedarwood. .

listings.rawTitle: Reunion Vanilla 100 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: Reunion Island is the historic birthplace of Bourbon vanilla, high quality pods with a creamy/spicy richness. This extrait is a vanilla scent for lovers of sugar icing desserts. A scrumptious marshmallow accord is floralised with the golden warmth of peach blossom. As Reunion Vanilla wears, the vanilla beans lean woody with the addition white woods and musk..

listings.rawTitle: Reunion Vanilla 50 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: Reunion Island is the historic birthplace of Bourbon vanilla, high quality pods with a creamy/spicy richness. This extrait is a vanilla scent for lovers of sugar icing desserts. A scrumptious marshmallow accord is floralised with the golden warmth of peach blossom. As Reunion Vanilla wears, the vanilla beans lean woody with the addition white woods and musk..

listings.rawTitle: Reunion Vanilla 10 ml Extrait de parfum
listings.description: Reunion Island is the historic birthplace of Bourbon vanilla, high quality pods with a creamy/spicy richness. This extrait is a vanilla scent for lovers of sugar icing desserts. A scrumptious marshmallow accord is floralised with the golden warmth of peach blossom. As Reunion Vanilla wears, the vanilla beans lean woody with the addition white woods and musk..

"Fiore di cotone" is an Italian expression for "cotton flower", used to describe a fresh, clean scent. This EdP is powdery and green, thanks to the interplay of lavender with musk and bergamot. Artemisia lends a subtly herbaceous and bitter edge, putting a little starch in this smell of freshly-washed sheets..

"Fiore di cotone" is an Italian expression for "cotton flower", used to describe a fresh, clean scent. This EdP is powdery and green, thanks to the interplay of lavender with musk and bergamot. Artemisia lends a subtly herbaceous and bitter edge, putting a little starch in this smell of freshly-washed sheets..

"Fiore di cotone" is an Italian expression for "cotton flower", used to describe a fresh, clean scent. This EdP is powdery and green, thanks to the interplay of lavender with musk and bergamot. Artemisia lends a subtly herbaceous and bitter edge, putting a little starch in this smell of freshly-washed sheets..

listings.rawTitle: Lovers in Pink 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Russian-French painter Marc Chagall inspired Lovers in Pink with his ecstatic portraits of his wife and muse Bella. Like a champagne bubble, this extrait sparkles with a blackcurrant/lemon/ginger effect. A bouquet of roses, peonies and jasmine glows against a woody background. The result is a declaration of love in all its forms.. . .

listings.rawTitle: Fiesta Habana 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Cuba was the nightlife, casino and party paradise of the 1930s, where Cherigan was already a favourite perfume brand of the local jet set. Fiesta Habana is an ode to the vibrations of Havana nights, enveloped in a swirl of Cuban rum and sweet tobacco. This extrait is enhanced by creamy vanilla and tolu roughed up with haylike tonka bean, spicy immortelle and earthy patchouli. . . .

listings.rawTitle: Fleurs de Tabac 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Launched in 1929, Fleur de Tabac was part of the roaring twenties perfume trend for “tobacco”, considered daringly taboo when worn by young women. With its notes of iris and pipe tobacco, oak moss and tonka, this extrait summons the heady atmosphere of 20th century Parisian cabarets. The original formula has been analysed and reconstructed with the finest raw materials, conjuring searing jazz, frenzied dancing and rebellious chic..

listings.rawTitle: Iris Coffee 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Iris Coffee is a sophisticated sip of beautifully-bitter coffee with a cardamom bite. An undercurrent of jasmine lends voluptuousness, while powdery iris, tonka bean and musk steer the composition towards leather. Stimulating and comforting. .

listings.rawTitle: Edo Park 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: When Japan opened up trade and travel to the rest of the world in the mid 19th century, it influenced art, theatre, architecture and philosophy across Europe. Edo Park is an olfactory portrait of Japan through the eyes of the West, with osmanthus as the centrepiece. An iconic flower of Asian culture, osmanthus has a complex blend of apricot, tea and soft leather. In this extrait, this sophisticated but sunny floral is enhanced with notes of citrus, freesia and Siberian pine..

listings.rawTitle: Divine Lotus 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Divine Lotus is inspired by the sacred flower that rises untouched above murky waters. The lotus stands bright and serene on the surface, yet its roots remain deep in damp, muddy earth. Divine Lotus opens with white and pink lotus, radiant, watery florals that reflect purity and clarity. As the scent evolves, the hidden world beneath the waterline begins to surface — earthy, animalic and softly damp nuances echo the lotus root’s stamina and strength below. .

“Feel free, like a child running barefoot in the garden of your past experience. Dedicate yourself to this strange ritual. Worship and forsake all, we leave at dusk.”. Discordant notes of ether, with its menthol halo, and palo santo, with its creamy wood, juxtapose to challenge your comfort. If you can reconcile them, you’re in the cult..
“Lay back in the grass, breath of fresh mountain air, alone but one with the universe, the devil’s in the details.”.

“Powerwalk for creative conjuring, Tincture, Sports drink, Trap beat, Weirdos in the woods.”. This elixir blends the wintergreen snap of wormwood with a lived-in melange of something that evokes human hair, old soap and a deep exhalation. Tuberose lends its floral-not-floral force to this dark forest spell..

“A dirty bloom Dancing by candlelight, warm luxury, equal parts seduction and depth.”. In poetry, the volta is a dramatic shift in thought and/or emotion. This perfume starts down a bright berry-rose road, before taking a turn into earthy patchouli and a scuffed-up musk. The effect is emphatic..

“Do whatever you want in your own way, lipstick, powder head love letters, cherry on top all grown up but not really.”. This potion summons strange leather suggested by iris, which also cues impressions of vintage lipstick. A distant marzipan twists the leather into doll head notes of plastic and powder, for an unexpectedly tough statement..

In your dream, you’re an alpine snowboarder. The fresh air gives you a headrush as you carve effortlessly through the pristine snow. A cave emerges, and you unclip your board to enter the darkened space, overwhelmed by the unexpected sensation of salty steam billowing out of the hidden hot spring. The air has a metallic quality. Breathe Out conjures a kaleidoscope of contradictory sensations—the chilly bite of mountain air, the mineral steam of geysers, and the heady tropical sunshine of frangipani, summoning the paradox of nature’s tranquility against its danger.. Perfumer: Soizic Beaucourt.

The dream of a luxury summer resort, where the sky is pink and the guests are from outer space. Languages from Earth and beyond blend in an excited babble as waitstaff weave through the cabanas with tropical cocktails and yuzu sorbet. You hold a piece of strange alien fruit up to the blue sun, and suddenly the planet is awash in neon yellow.. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour.

The dirt road is bumpy, glowing red in the fiery sunset. The truck lumbers through Mediterranean farmland, kicking up dust at every turn. You put your hand out the passenger window, experiencing the dry heat of summer and the rich smell of figs. Pulling into the grove, you fill your mouth with sticky figs. The driver takes you by the hand and you start running towards the sounds of laughter and music. There are flamenco guitars, dancing, milky cocktails. You spin around and around until the colours of the crowd swirl into infinity.. Perfumer: Joëlle Lerioux Patris.

A dream of childhood summer days. You’re in a garden, familiar and unfamiliar, looking into the kitchen of a house where your mother makes jam with fresh-picked berries. There’s a rose bush with a magical cat underneath, its dense fur filled with your favourite toys. A sublime aroma of tart blackcurrant and rhubarb, sweet lychee and magnolia, along with woody amber ferries you off to a dreamlike world, brimming with enchantment at every corner. You don’t want to wake up.. Perfumer: Julia Rodriguez Pastor.

Inspired by the dream of waking up in a Provençal country house next to the one you love. Linen curtains sway open in a breeze to reveal a meadow dappled with wildflowers. The sound of a fast-moving brook fills the air. Where Love Belongs sings with the delicate essence of lily of the valley, laced with citrus, musky and woody notes.. Perfumer: Julia Rodriguez Pastor.

Inspired by the dream of an upside-down world. Mandarin and blood orange mix with aquatic, airy and green notes to create a surreal dreamscape where the sky is beneath your feet and a vast blue ocean hangs over your head. See-through boats drift by, and the invigorating aroma of imaginary citrus trees energizes your senses. You don’t want to go back to the world you know.. Perfumer: Maud Chabanis.

Inspired by a dream of flying naked over a lush jungle. Your skin tingles from the cold, before you feel the rustle of leaves against your body as you descend through the canopy of cypress and white cedar trees. Your senses are dazzled by the smell of green: vetiver, juniper, moss. You live here now.. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour.

A dream of being completely loved. You’re in an artist's workshop surrounded by the soft scent of carved driftwood, palo santo and sandalwood. In the next moment, you're wrapped in your lover's arms, feeling their gentle touch on your skin and the blissful immersion of the hug. A blend of woody, amber, spicy and powdery notes invites you to lose yourself in this intimate fragrance, evoking the best memories of feeling cherished and safe.. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour.

Inspired by a dream of a romantic encounter in a Parisian bakery. The air is filled with the mouthwatering aroma of candied fruits, vanilla-laced pastries, a hint of sweet tobacco. You’re captivated by the sight of a beautiful stranger holding a bouquet of fresh freesias. This playfully flirty mix of cream-topped fruits and florals conjures the dream all over again.. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour.

Inspired by the dream of chasing something just out of reach — a shimmer, a smile, a sunbeam. This scent glows with golden vanilla, the sweet’n’sour sparkle of tamarind, and the dusty warmth of an antique wooden trunk..

Inspired by the dream of a pastel sky and a candy-floss forest, Cloud Essence drifts through mists of milk, soft light and silent wonder. A scent of warmth and comfort, where creamy notes of milk, rice, musk and gentle mimosa whisper like a lullaby that lingers long after you wake..

Inspired by the dream of a night that pulses with rhythm and desire. Their hand slides up your arm, slow and electric, and the attraction that fills the air between you is thick enough to drown in. You surge together, drawn by an invisible force, teetering on the edge of something that feels like it could consume you. Then — the sweetness of connection vanishes like smoke. Honeyed spice, glowing fruit, and a whisper of tobacco linger long after the music fades..

listings.rawTitle: Lovebird Special Edition 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: In the branches of a sprawling thorn tree, a boisterous flock of lovebirds gathers, undeterred by the African savanna’s scorching heat. Cheerful chatter fills the air as they flit and weave, playfully hopping from one partner to another. Amid the lively commotion, one pair slips away to a quiet perch. Snuggling head to head, they preen one another, their affectionate chirps muffled against velvety soft feathers. The setting sun captures the intimate encounter, washing the glorious hues of the lovebirds’ intertwined plumage with a golden glow.. Zoologist Lovebird bottles the thrill of budding romance in a single spritz. It opens with a playful burst of kiwi, orange, and passionfruit, as sweet and fleeting as a first kiss. A captivating blend of ylang-ylang, lavender, lily of the valley, and heliotrope weaves an intimate connection, drawing you deeper. Finally, ambrette, musk and amber ignite a sensual embrace, leaving a warm, lingering glow of enduring love..

listings.rawTitle: Elephant Sanctuary Edition 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A white shroud of mist evaporates in the amber rays of the morning sun, parting to unveil a canvas painted with brilliant colour. In the peaceful haven, a rustle of leaves whispers softly. Massive foot pads stir up sweet, earthy scents, but deep beneath the soil, harrowing memories of clanking chains and chaotic circuses lie buried. Like old scars, those memories stretch across generations, faded yet never fully erased. Majestic matriarchs bear the painful weight of remembering, so their young might frolic unburdened. The exuberance of a calf, trumpeting with abandon, tramples the dark past, while a solemn bull, buoyed by the joyous outburst, sways behind the stripes of tree trunks, never having had to endure the vicious bars of a cage.. Zoologist Elephant, Sanctuary Edition is an ode to the tranquility that comes with true freedom. In stark contrast to their vivid blooms, a soft veil of delicate jasmine, tuberose, osmanthus and rose murmurs with quiet grace as it settles with a subtle whisper. Pink pepper, cardamom and nutmeg warm the skin, while a splash of tea entices you into a verdant haven, defended by the imposing presence of sandalwood and suede. Wander your world freely with strength and serenity..

. . Tentacles of anise-infused florals (jasmine, mimosa, white rose) weave their way through this sea of green: vegetal artichoke, watery lotus, bright peppermint, briny seaweed. The effect is a deep, esoteric leather. . . . .

. . An autumnal picnic in a harvested field. Strawberry chocolate in the pocket of a suede jacket. Roasted barley on the air, a clash of earthy aromatics: angelica, lavender, helichrysum. The bite of whisky, the sweet twang of pear. Dense and fortifying.. . . .
. . Tart and earthy rhubarb set against tobacco and the heady green floral of narcissus. The zingy dissonance continues with the interplay of tangerine, patchouli, styrax and wet leather.. . . .

A pile-up of contrasts: cinnamon along with tropical florals frangipani and ylang ylang, against the earthy bitterness of artichoke and leather. This almost-gingerbread, almost-cement perfume confuses the senses with its animal/vegetable/mineral mystery..

Inspired by the serene monasteries of Russia, where silence, snow, and incense create a mystical atmosphere. A blizzard of white aldehydes set the scene, swirling around clove-like pimento, cold/minty hinoki wood, and evergreen pine. The incense here is a cold smolder..

Kyoto is a lean and clean incense that smells like a sacred space in a forest clearing. The incense here is shaped by dry and spicy cypress and cedar, crisp teak, and the sweet hay of everlasting flower. Even just wearing Kyoto is a purification ritual..

Sunscreen captures the shimmering memory of a long-lost summer. West Coast sun against salty skin morphs into cool splashes of ocean surf, and the whiff of chlorine on the wind. Plastic pool floats and coconut sun lotion: the scent of Venice Beach, California. Comforting and weird.. . .

Lovely and limpid, pretty and pellucid, osmanthus is poetry in a flower. Its scent is a gorgeous whirl of apricot, tea and suede, which in Dot is made even more fresh with bitter orange and leafy green notes. This enveloping edp keeps the edges round with amber woods, punctuated by a sprinkling of peppery frankincense. .

Black in name, black in nature: black pepper, incense, leather, licorice, birch tar. The effect is tough but comforting — a campfire shot through with sparks of nutmeg, and more than a hint of gasoline-infused motorbike saddle. .

Perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour sought to recreate the smell of the inside of an ancient Catholic cathedral: “It’s a mix of something strongly incense-y together with a mineral-like note and wet flagstone, which adds something fresh and chilly.” Avignon is indeed chilly, but also radiant, with its aromatic halo of balsamic myrrh, lemony elemi and punchy patchouli..

Comme des Garcons 2 is a landmark perfume in the CdG range, and a revered cult classic. Built around invisible incense, the suggestion of ink, and the gentle euphoria of tea, CdG2 is bright and clear, but with an unexpected tenderness. Incredibly diffusive, this EdP retains its structure and presence while also hanging in the air with a barely-there shimmer. .

White is a bright and lively fragrance built around the friction between hot spices and suave florals. The cinnamon, clove and cardamom opening suggests candied red hots, which makes it all the more surprising when the melange of rose de Mai and lily of the valley softly asserts itself. The undertone of tagete, with its bitter herbalness, keeps White from getting too “pretty-pretty”..

A high-contrast fragrance: metallic/vegetal, bitter/sweet. Copper opens as a galbanum bomb: the sap of the Persian perennial producing its characteristic grassy bite. Copper elicits strong impressions: from “peas growing in a sun-baked greenhouse” to “a cashmere scarf permeated with cigarette smoke”, with the unifier being “comforting”, due to its soft path to a faded tobacco-vanilla drydown. .

This monster of an “anti-perfume” is simultaneously clean and dense, the olfactory interpretation of the building material. Aptly encased in a grey concrete bottle, this eau de parfum is an astonishingly diffusive blend of sandalwood, rose and spices, with a powerful smoothness that mimics the material's satisfying surface. .

A woody choir with sandalwood singing lead. Vetiver, oud and incense lift their voices in a grounding blend that highlights the coziness of sandalwood. Pepper adds percussion and punctuation, adding liveliness to the friendliness. .

The colors of the day are melting. In the shadows, feelings take surprising shapes. The night is calling. Softness is in the air. Silent connections form. The alchemy is real. Two shadows. One.. Sombra is a dirty shadow of tough rose and oud, spiced with saffron and nutmeg. Tolu balsam bathes the composition in a twilight effect of almost-sweet tobacco and leather, for an animalic result that purrs. .

From the heart of the Mediterranean scrub, where the air hums with resin and sun-drenched leaves, Ladano rises — a fragrance shaped by the slow pulse of Cistus ladanifer. For centuries, this golden resin has been gathered from the wool of animals, breathing its scent into fabric and skin. Here, labdanum glows rather than burns — thick, balsamic, embracing. It’s animated by tickly aromatics: licorice, celery seed, cinnamon leaf and immortelle..

Terram captures the Mediterranean embrace of autumn. The path winding up from the beach is silent. Sweet aromatic notes of dry soil and clifftop pines float in the air. A haze of ambery benzoin and dusty patchouli settles over musk. Warm, woody, still — this is a fragrant mood that comforts and lulls. .

The sun stands still. The air shimmers. Time dissolves. You are alone — but not lonely. Skin. Silence. Isleta is the echo of an island within you — a moment without direction, carried by light and warmth. A daydream in summer. Hold onto nothing. Just be.. Isleta is an extraordinary fragrance that shines with the generosity of summer. This bright green floral weaves a delicate dance between fresh grass and sultry jasmine sambac, savory fig and aromatic white tea. .

This is the updated packaging Vanagloria , now part of the Extreme collection.. A fragrance that expresses all the richness of vanilla in its many nuances. Vanagloria is built around a sublime quality of LMR vanilla pods, whose most subtle tones I have amplified. This Bourbon vanilla, grown in the Indian Ocean, is extracted using CO₂, a cold-extraction technique that reveals the full spectrum of its gourmand, floral, leathery, and spicy notes. Its leathery character is reinforced by saffron, made addictive by a touch of tonka bean, while swirls of incense add a mystical aura to its texture. .

listings.rawTitle: Baise Moi On The Dancefloor 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Year: 1979 Place: Paris Champagne in crystal flutes, jasmine vines and iris roots, limbs tangled and lipstick smudged, a poet and a muse, an ocean of violets in bloom. “Love is reciprocal torture,” breathed through a cloud of powder. .

listings.rawTitle: Call For A Good Time 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Year: 2000 Place: Tokyo Fizzy grape vape sparks of amber lasers and violet orbs, plumes of jasmine, twirling petals of ylang-ylang, yuzu cake on the dance floor, all the shining colours spinning from a gigantic mirror ball in the sky. .

listings.rawTitle: Heathens Cowboys And The Santa Ana Winds 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Year: 1986 Place: Los Angeles Palm trees, a wild sweet breeze, fortunes told, green tea leaves, naked hips, Freudian slips, loose lips, sandalwood embers in warm amber sunsets, a city of angels with no angels, a haven for heathens, cowboys and nymphos. .

listings.rawTitle: Lola at Coat Check 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Year: 1992 Place: New York Spirals of sandalwood smoke, love letters and curses, white chocolates in pockets, a moment of softness, razor-edged nails, tiered chandeliers, a glimpse of the moon high in the sky, a whisper on lips that turns into a 4am surprise. .

Year: 1985 Place: London Leather and gin and glistening skin, crimson nights and black box peepholes, a bath of glowing amber, a key on a chain, a glimpse in the saffron haze, silhouette reflections in infinite mirrors, eyes that can’t look away. .

Over millions of years, persistent rainwater gnaws at porous limestone, carving out karsts deep within the earth. Carried in droplets, sediment grows upon itself, forming misshapen statues. The stalagmites and stalactites reach for one another, patient in the knowledge that one day they will meet. No sunlight breaches these cavern walls, but something has. Somewhere in time, a family of olms, aquatic salamanders, wandered into the limestone cave and never re-emerged. Generations in darkness have stripped the olms of colour and sight. Pale and blind they wait, sometimes for years, for the subterranean river to deliver a meal of larvae or shrimp to their murky abode.. Close your eyes and follow Zoologist Olm into a cavern of sensory delight. Aromachemicals float in mineral water, flowing into a dewy limestone passage that shimmers with algae and amber, stirring up earthy sandalwood and musks. Olm is not seen. Olm is felt. Let this unique fragrance awaken something deep within you. . . . . .

A rich whisky aroma, intertwined with the sweetness of caramel, coffee and dark chocolate, which truly tickles the senses. With the sophistication of a dandy, the moreish aromas give way to hints of ash and smoke. .

A rich whisky aroma, intertwined with the sweetness of caramel, coffee and dark chocolate, which truly tickles the senses. With the sophistication of a dandy, the moreish aromas give way to hints of ash and smoke. .

An unexpected fragrance, a contrast of spicy, fruity and tangy notes, pinioned by the creaminess of tuberose. Ginger and cardamom play with the taste buds, while the delicate aroma of black tea blends into a warm milk accord. .

An unexpected fragrance, a contrast of spicy, fruity and tangy notes, pinioned by the creaminess of tuberose. Ginger and cardamom play with the taste buds, while the delicate aroma of black tea blends into a warm milk accord. .

The dance of atoms, of stars, of snowflakes, of attic dust. The fizzy carbonation of a cola drink. Cosmic breath captured in a perfume. Sparkling notes of sweet orange, mixed with liqueur, reminiscent of the warm, amber transparency of Cointreau. Altamura constantly evolves, transporting you to a nebula of incense expanding in the void, like an ascending cloud in space. .

The dance of atoms, of stars, of snowflakes, of attic dust. The fizzy carbonation of a cola drink. Cosmic breath captured in a perfume. Sparkling notes of sweet orange, mixed with liqueur, reminiscent of the warm, amber transparency of Cointreau. Altamura constantly evolves, transporting you to a nebula of incense expanding in the void, like an ascending cloud in space. .

This perfume paints an olfactory portrait of Sada, a glamorous geisha. Her languid body, shamelessly powdered, is draped across the tatami. The silky slide of her skin against the woven straw becomes a caress. Blanc Sada captures her allure — milky rice powder and refined iris suggesting the geisha’s elegant makeup. Through this white veil, a fresh green accord of straw and tatami appears. The fragrance recasts the color of purity through a powdery, sensual composition. .

Dawn Whispers opens with a cold and ozonic note, like an echo suspended between two worlds. Gradually, the fragrance softens, shifting toward subtle, enveloping milky tones. A warm woody base emerges, supported by musky and amber touches. This unexpected contrast captures the whispers of another self, like a lost reflection in a parallel dimension, resonating through infinite spaces. .

A delectable, almost savory blend that combines the warm and comforting notes of almond milk with an exceptionally rare saffron. The aromas merge with the green freshness of sticky tulip sap. A trail of contrasts, oscillating between sweetness and sensuality. .

A passionate declaration of love written in ink and blood. The scent opens on a dark, almost smoky red rose, pierced with crimson sparks. Metallic aldehydes emerge, adding tension and intensity. Dense magnolia adds a sweaty sweetness. The opoponax warms and deepens the whole, leaving a profound, mysterious signature. .

A passionate declaration of love written in ink and blood. The scent opens on a dark, almost smoky red rose, pierced with crimson sparks. Metallic aldehydes emerge, adding tension and intensity. Dense magnolia adds a sweaty sweetness. The opoponax warms and deepens the whole, leaving a profound, mysterious signature. .

listings.rawTitle: Inner War 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The never-ending war between what you “should” do and what you want to do. Where being loyal to your dreams and desires clashes with societal expectations. Well, here’s where the conflict ends. Inner War is an amber carnival of too-muchness, a stop at the candy floss stand, a ravenous kiss on the big wheel. This extrait is a billowing cloud of talcum powder and almond, suggesting delicate heliotrope. Curling like tendrils into the air is a phantom, licorice-like anise, adding freshness and subtle weirdness. Rose supplies the syrupy “mmmmm” that glues together ambroxan, vanilla and patchouli. .

listings.rawTitle: Hey Bitch! 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: “Hey Bitch! You smell fucking good.” In Perfume World, that’s what we call a result. Hey Bitch! raises eyebrows with its dissonance between buttery, blowsy orange blossom and tough, bitter leather. Tangy rhubarb at the top snaps its fingers in your face, before dissolving into a blur of suedey iris and milky sandalwood. The dance between bitter and sweet keeps you on your toes throughout, conjuring hints of…what? Photocopier ink? Coffee? For sure it conjures ambered black leather, Bitch! .

listings.rawTitle: Skin Fetish 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Sniffing is the next generation of fetish: inhaling, craving. Smoke and black cherries in champagne. Rose, oud and amber. Sparkling and titillating, just like foreplay. Your skin, your fetish..

listings.rawTitle: Crispy Porn 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Ourte’s signature vanilla, inspired by toasted waffles and caramel popcorn. Coffee with nuts, coconut on top, soaked in the finest rum. With one dirty ingredient – castoreum – that sets your senses on fire. Live crispy, play naughty..

Almaz, the Arabic word for diamonds, are renowned not only for their beauty, but also for their timelessness as they withstand millions of years of immense pressure in their formation. This EdP references the indestructible nature of diamonds with a powerful blackcurrant-led bouquet. Juiciness is enhanced with raspberry, while powdery heliotrope and musk add padding to the cushiony feel. The ambered base, redolent with vanilla and brown sugar, offsets blackcurrant’s tartness. The jewelled bottle incorporates a poem composed by Elen Jeres Ayoub, portrayed in Eastern Kufic calligraphy. The words have been meticulously placed so that the vertical lines create eight zones on the bottle, representing the lunar phases in each lunar calendar month to represent the passage of time.. The seasons and their times And pressures and their effects, Bear Diamonds as their fruit. -Elen Jeres Ayoub .

Masa is the Arabic word for a one-of-a-kind diamond, and this EdP embodies the diamond’s luminosity through a balance of herbal freshness and ambered wood notes. Masa opens with a crisp combo of bergamot and grapefruit highlighted by the warm spice of ginger root. Mirabelle, a sweet golden plum, becomes the focal point, its honeyed floral charms suspended in a radiant amber syrup of cardamom, vanilla, guaiac wood and patchouli. A stealth violet leaf, a throwback to vintage elegance, steers Masa towards leather. .

Inspired by the iconic cocktail Piña Colada, Kajal Kolada pays homage to escape and blissful pleasure. Kolada starts as it means to go on with a skyscraper pineapple, given an assertive twist by a metallic lily-of-the valley accord. The uneasy alliance of tropical fruit with this mineral floral is fleshed out with creamy coconut milk and amber. A provocative perfume. .

Many ancient cultures revered rubies, believing these sacred stones to be immortal emblems of love, vitality and the unyielding pulse of life itself. Ruby opens with a burst of red berries, pineapple, and juicy, juicy cherries. Much like cherry blossoms, cherries conjure the delicate and fleeting nature of life, a reminder of moments to be savoured. The heart notes swirl with whipped cream and brown sugar, before settling into a rich fusion of musk, amber and benzoin. .

In Arabic, Lamar means “liquid gold”, the legendary potion long sought by alchemists in search of immortality. This generous fruity-floral embraces the eternity of living in the moment. In creating Lamar, perfumer Mark Buxton said, “My inspiration was to create a rich, natural, warm, long lasting fragrance, by using high quality natural products. This gives a feeling of walking through a bed of roses or a jasmine field – very feminine and sensual.” Lamar opens with a festival of berries, apple and pineapple. The heart notes glow with jasmine sambac, Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose and magnolia. Vanilla, musk and amber supply the softest landing. .

An ancient king named Yuvanaswa had great wealth, good fortune and many queens. But no children, which he wanted more than anything. So the sages prepared a magic potion to bestow a mighty son upon whomever drank it, which awkwardly turned out to be the thirsty king, instead of the queens it was intended for. The baby was delivered by cutting a hole through the king’s thigh, and the breastfeeding conundrum was solved by the god Indra, who slit his own thumb to feed the child with life-giving nectar. And that’s why babies, born with the memory of their divine ancestors, still suck their thumbs.. Thumbsucker illuminates this legend with the narcotic flower power of narcissus, melding its dirty floral appeal with animalic honey. A vintage violet drifts through a comforting cloud of leathery styrax balsam and candle wax. .

Silphium was a plant widely renowned as a spice, medicinal herb and perfume ingredient throughout the empires of classical antiquity, outshining both saffron and cinnamon. It was praised by Greek philosophers and writers, as well as Roman emperors and cookbook authors. The demand for Silphium eventually became so overwhelming that it was harvested to extinction, and the taste and smell of the once greatest spice in the world were lost in time.. This extinct plant was reconstructed by researching assumed relatives of Silphium, using aromachemicals (the molecular building blocks of scents) to create an accord reflecting historical descriptions. This is set against a background of ancient incense, woods and leather. . .
Pine! It’s soooooo pine. Camp fire smoke and fresh cold air combine in a fragrance both bracing and comforting..

In his Descriptio Montis Fracti sive Montis Pilati from 1555, the famous Swiss naturalist Conrad Gessner chronicles his journey into the caves of the Alps. “At night, the moon shines into the cave so brightly the light itself seems to take form, like a mist. It gathers in the ceiling and makes the limestone stalactites glitter and gleam, dripping tears of white liquid into puddles on the rock floor that never dries. Moonmilk.”. This EdP lives up to that sublime description with a dance between conflicting textures that titillates the nose. The black tea and lime opening establishes an expectation for further crispness to come. The switcheroo comes with the appearance of Mysore sandalwood, its milky incense soft like a lover’s touch on the skin. All the elements resolve in a fresh and tender leather. .

This is a fantasy interpretation of the long-lost scent of the musk monkeyflower, beloved in Victorian England for its delicate yellow petals and rich musk smell. That is, until the turn of the twentieth century, when the flower suddenly lost its odour. This biological mystery continues to stump botanists and windowbox gardeners alike. So until the monkeyflower rediscovers its mojo, Stora Skuggan has created an imaginary version, a sunny meadow of flowers and herbs. Gently fruity chamomile and fig swirl through a landscape of comforting hay and musk. A sunscreen accord suggests bare skin warming in the late afternoon heat. Mellow and uplifting..

A Mistpouffer is an unexplained natural sound, a sonic boom like distant cannon fire that seems to come out of the fog over large lakes or rivers. It has been recorded all over the world throughout history, and is the source of many legends. Despite scientific attempts to understand the sounds, its source has still not been identified. Possible explanations include solar winds resonating in the atmosphere, underground earthquakes or gas bubbles being released from the deep. Others believe it is the work of extraterrestrial or subsurface civilisations. . Rendering this mystical water thunder as a fragrance was as elusive as the sound itself. We spent four years and hundreds of iterations before finding the right balance between being distinctive and inexplainable. The honeyed hay of immortelle dapples sunshine across deep green siblings vetiver and cypriol. It’s foggy but not aquatic, smoky but not heavy. Natural, but in equal parts supernatural. . .

“In rifleing the closet of the ladie, they found a pipe of oyntement, wherewith she greased a staffe, upon which she ambled and galloped through thick and thin, when and in what manner she listed” – Proceedings Against Dame Alice Kyteler, Prosecuted for Sorcery, 1324 . Hexensalbe, also known as witches’ flying ointment, was a hallucinogenic salve used in witchcraft in the middle ages. It was a mixture of extremely poisonous ingredients that produced an ecstatic trance with powerful sensations of flying, images of otherworldly creatures and a primal sexual hunger. . But where did the witches’ broomstick come in? The ointment was too poisonous to eat, so instead it was applied to other soft membranes, commonly the genitals. Because of the erotic effects of the high, the salve would often be rubbed directly onto a phallic object like the end of a staff or a broomstick. (Now that’s what we call “riding a broomstick”!) . Given which aspects of the history of hexensalbe have been suppressed, it would seem that the one thing more terrifying than witches is female sexuality. This fragrance celebrates the forbidden rituals of personal power, summoning the ancient ways with dark aromatics: wormwood, liquorice, belladonna and black hemlock. Voluptuous tuberose and vibrant patchouli ensure a long and blissful trip. . .

listings.rawTitle: Fantome de Maules (The Ghost of Maules) 30 ml EdP
listings.description: An enigmatic being, seen by locals in the late 1990s wandering the Swiss woodlands of Maules, dressed in a camouflage cape and a vintage gas mask. No one knew if they were woman or man, or even human, but this 6’3” creature was always observed picking and smelling flowers. When the cryptid disappeared forever after ten years of sightings, Le Matin reported that the mask and the cape were found in the forest, along with a note signed “Fantôme de Maules”. . This olfactory tribute summons the forest that was the stranger’s haven: green leaves, galbanum, lavender, oakmoss and vetiver. A scent that’s part barbershop, part woodland escape. Who was this “ghost”, anyway? We will never know, because they don’t want us to. The modern world is alight with information and the shadows are shrinking. So here’s one for perfume lovers who don’t feel it necessary to explain themselves. .

The azalai is a caravan route through the Saharan desert where camel trains have transported salt and gold for a thousand years. Along the route stood a single acacia tree, the only living thing in an ocean of sand. 150 km from any other, this was the loneliest tree in the world, a sacred testament to the resilience of life, that had guided caravans for centuries. When a drunken truck driver crashed into it in 1973, killing it, the sacred tree passed from legend to myth. This phantom tree in the desert is the inspiration for Azalai.. The scent is as an olfactory impression of gold, with radiant warmth from saffron and blood orange, and the plush musk velvione (a material redolent of the powdery scent of a newborn’s head). Gum acacia, a syrup made from acacia sap, provides sugary sweetness balanced by salty amber and incense. A touch of mint tea and dried fruit pays homage to the Tuareg caravan riders. .
A fig that you feel, rather than smell. In This World is a wisp of clean green fig, supported by aromatic notes of lavender and sage. Tonka adds hay-like warmth, and violet lends tender sweetness..

Inspired by the weightlessness of a day without plans or obligations. Effervescent top notes of ripe peach and bergamot levitate over wild orchid, crisp linen and sequoia wood. Aldehydes swirl airy musk in a cloud around you..
A fragrance inspired by opposites — exquisite allure and emotional depth. Bergamot and cardamom sing while white and black tea cascade into a luscious tapestry of blonde woods and velvet musk..

A whimsical, rich and fluffy treat inspired by choux à la crème pastry and “chouchou”, the French term of endearment. This cream puff perfume is conjured with accords of cocoa, caramel, vanilla cream and sandalwood. A spritz of citrus puts a little pucker in the sweetness..

Celestial Object is inspired by the idea that we are made of stars, and the connection between body and sky. Here the connection is between skin and vanilla, enlivened by sugared almonds and the popcorn nuance of rice, with a sprinkling of salt. Sweet and buttery. .

The olfactory journey through ancient Pompeii continues, this time focusing on the vibrant cultural and commercial life that defined the city. . From this dynamic atmosphere comes Vettii, a fragrance that opens fresh and fruity, gradually becoming more opulent and enveloping. It’s a conversation between precious Mediterranean ingredients and rich Oriental treasures, where fig and strawberry meet saffron, myrrh and oud.. . .

A sea breeze weaves through the slumbering streets of Pompeii at dawn. Here, the Mediterranean aromas of citrus fruits and aromatic herbs blend with the wild scent of dew-kissed apples. The talcum-like fragrance of frescoed walls, suggested by powdery iris, grounds the fragrance..
Mountain air infused with juniper settles over an ancient coniferous forest. Orris and white musk mesh with balsam fir to create a cold, luminous finish..
The creamy lemon-vanilla of magnolia joins forces with the gourmand glamour of a grand cru coffee liquor. Rich, sweet and deep, set aglow with a ribbon of fluffy musk. .
The creamy lemon-vanilla of magnolia joins forces with the gourmand glamour of a grand cru coffee liquor. Rich, sweet and deep, set aglow with a ribbon of fluffy musk. .

An unusual tuberose that highlights the cold green aspect of this tropical bloom. A green leaves accord lends a grassy aspect, while vetiver deeps the metallic earthiness. Ylang-ylang twins with tuberose’s voluptuous ripeness..
