Prepare to enter the dark entanglement of Jungle Tobacco, a dense canopy of burnished blond tobacco. Every surface, every space is drizzled with honeyed heliotrope, lulling you into a narcotic swoon. A rough-around-the-edges oud lends gravitas to the sweetness, making this a poised and pretty perfect tobacco..

Prepare to enter the dark entanglement of Jungle Tobacco, a dense canopy of burnished blond tobacco. Every surface, every space is drizzled with honeyed heliotrope, lulling you into a narcotic swoon. A rough-around-the-edges oud lends gravitas to the sweetness, making this a poised and pretty perfect tobacco..

A smoky spicy floral rather than a hops-fuelled fury, this warrior of the night throws the first punch: carnation, with its red-hot clove effect. An unusual nuance of malt, toasted and rich, is complemented by smoked tea. A hint of vintage violet permeates the intriguing melting candle drydown..

A smoky spicy floral rather than a hops-fuelled fury, this warrior of the night throws the first punch: carnation, with its red-hot clove effect. An unusual nuance of malt, toasted and rich, is complemented by smoked tea. A hint of vintage violet permeates the intriguing melting candle drydown..

Patchouli Monarque is truly a ruler of patchouli perfumes, thanks to the sumptuous blend of supporting materials that make this such an “ahhhhhhhhhh!” experience. Powdery heliotrope and immortelle’s hazy hay create a soft landing for the sweet leather effect of labdanum and amber. Vetiver supports patchouli’s stern earthiness, but there’s no hiding the smile of dusty cocoa that brings friendliness to the lusciousness..

Patchouli Monarque is truly a ruler of patchouli perfumes, thanks to the sumptuous blend of supporting materials that make this such an “ahhhhhhhhhh!” experience. Powdery heliotrope and immortelle’s hazy hay create a soft landing for the sweet leather effect of labdanum and amber. Vetiver supports patchouli’s stern earthiness, but there’s no hiding the smile of dusty cocoa that brings friendliness to the lusciousness..

listings.rawTitle: No. 8 – Drop of Blood 100 ml EdP
listings.description: This enigmatic essence opens with zesty mandarin, briefly evoking the metallic smell of blood, before plunging into the dark pleasures of incense and patchouli. Oud wood deepens the effect, while bittersweet myrrh adds to the mystery..

listings.rawTitle: No. 8 – Drop of Blood 30 ml EdP
listings.description: This enigmatic essence opens with zesty mandarin, briefly evoking the metallic smell of blood, before plunging into the dark pleasures of incense and patchouli. Oud wood deepens the effect, while bittersweet myrrh adds to the mystery..

Rude Rose is a green and stubborn rose that highlights the mischievous modernity of this perfumers’ fetish flower. Tart-sweet yuzu joins blackcurrant berries and ginger for instant pop! at the top. But a dirty myrrh soon enters the scene to rough things up. .

Rude Rose is a green and stubborn rose that highlights the mischievous modernity of this perfumers’ fetish flower. Tart-sweet yuzu joins blackcurrant berries and ginger for instant pop! at the top. But a dirty myrrh soon enters the scene to rough things up. .

listings.rawTitle: No. 6 – Cuir Grand Tigre 100 ml EdP
listings.description: The wild character of the tiger is represented here by a distinguished leather with a green facet of fig in the opening. Tuberose and vanilla adds a fleshy, voluptuous aspect. .

listings.rawTitle: No. 6 – Cuir Grand Tigre 30 ml EdP
listings.description: The wild character of the tiger is represented here by a distinguished leather with a green facet of fig in the opening. Tuberose and vanilla adds a fleshy, voluptuous aspect. .

The story Cleo Gordon doesn’t belong but she sees no way out. She’s too beautiful for the small mountain town where she’s spent her whole life, too educated to relate to the locals, and too curious for her own good. Her quest to find light in the encroaching darkness leads her to catalog everything in her life that brings joy, from a slice of cherry pie chased by a cup of black coffee to the sound of a roaring waterfall in the pitch-black night. Her observations of “Life’s Little Luxuries” redefine what it means to be rich in today’s world, but with affluence comes responsibility. How Cleo navigates this new abundance of wealth is seen as both foolish and brilliant, but which is it?. The scent A hyper-real cherry pie: technicolour cherries fleshed out with marzipan, saffron, demerara sugar and rum-soaked tonka. .

The story Aimless twenty-somethings Calvin and Millie didn’t mean to drop off the face of the earth but when they stumbled onto an abandoned mansion while hiking in the Adirondacks, that’s just what they did. Lounging in the autumn light and lost among the stacks of paperbacks they decided to weather the winter in their found fortress. Spring brought hordes of wildlife, both indoors and out, but no sign of other humans (other than the one growing in Millie’s belly). It would be another four years before the burgeoning family would be forced out of their assumed home but they don’t plan to leave without putting up a fight.. The scent With its earthy labdanum and aged vanilla, the ambreine accord conjures vintage perfumes like Habanita by Molinard and Cuir de Russie by Chanel. In combination with the deep forest scent of oakmoss and a distant fruity quince, The Abandoned Mansion summons leather-bound books and the haze of a thousand parties. A chypre for dark dreams. .

listings.rawTitle: The Silk Road | 丝绸之路 50 ml EdP
listings.description: The Silk Road carried goods, stories and dreams across empires. This scent pays homage to the ancient trade routes with warming notes of spices, tobacco leaf, and leather. A tribute to adventure, history and cultural exchange. .

listings.rawTitle: Spring Festival | 春節 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Every year, millions across China journey home to reunite with family for Lunar New Year. Spring Festival captures this joyous season with notes of mandarin, plum blossom, and candied hawthorn. A scent of celebration and belonging. .

listings.rawTitle: Chinese Calligraphy | 書法 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Calligraphy is China’s living art—each stroke a meditation in ink and paper. The scent evokes the stillness of a scholar’s studio, where technique meets introspection. This quiet ink, paper and coffee fragrance is an homage to the brushstrokes that shaped a civilization. .

listings.rawTitle: Princess of China | 中國公主 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Inspired by the noblewomen of dynasties past, Princess of China is soft yet radiant—like flowers in full bloom. It celebrates China’s rich history and imperial femininity through luminous petals and delicate fruits. Graceful and timeless. .

A pure and crystalline vanilla with mineral freshness, deepened by voluptuous vanilla pod. It’s a trio of rare vanillas: the elegant and airy NaturePrint® blue vanilla, the carnal intensity of Bourbon vanilla, and the woody and velvety facets of Madagascar vanilla. The golden glow of mimosa, with its powdery honey effect, wraps it all together with sunny sweetness..

"I didn't kill because I was angry with them, not because I hated them - I killed because I wanted to keep them with me.” Between 1978 and 1991, Jeffrey Dahmer murdered seventeen men. He lured them with gentleness, drugged them, took their lives, then preserved them. Some he drew, others he photographed. He tried to keep them forever.. Jeffrey is the second chapter of Spiritica's Crime Collection. It is the smell of a damaged mind cracking apart, a world where reality and hallucination coexist. The extrait begins with accords of iced beer and poppers — cold, almost clinical. The heart opens like a wound that breathes: dirty carpet, carnation, coagulated blood, sweat, a sharp blade. The base is the sweetest confession: melted plastic, damp cellar, amber, vetiver. The cap’s flocked and laser-engraved finish reproduces the carpet of the killer’s apartment.. Jeffrey is a fragrance that grips the skin like a memory unwilling to die. .

She killed, dismembered and boiled three women. She used their fat to make bars of soap, and dried their blood in the oven, crumbling it into dough to create crunchy teacakes for herself and her friends. She was Leonarda Cianciulli, the first Italian serial killer, also known as the "soapmaker of Correggio". Leonarda was driven by a macabre maternal desire to protect her son from harm, which she believed required human sacrifice.. This extrait perfume is an olfactory portrait of Leonarda, part of Spiritica’s Crime Collection. The opening of Marseille soap is clean but strange, combined with the spikiness of a peppery accord that conjures caustic soda. And the dirty, dusty, somewhat stale gourmand background suggests something ominous. Chantilly cream-dipped homemade biscuits reveal a ghastly surprise within: raspberry syrup mixed with notes of clotted blood, oozing a sweet and ferrous odor. The malevolent dissonance continues in the base notes, where oud and dark chocolate combine with sulphur. Leonarda is a perfume that infuses madness with love. .

listings.rawTitle: Lynch aka Smoked Styrax 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Lynch is a mysterious and hypnotic fragrance, an olfactory portal that pays homage to the work of surrealist film director David Lynch (Blue Velvet, Twin Peaks, Mulholland Drive). The mesmerising sweetness of cherry pie mingles with cozy woods, creating an illusion of domestic warmth. But nothing is as it seems. Vanilla and night-blooming jasmine swirl around dusty saffron, charred leather and smoky styrax. Dark resins, earthy oud and nocturnal musk leave a dreamy trail, a fragment of restless reality that crumbles upon awakening..

Tokyo, late at night. Pulsing neon lights reflect in the wet streets, disturbed by silent footsteps through the alleys of Kabukicho. Yuzuyakuza is a perfume inspired by the unwritten code of the Japanese mafia, the ritual of the initiation tattoo, and the luxury and danger of a life lived in the shadows. The opening is as sharp as a katana blade. Yuzu and Japanese lime explode with their citrus and metallic freshness, a precise blow that awakens the senses, like the first drop of rain on warm skin. In the heart, the city breathes. The scent of Indian ink blends with the electric smell of wet asphalt, and of a spring blooming of Sakura, evoking the silent ritual of Irezumi: the needle cuts the skin, the drawing comes to life, the pain is just a passage. The perfume’s background is a whisper of power: banknotes touched by expert fingers, the warmth of human skin, a haze of smoke in an exclusive club. Yuzuyakuza leaves a magnetic trail, unmistakable, like the respect earned with blood and silence.. This perfume is available in three different caps, all inspired by Japanese tattoos. .

At the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro, in the forests of the Tijuca National Park, macumba rituals take place. Macumba, from the African Bantu language, is the umbrella term for religious practices blending pagan elements, folk Catholicism and influences from Brazilian culture. The rites promote protection, health, prosperity and luck.. The opening of Mangomacumba explodes with fruity notes of tropical mango and pineapple, punctuated by lime. Peppermint breathes air into the sweetness, before tiare flower and iron assert themselves, referring to the places, tools and the sacrificial offerings involved in macumba rituals. Tobacco absolute, earthy woods and lactonic notes hum through the dry down. . Mangomacumba is an invitation to look beyond what has been imposed on us, as well as a way to get to know one of the most mysterious sides of human existence..

We are in the Valley of the Moon, a ghostly lunar landscape in northern Chile. Unexplained lights and strange shapes regularly zip across its skies. The earth is rich in lithium, a sweet-smelling mineral used in mood-stabilising drugs. The mystery and the magic of the terrain is the inspiration for Weon (meaning “friendship”, from the ancient indigenous language). Weon incorporates elements of a pisco sour (the South American brandy and lime cocktail) with bitter notes of coca leaves (a stimulant legally used by native populations to counteract altitude fatigue in the Andean plateau). The woody/floral fantasy accord of “copihue balsam" connects the Amazonian resin of copaiba with the Chilean national flower, which is copihue. Weon summons the spiritual shadows of a unique place that can generate very strong internal shocks. . The Illuminata Collection is distinguished by their bottles’ photoluminescent caps. Light absorbed during the day glows in the dark of night, representing the occult mystery conjured by the fragrance. . .

The salty Aegean breeze across the Greek island of Tinos carries devotional offerings from both man and nature. Amid bracing eucalyptus and mint softened by honey is an unexpected blend of frankincense, benzoin and sandalwood. That’s from the monastery at the top of the hill, filled with beeswax candles and hammered silver votives left in gratitude for miracles. Suscepto is a hymn to the supernatural sacredness of this place. . .

The green and intoxicating notes of the Chiribasa Valley, lost among the peaks of the Himalayas and near the sources of the Ganges, blend in the air to create a spontaneous, spicy incense. This is the inspiration for Atmayatra, a name composed of two Sanskrit terms Atma (soul) and Yatra (pilgrimage), which seeks to evoke a pilgrimage of the soul. The sumptuous green notes of holy basil tulsi and cannabis, plants that grow freely in the landscape of northern India, mix with the muddy smell of the Ganges River. The result is sun-baked aromatics washed by Himalayan storms, not “comfortable” or simple, but always memorable.. The Illuminata Collection is distinguished by their bottles’ photoluminescent caps. Light absorbed during the day glows in the dark of night, representing the occult mystery conjured by the fragrance..

listings.rawTitle: Un Jour Sans Fin | Endless Day 100 ml EdP
listings.description: The name of this lively perfume is French for “endless day”, and it’s a day filled with the buttery sweetness of pistachio nuts. The earthiness of pistachio is uplifted by the floral innocence of orange blossom, and smoothed by vanilla and hay-like tonka beans..

Ah the wiliness of youth! You think that fresh face shines with only innocence, until a feral cunning presents itself. Disco Inferno starts off playing the game with happy-sappy pear and peach blossom, frangipani and pineapple. Then you realise oud and soft woods are at work behind scenes, allowing that innocent visage into places they should never be allowed..

listings.rawTitle: Bain de Minuit | Skinny Dipping 100 ml EdP
listings.description: “Bain de minuit” is French for “skinny dipping”, and what could be more decadent than a midnight splash au natural in a giant vat of strawberries, cherries and vanilla? The initial fruity-tootiness gives way to a tough ‘n’ tropical accord of monoï oil and leather, with jasmine and praline singing the high and low harmonies..

listings.rawTitle: Faire Le Mur |  Going AWOL 100 ml EdP
listings.description: “Faire le mur” means “going AWOL” en Français, and if you’re going to make a break for it, you might as well do it fragrantly with this fruity-floral escapade. Heady jasmine and spicy lily get juicy thanks to orange and pear. Osmanthus, with its delicate apricot tea facet, bridges flowers to fruits..

listings.rawTitle: Shifumi | Rock Paper Scissors 100 ml EdP
listings.description: Step out into the world clean-with-a-sheen thanks to the dewy freshness of this smile-bringer. The initial grapefruit/mandarin kick opens up into creamy magnolia and tart apple, underscored with woody vetiver and cedar..

listings.rawTitle: Portuguese Man O' War 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Blazing sunlight glistens then fractures on the roiling surface of an angry tropical sea. A caravel bobs among the waves, its tall sail blasted by hot, salty winds. Dangling beneath the ghostly vessel, a curtain of lethal tentacles sways menacingly in the swell. The Portuguese man o’ war drifts, letting its unwitting prey approach. Up to 100 feet long, their lacy tentacles exude crippling venom with the merest touch. In an instant, the prey is paralyzed, and as its organs slowly liquify, the colony of zooids begin to feed.. While it’s wise to avoid a Portuguese man o’ war in the wild, prepare for danger and excitement when you encounter this Zoologist perfume. Crisp ginger and metallic gunpowder deliver a fiery sting to open, before casting you adrift on a wave of briny seaweed absolute, immortelle and geranium. You’ll thrill to this enticing scent where the only pain is the delicious pang of longing..

A secret garden of endless summer, evoked by the luminous opening of blackcurrant and apricot jam, brightened by bergamot and tempered by davana. A floral heart of honeysuckle and rose glow in shades of gold. Night-blooming jasmine, harvested at the summer solstice at its most fragrant, infuses the composition. Muguet, created with headspace technology, lends a dewy, delicate facet. The fragrance settles into a luxurious base of benzoin, cedarwood, vanilla, and Spanish honey, mirroring the glowing amber warmth of the lingering sun..

A celebration of sensual sandalwood. It's the central note, like a golden thread seamlessly interwovenwith the exotic allure of cardamom, creating a lightly spiced composition that whispers luxury. The heart of the fragrance continues with supple cashmere woods lending a soft, velvety quality, while violet and orris underscore the powdery edge of sandalwood. As the fragrance blooms on the skin, olibanum and vanilla produces a subtle warmth, a serene endnote to a fragrance that is both tranquil and tantalizing..

You’re in a cafe on a quiet London street as the morning fog mingles with gentle rain. You breathe in your cup of freshly brewed Earl Grey tea, bright with bergamot and ever so slightly smoky. Silky steamed milk frothed with decadent vanilla bean and a hint of lavender is sweetened with whipped honey. Let London Fog be your invitation to indulge in the serenity of cozy luxury..

A wet and moody rose unfurls its dark petals, releasing the ancient aphrodisiac of saffron, along with bitter/fresh cassis. Javanol, an aromachemical summoning a rose-inflected sandalwood, creates the powerful sillage. Natural sandalwood and a warm tobacco ground the fragrance, adding depth and richness. Kashmir Fusion rounds out the velvety effect with its woody amber-musk..

Tropical-la-la-la! Guava Sorbet sings out with juicy mandarin, fresh guava and tart passionfruit. This abundance of tropical playfulness gets a posh gloss with peachy osmanthus and sultry jasmine. It’s sunshine in a bottle..

Klea opens with crisp mandarin and bergamot, while olive leaf adds an aromatic quality. As it warms on the skin, light and dewy floral notes of water lily, magnolia and jasmine reveal themselves. The citrus and florals intermingle with an aquatic sea salt note, reminiscent of warm skin drying in the sun after a dip in the sea. Papyrus and cedar ground the fragrance with a gentle woodiness, while amber, Egyptian musk and tonka bean add a softly regal quality..

A self-possessed perfume for a person who doesn’t need anything, but craves everything. This is excess with control, 70s-era Bianca Jagger wearing Halston, lighting up the Studio 54 dance floor. Carine is a fiercely chic patchouli with an ample gardenia and jasmine cleavage, trussed in a corset of vetiver. Sighs of rose and amber sail through the trail of this Dominique Ropion composition. Confident, elegant, insolent..

204 perfumer Domitille Michalon says, “I imagined a sunny fragrance bursting with sweet figs over creamy sandalwood; a nap in the shade when the sun is beating down. I added a touch of green, a touch of nature, like a crunchy edamame bean.”.

Orkney, an archipelago located to the north of Scotland, plays host to the inspiration for this fragrance. According to ancient Orkney myth, shapeshifting creatures – selkies – inhabit the bodies of seals who, coming out of the water, shed their skin to walk among humans. Often in these legends the selkie’s skin is found and hidden by local men, and they are forced to marry their human captor.. But in our version of this tale, the selkie takes control. Furious that he has tanned her precious skin, the selkie poisons her captor, reclaiming the leather and returning finally to the tumbling sea.. Sirenide Eau de Parfum is a suitably formidable fragrance: powerful and haunting, with triplicate aspects of ‘skins’ developing on your own. PVC melds with pinseal and an unnerving bitter almond note; water flowers blossom and die, returning to the water. .

Mooncake is a scent of sweet nostalgia—a warm, golden crust giving way to a luscious center of salted egg yolk. Shared during Mid-Autumn Festival, this beloved honey and mung bean treat marks memories of childhood joy and cherished tradition..

As featured on The 2025 Esquire Grooming Awards . A latex and leather 'oud-style' scent. A perfumer’s take on neon-soaked nightlife, the leather scene and raw, nocturnal behavior. With notes of latex, neoprene leather, black shoe shine, hydrocarboresin and styrax..

A fresh-out-of-the shower fragrance, conjuring soft skin dabbed dry with a plush cotton towel, sunshine-fluffed from the laundry line. Elisa elevates yuzu and candied bergamot away from straight lemon sherbet with beguiling florals: Indian davana and Tunisian orange blossom. Sensual sandalwood, musk and benzoin upholster the innocence with knowingness. A scent to make you feel happy, safe and sunny..

To those who seize what’s precious to them the present is eternal. Brutus steals the time by remaining stable and unchangeable. A man who lacked eloquence in his actions, a man who was terrifying yet full of kindness. .
A fragrance that is covered with darkness, that steals the kiss and leaves a spicy aftertaste on the lips. Boccanera strikes a confusing balance between scent and flavor, between love and fear . .

An immersive fougere that storms your senses with a muscular version of the great outdoors. Hallucinogenic wormwood takes the reins of a wild gallop through fir, cedarwood and tobacco. The fierce greenness is cushioned by a plush and saturated musk. .

Stercus never lies. A part of the essential body functioning and a natural way to fertilize the soil. It is the secret sweetness that attracts, and the animalic side that offends. A sign of an infinite life circle. The smell of an end and the beginning. .
Seminalis is our first stimulus in a fragrance bottle. An aromatic aldehyde which helps sperm to locate the ovum, biological proof of olfactive attraction. Life initiated by smell. .
The cool kiss of violet leaf tames the brute force of smoky leather and peppery patchouli. Cuoium releases the raw animal from within you, with nuclear force. .

A rampage through a fantasy meadow. Lily-of-the-valley, orange blossom and lavender are crushed underfoot as you run riot across beauty. Lilac and lemon assert themselves in the carnage. Tonka bean and white musk ensures that this extrait strength perfume stays and plays. .

Dig your hands into the wet earth and feel the tree roots straining against the soil. Birch, lava and smoke coil around Terroni, surrounding guaic wood, patchouli and vetiver with their bitter, cold heat. .
Sights. It is an indomitable depth, the unknown, a call towards all and nothing – here, there, everywhere. The wholeness of the sea doesn’t need an explanation. .

The scent of awakening, an inhale that fractures the ordinary and exalts the extraordinary. It draws from the unseen forces that bind the earthly and the ethereal, a bridge between the tangible and the transcendent. The soul's journey is both the question and the answer. .

971 is the international phone code for the United Arab Emirates, a shorthand for the heritage and spirit of the UAE. The inspiration for 971 comes directly from traditions of the homeland: dates, a symbol of Emirati hospitality and abundance; honey, reflecting sweetness and generosity; and cinnamon, adding warmth and spice reminiscent of local flavors. Bold, yet comforting..

listings.rawTitle: Al Sarab 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: In Arabic, Al Sarab means “mirage”. It is inspired by the twilight desert landscapes of the United Arab Emirates: timeless, mystical, and deeply poetic.. Al Sarab is an intense and profound layering of mixed oud oils blended with pure Cambodian oud (aged 15 years). This is an animalic yet fruity oud for connoisseurs of the earthy wood material, suggesting the mesmerising illusion of the desert’s shifting horizons..

This is the smell of freshly-washed linen — rendered in neon. Powerful, elegant, womanly, RO was created as a tribute to Maysson’s sister. The name carries her initials, as well as her favorite notes in perfume — amber and vanilla, borne aloft by powdery aldehydes. A scent reflecting love and celebrations..

The name S24 refers to the double S in the Maysson brand logo, paired with 24 to signify the very first perfume the house released in 2024. Bitter/nutty notes of saffron and hazelnut accent the woody-leather theme, softened by amber, benzoin and toffee. A fragrance summoning new beginnings, confidence and determination..

The drowned monk’s body is bloated, its fat turned to soap in his watery grave. His crime was revealing the apothecary secrets of his order, in a scroll inscribed with the antidotes to poisonings.. This is privileged information that keeps the power with the friary, and he betrayed his vows.. Farmakon is the smell of his sad story: the odor of parchment, ink — and the wax from the flesh of a drowned man. .

Farmakon is the smell of his sad story: the odor of parchment, ink — and the wax from the flesh of a drowned man. .

Grigia is named for the grey amber — ambergris* — expelled from the sperm whale and used to impart a marine, almost-fecal physicality to perfume. This Grigia suggests a different kind of sperm — human ejaculate — with its bleachy niff and suggestion of release. Combined with an underlay of burnt hair and plastic, Grigia is a voodoo doll of a fragrance that puts a curse on your enemies while protecting you from harm. . * this perfume contains natural ambergris from Irish coastline.

In India, flowers are sacred symbols and an essential part of daily life. “Malli Nadu” means “land of jasmine”, inspired by the paradise of perfume ingredients found in India. There’s jasmine sambac, cultivated in India since antiquity, with its radiant fruity/green sheen and animalic undertone. There’s tuberose, an opulent, powerful floral, along with davana, an aromatic plant unique to India with a profile that vibrates between apricot and herbaceous. Palmerosa oil supplies a geranium-like lift, while Indian vetiver and sandalwood deepens and softens the composition. Perfumer Ilias Ermenidis sought to translate the romance of India into this luminous scent, which he calls “a fragrance for lovers”.

Chaco is the second largest primary forest of Latin America, called the "impenetrable forest" for its incredibly dense formation. This Paraguayan forest is the only place in the world where gaiac wood grows, known locally as palo santo. The region is also prized by perfumers as source of petitgrain essential oil, as well yerba maté tea leaves. Chaco the fragrance is a cologne style built around a refined tea structure. Perfumer Alexandra Monet placed the petitgrain and maté in conversation with each other, heightening each other’s mellow greenness in the process. Palo santo, with its woody, salty and smoky facets, brings warmth and sensuality, resulting in a unique unisex signature with lightness and modern elegance..

Here he offers a deceptively simple rose that plays with contrasts: dry into wet, crisp into voluptuous. In a bit of misdirection, a lean basil and mint twins with rose for an opening that suggests the rest of the journey will be straightforward. That’s until the gunpowder shows up, unfurling its metallic, cold and smoky facets. Geranium shores up the minty rose, while incense, vetiver and benzoin flicker between wood and amber. A dance of beauty and violence. .

listings.rawTitle: Orchid Mantis 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: In the muggy shade of a tropical rainforest, an orchid sways seductively. Its glistening petals tremble in anticipation, inviting a passing butterfly to consummate the intimate act of pollination. Succumbing to the allure of the silken flower, the butterfly eagerly flits forward. But as it prepares to alight, the exotic bloom abruptly transforms. Delicate leaves contort into dagger-like forelegs, seizing the bug’s fragile wings. Before the butterfly can comprehend its fate, its head is devoured, crushed between the powerful jaws of the stealthy orchid mantis.. Orchid Mantis lures you into a fragrant illusion. Juicy pear, rich rose and heady jasmine entwine with basil and ylang to suggest the intense scent of orchids. This vintage style is set against the backdrop of a humid rainforest evoked by patchouli, moss, sandalwood and vetiver. An enduring musk serves as a reminder that beauty can also be beastly..

listings.rawTitle: Beaver Maple Edition 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Sun-drenched spring air infuses the tangle of timbers the beavers call home, inviting the family to venture from their cozy den. A sparse winter diet of dry buds and twigs gives way to a juicy salad of fresh waterlilies and leaves. The drive to build is awakened and soon the industrious carpenters are hard at work. Yet over the rustle of branches and the slapping of tails on wet mud, a hammering is heard. In a nearby maple forest, farmers tap thick trunks, creating channels through which sugar-laden sap can flow. Unfazed, the beavers toil on. In tandem they work, the beavers crafting lodges while farmers harvest sweet sap, guiding it to a sugar shack where alchemy will transform it to a rich, golden syrup.. Evoking the onset of spring, Zoologist Beaver Maple Edition combines fresh florals with the delightful sweetness of cocoa-infused maple syrup. Within smoky woods laced with earthy vetiver and patchouli, castoreum and vanilla offer a cozy haven. Like a carefully-crafted lodge of a beaver family, this scent offers warmth while hinting at hidden depths..

From the profound darkness of the bush, a magnificent bonfire burns. Like a guardian the fire protects, holding back the wilderness beyond. The fragrance opens with clove (Madagascar) and pink pepper (South Africa), reminiscent of bright embers dancing on the fire. It heats into a heart of comforting vanilla (Madagascar) and resinous myrrh (Ethiopia), deepening into sensuous opoponax (Somalia) and sandalwood (Somalia).. Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

A forest oasis shrouded by hazy mists. This fragrance starts with the piney sparkle of lentiscus (Morocco) and olibanum (Somalia). The fresh floral heart of neroli (Morocco) and rose (Morocco) is further enhanced by watery violet leaves (Egypt), reminiscent of cucumber and melon, with woody cedarwood Atlas (Morocco) at the base.. Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

The sun rises, flooding the great expanses of the plains, gracing the wilderness with a wash of pure light. The sky is clear. The air is fresh.. The fragrance opens with a luminous burst of citrus: tangerine (South Africa) and blood orange (South Africa). A bright heart of enveloping orange flower (Morocco) and zesty ginger (Nigeria) is supported by a woody base of cedarwood Atlas (Morocco).. Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

On a hot, dry terrain, through the cracks of rocks, enigmatic flowers flourish. Every now and then, great beauty requires great contrasts. The fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of orange (South Africa) and zesty ginger (Nigeria), followed by a complex floral heart of rich rose (Morocco), powdery iris (Ivory Coast) reminiscent of sand swirling below the flowers, and bright chamomile (Egypt). It finishes with a narcotic base of sensual sandalwood (Somalia) and creamy vanilla (Madagascar).. Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

An olfactory interpretation of a Saharan oasis at twilight. This fragrance opens with rich tart notes of North African karkade (an hibiscus infusion/tea) blended with opulent pomegranate jam and minty buchu (South Africa). At its heart, floral hibiscus petals bloom alongside creamy vanilla (Madagascar) and rich floral ylang-ylang (Comoros). The base of cedarwood Atlas (Morocco) and wisps of oud smoke leaves a seductive trail that's spellbinding.. Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

This fragrance is a tribute to the beauty of Madagascan vanilla — one of the finest vanillas in the world. Mafonja means “intense” (as in power or strength) in Malagasy.. It opens with a breath of fleur de sel, evoking salt-kissed skin. A soft heat follows, as cinnamon, pink pepper (Mauritius), and nutmeg wrap the senses in warmth. Ylang-ylang (Comoros) lends a creamy, luminous floral note. As the scent deepens, a darker story unfolds: resinous myrrh (Somalia) and olibanum (Somalia) melt into dark amber.. Réserve en Afrique eaux de parfum feature responsibly sourced naturals, and are free from parabens, phthalates, UV filters and colorants. Their natural alcohol base is derived from beetroots, and they are a PETA-listed vegan & cruelty-free brand. .

A protective herbal fragrance to ground and shield you as you move through the world. The scent opens with a refreshing burst of watermint, peppermint, parsley and coriander — cleansing and cooling like taking a deep breath in nature. Its heart unfolds into comforting notes of sage, rosemary, cardamom and basil, known for their restorative properties and connection to healing traditions. Grounding oak moss, cedar and tree moss form the base, anchoring you with a sense of rootedness..

Grounding oak moss, cedar and tree moss form the base, anchoring you with a sense of rootedness..

Order creates a serene space for reflection, with top notes of hay and white tea that open the mind. The airy plushness of a lilac/mimosa accord adds support, while the warm heart of Himalayan honey and clove brings comfort. Finally, a base of tonka bean and vanilla wraps the fragrance in soothing, cosy warmth. Perfect for mindfulness and calm..

Energy is a dynamic blend designed to support alertness and focus. A vibrant citrus opening of bergamot and grapefruit refreshes the senses, followed by a floral heart of orange blossom and neroli. Indonesian patchouli and cedarwood provide a grounding depth, making this fragrance ideal for those needing sustained resilience..

Focus opens with sharp, spicy cardamom, elemi and black pepper to invigorate. The middle layer combines earthy nagarmotha with floral ylang-ylang for balance, while the base of sandalwood and benzoin adds a warm, grounding finish. Designed for environments where mental clarity is essential..

Damask rose given a lift with smell-kin geranium and bright eucalyptus. Crafted to soothe and centre, Balance harnesses the earthy warmth of saffron and cedarwood to reconnect with calm during demanding moments..

Expression channels the raw, revitalising energy of a forest running down to the sea. Notes of oakmoss and clove awaken the senses, while cedarwood and patchouli foster meditative clarity. Piny hinoki brings a calming depth, perfect for grounding and focus..

This eau de cologne combines two materials that bring out the best in each other: vanilla and saffron. Vanilla’s creamy sweetness hugs spicy saffron’s honeyed earthiness in all the right places. The drydown reveals a fruity flair for added playfulness..

A sheer yet sumptuous sandalwood, Sandalo is frisked up with lime and black pepper, and deepened with cypress and patchouli. This eau de toilette has 90% natural ingredients and is part of the Granado Layering Collection, either to be used alone or combined with other fragrances. Free of dyes and animal ingredients. .

Of Brazilian origin, tonka bean has a dusty almond aroma profile with nuances of vanilla and hay, bringing a comfortable gourmand touch to fragrances. In this interpretation, Tonka explores the material’s amber and creamy side, which combined with coconut and woody notes, results in a cozy, skin-snuggling scent. This eau de toilette has 90% natural ingredients and is part of the Granado Layering Collection. These perfumes can be worn as base notes, either used alone or combined with other fragrances..

Patchouli eau de toilette contains 88% natural ingredients, highlighting the green, earthy woodiness of this classic perfume material. This is a charmingly rustic interpretation of patchouli, with warming nutmeg and cardamom offsetting the crisp aromatics of lavender and geranium. Part of the Granado Layering Collection, Patchouli can be worn as a base note with other perfumes, as well as on its own. Free of dyes and animal ingredients..

This is a beautifully-executed balance between dense, rich materials and a sheer, relaxed interpretation. Oud, unusually sourced from Brazil, sits easily with cedar, guaiac, patchouli and sandalwood, harmonising with spicy notes of cardamom and black pepper. With 92% ingredients of natural origin, the fragrance stays true to its structure, even as a lighter eau de cologne formulation. Free of dyes and animal ingredients..

With 92% natural origin ingredients, Figo shows up ready to celebrate the fig in the wild. This eau de cologne represents the sheer green “wheee!” of fresh fig, with its unique combo of milky sap and woody notes nestling among the aroma of leaves from this “Tree of Life”. Guaiacwood and amber round out the composition. Free of dyes and animal ingredients..
A smiling vanilla that draws its character from contrasts: the bright twang of apple rubbing up against the mellow plushness of tolu balsam, with its beautiful blur of honey and balsamic wood..

You emerge from a Siberian pine forest to discover a treat: ripe raspberries growing in abundance in the brambles. In one of those sacred moments of serendipity, the smell of the rose you’re playfully wearing as a boutonnière swirls in the air with the snap of the evergreen trees and the tart syrup-sweetness of the raspberries. .

A tribute to the perfumer’s roots, Oued 48 is an ode to the city of perfumer’s ancestors — Oued Rhiou in Algeria’s territory 48 — and to the soul of the Algerian people. Almond, sweetly nutty, recalls the kalb el louz pastries of his aunts. Neroli and orange blossom conjures the orange trees of his father’s garden, while the vanilla base, warm and comforting, embodies the generosity of Algeria. Musk al ghazal, a musk grain infusion in sandalwood oil that recreates the scent of deer musk, evokes the village elders, their clothing permeated with the rich aroma. Oued 48 is a personal fragrance, carrying memory, tradition and light..

A night at the museum: locked in with old oil paintings, caveman dioramas, polished parquet floors and upholstered leather benches. Two different ouds, Trat and Prachin, intertwine in an insinuating suggestion of leather, canvas, minerals and exhaled breath. A frothy mint tea note sharpens up the edges..

A juicy, decadent take on tropical fruits, flowers and woods. Inspired by a modernist garden in the old city of Mêrida, Yucatán. The balmy air fills with the heady scent of champaca orchids, ripe guava, fresh ginger, jasmine sambac, Mexican vanilla and mahogany. A spritz of paradise..

“Udbaha” means “marriage” in Bangla, and this extrait references the Bangladeshi Holud Night celebration before the wedding. The festival is decorated with marigolds, roses and tuberoses. The aromas of festival sweets and treats fill the air: sugar, nuts, cardamom and saffron, mingling with oranges, pineapple and ripe mangoes. A spicy/earthy paste of turmeric and fenugreek is applied to the bride and groom’s body, enhanced by warm amber. And summoning the ceremonial application of henna, Bengal oud and oakmoss weaves a funky green trail through the proceedings. A deep and joyful perfume..

The name Pushpak comes from the Sanskrit for “season of flowers”, and this extrait is inspired by the essence of first love. Love’s first touch is summoned with notes of white champaca and osmanthus absolute, with fruity notes of peach and apricot. The warmth of a first hug is suggested by the glow of vanilla and amber, with tonka bean absolute and Thai oud deepening the experience. A tender whisper of powdery musk remains delicately present throughout..

Inspired by the mythical nectar of the gods, Ambrosia opens with the sweet, delicate notes of plumeria and mango, layered with the lush richness of peach, lychee, and coconut. The heart reveals the creamy depth of heliotrope, musk, and guava, while wafts of French orris, Mysore and Sri Lankan sandalwood, Indian tuberose and vintage Ethiopian civet evoke a divine atmosphere—capturing the essence of heavenly indulgence..

listings.rawTitle: Tiger Rouge 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Tiger Rouge summons the mythical Red Tiger, embodying the soul of the Indian wilderness. Fierce black pepper, pimento and paprika contrast with blood orange and lemon myrtle, with cinnamon and cloves weaving through the landscape. Muscular Hainan oud and Indian vetiver put meat on the bones, while rose, cherry and pomegranate add bright, voluptuous beauty..

listings.rawTitle: Ember Shaan 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: “Shaan” is a Sanskrit name meaning greatness and majesty. The perfumer intertwines the name with the legend of the Egyptian pharaoh Thutmose, the conquering leader whose final battle was foretold by the oracles. Ember Shaan is a fragrance that shifts and evolves, reflecting the concept of victory intertwined with sorrow. With a variety of ouds and frankincenses, this extrait explores how a bright fire fades into a smouldering ember, while also deepening into something more profound. Coffee, rose and sandalwood combine their rich effects into an olfactory syrup that infuses the woods, while spicy opoponax and stony gunpowder add punctuation and surprise..

In Sanskrit, “ankura” refers to the sprouting or budding of a plant. It can also signify the seed of an idea or feeling. This uplifting green chypre teases feelings into play with its sunny opening of lemon, bergamot, mint, and the honeyed spice of helichrysum flower. Oakmoss brings shade and mystery, accompanying an earthy blend of patchouli, sage and soil tincture. At its full bloom, the smoky allure of Prachinburi oud fills the soul, turning Ankura into an enchanted forest..

The word “agrani” in Sanskrit means a leader, a trailblazer, and this perfume embodies the life stages of a leader. The opening burst of cherry, almond and saffron symbolises the mesmerising oratory skills that rally the masses. The heart reveals the power of pipe tobacco and leather, expressing a leader’s fearless revolutionary spirit. Enveloping musk and Burmese oud summons the hope they bring during challenging times. The cacao and castoreum base evokes the lasting impact they have on the world, leaving an indelible impression. And finally, the warmth of amber echoes the rays of hope a leader ignites in future generations..

The odd couple of strawberry and Thai oud work out their differences and decide to make a go of it. The initial assault of red berries mellows out into a vanilla almond heart. Herbaceous Thai oud maintains the structure, as well as the appealing weirdness. A gourmand with the Mabra DNA — always natural, always different. .

Fruit punch with emphasis on the PUNCH. Scratchy-sweet pineapple joins forces with crisp green apple and rich mango for a tropical explosion. Before the dust settles, soft almond and coconut infuse the floral and woody haze..

Sous le Soleil is built upon a monoi accord, a traditional Polynesian oil combining heady tiare flower with coconut oil. Radiant creaminess is supplied by magnolia, with Peru balsam underscoring the richness. A perfume summoning bright sun and bare skin..

A tribute to iconic chypre fragrances, 1993 plays with the fruity succulence of peach crashing into dense chocolate, before a final dance-off with earthy, almost minty patchouli. A commanding perfume with serrated edges. Dangerous..

A tribute to the oldest of perfume recipes: incense and resins. Gifted to queens, kings and pharaohs of ancient times, blends of frankincense, myrrh and labdanum conferred status and beauty. Honey Like continues this ritual with its hypnotic blur of muggy myrrh, rich labdanum, feral honey and aromatic incense. Be your own emperor with Honey Like..

Haiti, or Ayiti in Creole, is a vibrant island of culture, resilience and natural beauty nestled in the Caribbean. Nicknamed “the land of mountains”, it boasts dynamic landscapes, where sandy beaches meet lush green mountains and dense rainforests. At the heart of the fragrance, the essence of Haitian vetiver sings out with an earthy and woody warmth. Ayiti is a multifaceted cut emerald, its deep green mysteries flashing from mineral and rooty to smoky and wild..

The Daintree in Australia is the oldest rainforest in the world, whose 180 million years of existence has seen the comings and goings of dinosaurs, ice ages and early humans. It’s a haven for birds, butterflies and bats, and all manner of mosses and ferns — up to 3,000 plant species in all. Daintree Rain Tea pays gentle tribute to this vast nature reserve with a soft and clean blend of balsamic buddha wood, grassy apple-tinged chamomile, and ethereal blue lotus root. An accord of rain-dappled leaves and damp earth lifts up the pleasing rubber nuance supplied by black tea. A haven of a fragrance..

Circa 1900, the cook for the governor of Queensland was in a jam. Asked to rustle up a dessert for last-minute guests, he improvised by cutting up day-old vanilla sponge into squares, then rolling them in chocolate and coconut. The guests were impressed, and “Lord Lamington” went from being a governor to an Australian culinary tradition, and now to a perfume. This edp features the treat’s strawberry, cream, coconut and chocolate, tempered by the crisp aromatics of bergamot and clary sage. The amber drydown lets you know you’re wearing a perfume and not a cake..

Not just a fine addition to luxury white chocolate chip cookies, macadamia is also an intriguing perfume material. Creamy, buttery and velvety, it’s the starting point for this unusual fruity floral. The floral is mimosa, a cute li’l flower that looks innocent, but plays dirty. Don’t let those fluffy yellow pom-poms fool you — mimosa’s got a raunchy side thanks to its dusty niff of overripe honey. Orris doubletracks mimosa’s powderiness, while peach twins mimosa’s earthy sweetness. Mellow sandalwood steers macadamia from a nut to wood. Macadamia? That’s Ms Macadamia to you.. .

A scented fantasy inspired by the Pavlova cake, a traditional Christmas dessert in Australia. Juicy passionfruit and lime contrasts with powdery iris root and the restrained vanilla sweetness of meringue for a softly musky gourmand..

Olive fruit absolute is an unusual material for an amber perfume, and a surprisingly appealing one. It gives a salty, animalic nuance to this sheer blend of cypress and sandalwood, rubbing up nicely against the cinnamon character of Tasmanian mountain pepper..

Vanilla’s in the name, but it’s not the name of the game, here. Instead, vanilla’s a team player with sticky, resinous labdanum, enigmatic orris and dark’n’dirty vertiver and patchouli. White chocolate smooths out the rough edges, while a lick of licorice adds an exclamation point!.
A modern take on a throwback 1970s amber, Hasard Bazar soothes your soul and elevates your spirit with wraparound rose, musk and ambrox. Upholstered sensuality. .

Avant L’Orage, French for “the calm before the storm”, is a perfume poised between action and rest. The sense of suspense is teased by sensual jasmine sambac in a vanilla haze of benzoin and tonka bean. Sandalwood and musk prolong the milky mellow..

Aromatic sage, coriander and black pepper combine with mandarin and lemon for laid-back sophistication. Vetiver and musk give it muscle, while orris provides lean, refined woodiness. . .

The creamy tropical lushness of frangipani and magnolia is sparkled up by crisp juniper berries. Cardamom and pepper punctuates this clean green floral with spice, while ginger adds subtle heat..

Our world is an open playground. Warni Warni symbolizes journeys through cosmopolitan cities, meeting across borders. Here, tea meets orange blossom, with a shared savoury sweetness and a pleasing rubber underlay. Freesia fattens the orange blossom, while cardamom and cedarwood add a spicy backbone. Soft coumarin and musk lend a powdery halo..

A bait-and-switch perfume that starts sharp and clean with juniper and crisp, metallic violet leaves. Then comes the gentle abyss: a faded haze of tobacco, patchouli and leather swirled with white tea and musk. The message might be lost in translation, but all meaning will be found in the fragrance..

Then comes the gentle abyss: a faded haze of tobacco, patchouli and leather swirled with white tea and musk. The message might be lost in translation, but all meaning will be found in the fragrance..

A happy explosion of clean and pretty flowers, with oodles of petals fluttering down from the heavens. Rose and peony team up with their syrupy richness, with a ruffle of freesia, orchid and mandarin tree flower intensifying the effect. Maison Matine devised Poom Poom as a carefree ode to life..

listings.rawTitle: Arashi No Umi | 嵐の海 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Bright apple and peach notes kick off this friendly fruity floral. Freesia, radiant and fresh, unfurls a sweet carpet of florals in its wake: jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang. Sandalwood and musk keep the edges soft.. .

listings.rawTitle: Arashi No Umi | 嵐の海 15 ml EdP
listings.description: Bright apple and peach notes kick off this friendly fruity floral. Freesia, radiant and fresh, unfurls a sweet carpet of florals in its wake: jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang. Sandalwood and musk keep the edges soft.. .

listings.rawTitle: Tu te Calmes | Calm Down 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Even intrepid voyagers exploring outer space to its outer limits need to keep calm at their core, which is where Tu Te Calmes comes in. Inside your spacesuit, you’re smelling a clean blend of fig leaf, cardamom, citrus and cedarwood. Guarantees a safe splashdown..

listings.rawTitle: Tu te Calmes | Calm Down 15 ml EdP
listings.description: Even intrepid voyagers exploring outer space to its outer limits need to keep calm at their core, which is where Tu Te Calmes comes in. Inside your spacesuit, you’re smelling a clean blend of fig leaf, cardamom, citrus and cedarwood. Guarantees a safe splashdown..
A sudsy bubble bath of radiant rose and lychee, sheer yet ebullient. As the veil descends, the effect darkens, with leather and moss toughening up the suds into a floral amber..

Perfumer: Chris Maurice . A smell-good-like-you-feel-good perfume, reminiscent of carefree hangouts with friends powered by “herbal inhalants”. Mainstream is a beautifully modulated cannabis fragrance, its grapefruit and lime kick-off nicely balanced by the long guaiac wood, patchouli and vetiver fadeout. .

Rose Riot is a tribute to those who dare to challenge the traditional. Saffron and pink pepper ignite a sensual rebellion in a symphony of spice and intensity. Jasmine, rose, amber, vanilla, patchouli, and sandalwood form the rebellious alliance that underscores Rose Riot. This isn’t your average bouquet; it’s a provocative fusion that defies the norm, leaving an indelible mark..

Wormwood, green cardamom, and saffron create a bold composition that combines the longing for adventure with the comfort of a campfire. Leather, oud, sandalwood, amber and white musk unite to conjure the allure of glowing embers..

Rare mizunara oak, used in Japanese whisky barrels, imparts an unusual sandalwood/pineapple undertone to the “water of life” maturing within. This eau de parfum blends the effect of mizunara oaked whisky with the furry, malty smell of chestnut for a moreish, warm experience. Don’t be fooled by the shape of the bottle — this whisky is only for spritzing, not sipping! . . . In only this life, let me drink up. And in lives to come, I'll be perfectly content as a bug, a bird. - Ōtomo no Tabito . この世にし 楽しくあらば 来む世には 虫に鳥にも 我らはなりなむ - 大伴旅人 . .

A green and lightly gourmand interpretation of pho, Vietnam's national dish. This fragrance mirrors the dish's main ingredients, echoes the warm blend of spices, and weaves in hints of fresh herbs. The top notes brim with cilantro and basil, which slowly reveal anise and charred ginger. A touch of patchouli imparts a hint of umami richness. While not a literal translation, Pho Breakfast invites you to savour its symphony of aromas and tastes. .

This elixir was inspired by the spirit of the celestial heavens. Solar florals, including lily of the valley, neroli, ylang-ylang and mimosa, swirl their sunshine around all within sniffing distance. Day turns to night with the added bitterness of frankincense and juniper wood. Caelestis is a scent that evokes the purity of a clear morning, the promise of a new day, and the boundless freedom of the night sky. .

Looking for a 10-tonne chocolate covered cherry? A Black Forest gateau the size of a skyscraper? You’ve come to the right place. Rubeus has got you covered — in truckloads of dark chocolate, cherry, raspberry, nougat and vanilla cream. A cheeky splash of oud heightens the furry burnt twang built into the cocoa. Life is a meal to be shared — and you’re the dessert! .

Nocturne is a startling coming-together of unusual elements: red wine, leather, roasted coffee and pistachio. Blackcurrant — bright, acrid and somewhat minty — lends a whiff of petrol when combined with oud. Nocturne’s effect is rich, green, dark and weird. .

Delirium is a voluptuous bouquet of tropical abandon: decadent gardenia, heady jasmine, honeyed champaca, ripe narcissus, creamy frangipani and delicate white lotus. Blurring the lines between reality and fantasy, every breath is an addictive journey into the blissful unknown. With Delirium, the wearer becomes the dreamer and the dream, lost in a world where anything is possible. .

This elixir is a complex expression of the spirit of duality. Cruelle is a perfume of contrasts, a potion that embodies both beauty and danger, sweetness and venom. Tender violet and mouth-watering blackberry compel you deep into the heart of tobacco and frankincense, with the purple haze intensified by plum and iris root. Resinous labdanum and oud add to the mystery, which includes a provocative hint of fresh rubber tyres. With Cruelle, the wearer is both the predator and the prey, a reminder that every beauty conceals darkness. .

Playground conjures the bracing nothing of cold air: crisp, clean, marine. A transparent but present blend of bergamot, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley, lightly fluffed with cashmere wood and musk. Honeydew melon lends its cool sweet flesh to this oceanic fantasy..

listings.rawTitle: Moonlight Samurai | 月光サムライ 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Summer grass— all that remains, of a brave warrior’s dream - Matsuo Bashō . 夏草や 兵どもが 夢の跡. - 松尾芭蕉. The initial salvo of ashy leather blooms into boozy life with the help of sake. Cedarwood and the flash of a samurai’s sword lend spice and metal to this distinctive eau de parfum. . .

Alone, in silence— the bamboo shoot becomes a bamboo - Santōka Taneda . ひとりひっそり 竹の子 竹になる . A tangled forest of muggy green bamboo. An alluring haze of cut grass and transparent violet drifts across this warm green delight. . .

The blossom-viewing kimono— disrobed, I'm entwined in a sea of sashes . - Hisajo Sugita . An ode to magnolia in all of its nuances — radiant and creamy with inflections of verbena honey and distant violet. Rich and sweetly voluptuous, Kimono swathes you in silky ripe florals. .

listings.rawTitle: Tokyo Nights | ナイト 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Sharing one umbrella— the person more in love gets wet - Keisanjin . 相合い傘 濡れてる方が 惚れている . Mouth-watering jammy plum falls ahhhhhhh into the arms of faintly-smoked tobacco. There’s a delicious illusion of frangipane, which hovers Tokyo Nights over the tantalising nexus of smell and taste. .

This eau de parfum pays homage to the city of Da Lat, a haven of serenity in central Vietnam. With its lush pine forests and year-round idyllic weather, Da Lat draws visitors seeking inner peace. At its core, Da Lat EDP is a tender rose scent that unfolds like a love letter, its pages filled with references to peony and magnolia. A red wine accord lends supple body, while cypriol and musk adds some welcome dirt to the drydown. .

listings.rawTitle: Sakura Snow | 桜吹雪 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Snow falls on snow— and remains silent - Santōka Taneda . 雪へ雪 ふるしづけさに をる. - 種田山頭火. Lily of the valley, sunny and sharp, is rendered rounded and suave with a cushion of white musk. The effect is a blizzard of innocent florals..

listings.rawTitle: Strawberry Mochi | いちご大福 50 ml EdP
listings.description: The scent of rice, fills my empty stomach, the bright sun - Kobayashi Issa . 稲の香の すき腹に入む 日影哉. - 小林一茶. Sticky rice and earthy-sweet red bean paste combine in an aroma profile reminiscent of popcorn. An understated strawberry permeates this comforting gourmand, enriched by vanilla and a touch of brown sugar..

listings.rawTitle: Matcha Soft Serve | 抹茶ソフト 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Even the clams Keep their mouths shut In this heat - Matsuo Bashō . 蛤の ふたみにわかれ 行く秋ぞ. - 松尾芭蕉. A friendly blend that’s a bridge between the vegetal umami of matcha and the milky nuzzle of warm clean skin. Green tea dances with vanilla and waffle cone in this gentle gourmand..

This eau de parfum honours Vietnam's signature brew. Crafted from dark-roasted Robusta beans, which exude a bold, caramel-chocolate richness and a pronounced bitterness, it harmonizes deliciously with creamy condensed milk. Topped with ice, it becomes the iconic drink known as "Cà Phê Sữa Đá", the perfect way to start the day for most Vietnamese. This perfume interpretation is such an uncanny smell hologram, you won’t know whether to sniff or swallow! .

A tribute to Vietnam's cultural symbol of livelihood — the white jasmine rice. Found at nearly every Vietnamese meal, the humble bowl of rice has nurtured generations. This eau de parfum presents a subtly sweet aroma, harmonizing gentle softness with the rice nuttiness. Pandan, with its vanilla and hazelnut profile, brings out a snuggly facet of powdery/clean orris. White musk and tonka beans make everything huggable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Angel Dust Extrait De Parfum 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The heightened version of Angel Dust, Fugazzi’s epic symphony of cashmeran and amber. Here, an overdose of cashmeran and amber gives the feeling of swimming through velvet. At 50% perfume oil, Angel Dust extrait is a muffled cry of ecstasy. . .

Inspired by the energy of Ipanema Beach, Brazil’s soul, bottled..

Parfum 1 is a bold blend of bright and dark fruits, made mysterious by patchouli and cedarwood. The fresh top notes of citrus and blackcurrant are insinuating, gracefully riding a woody wave of sandalwood and musk. The effect is leathery, with a faint kiss of apple pie..

All work, all play. Workaholic bends the rules for the ambitious ones who want to smell like the success they are. The powerful appeal of white musk, Australian sandalwood, coffee and amber singles out future Masters of the Universe, whoever and whatever they may be. .

listings.rawTitle: Saint Remy 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: After the famously troubled artist Vincent Van Gogh cut off his left ear, he admitted himself to an asylum in St Remy in Provence. This extrait is an olfactory portrait of a haunting painting of irises Van Gogh made during his recovery. The Irises depicts a tangle of purple-blue flowers, their stems rippling ribbons of green. The artwork’s dark vibrancy is echoed in the perfume, which explores the dry, leather aspect of iris root. Juniper and ginger keep the focus sharp at the top, before the whole picture emerges revealing amber, vetiver and woods..

Fugazzi founder Bram Niessink was inspired to create this crisp, refreshing fragrance during a stay in Bali. Thirsty opens with juicy apple, green galbanum, airy bluebell, and the clean snap of bamboo. At its heart, soft jasmine, rose, neroli, and ripe fig add a cool, floral brightness. As it settles, grounding notes of cedarwood, warm amber, and smooth musk leave a light, lingering trail — like dew on skin after a cool morning swim. What happens in Bali, stays in Bali, but you can get Thirsty anywhere..

listings.rawTitle: Cash Flower 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The scent fuses the intoxicating aroma of roses with a hint of spicy allure and depth from warm pepper notes. Cash Flower encapsulates the essence of success and allure embodied by this majestic flower. . As the perfume graces your skin, it becomes even more indulgent and grandiose. Luxurious tints of cashmere and amber create a velvety texture, enveloping you in a world of utmost opulence. Musk and sandalwood add a touch of sensuality, intensifying the fragrance's allure and leaving an unforgettable impression. .

listings.rawTitle: In Love With the Cocos 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: This soft tropical skin scent opens with a burst of bright bergamot and lemon zest, setting the stage for a heart of creamy jasmine and coconut water. Floral notes of rose, neroli, orange blossom and geranium unfold beneath, adding a delicate, sunlit richness. As the sun sets, warm amber, sensual musk and airy ambrette create a lingering finish — like sunset on your favourite island..

listings.rawTitle: Kawa Karda Extrait 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Kawa Karda's perfumer Marie Salamagne calls it “a dialogue between black and white, light and shadow”. This coffee and cardamom extrait (crafted at 40%) opens on a dry, almost wheaty earthiness, until tarry black coffee asserts itself. Before you’re begging for mercy, the spicy lilt of cardamom adds light to the shadow. Like the ristretto rounding off the first pleasures of the evening, KK’s thick syrupy sweetness primes you for indulgences to come. .

listings.rawTitle: Cocoa Kimiya Extrait 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: For Cocoa Kimiya, perfumer Marie Salamagne was inspired by the French artist Pierre Soulages’ walnut stain paintings. Soulages saw light as a work material, allowing his signature black to emerge from darkness and into brightness, becoming a luminous colour. Cocoa Kimiya reverses that transition, with a rum fudge opening shadowing into cardamom, then blackening into cocoa. “Kimiya” comes from the Arabic word for alchemy, which is much in evidence in the transformative magic of this extrait. .

As a material, patchouli is earthy and dry, its initial hit of deep fruitiness billowing out to a dark, leathery haze tinged with chocolate. In Double Patchouli, these attributes are heightened by the use of Indonesian patchouli harvested from two different terroirs, resulting in a surround sound effect infused with amber and musk. Double Patchouli’s journey on the skin has many stops, from hot buttered rum, to warm leather, to herbaceous dust, before arriving at its destination of enveloping mystery..

listings.rawTitle: 403 Myrrh Shadow 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: You’re being followed by a myrrh shadow. A shadow that traces your outline, then embellishes with enigmatic depth. This intriguing extrait de parfum flirts with myrrh’s dark charm, tickling its dusty delights with peppery cedarwood, spicy akigalawood and earthy patchouli. The zesty sparkle of bitter citrus succumbs to an enveloping cloud of benzoin and musk as the shadow lengthens, leaving behind an echo of the fascinating person everyone longs to meet again soon. .

listings.rawTitle: 403 Myrrh Shadow 15 ml Extrait de Parfum

From LO’s Parfum Intense collection, this is an amber with the darkness turned up to 11. There’s no white space here, just expensive raw materials piled high. Its vibrant opening with fruity notes is enriched by the bitterness of coffee, deepening into a powerful chorus of rose, iris, jasmine and lily of the valley. And this valley is a deep one, a soft black expanse of leather, nagarmotha and patchouli, cushioned by a dirtier-than-usual amber..

listings.rawTitle: Oud in White 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A battle royale between jasmine and oud, where everyone’s a winner. Oud in White opens on a zest of pear, ginger, and raspberry, before revealing its true intentions with jasmine sambac’s shocking sensuality. Peachy osmanthus fleshes out the fleshiness, and resinous labdanum and milky sandalwood makes the slide into leathery Cambodian oud irresistible. Between the twinned forces of indolic jasmine and barnyardy oud, this one’s for connoisseurs of the finer side of skank..

Delulu is a soft-focus dream sequence in oversaturated colours, swirling across a soundtrack of shoegaze and nineties/noughties indie.This particular sequence follows childhood into adolescence: a favourite toy, a pack of crayons, a melted sweet in your jeans pocket, a bite of berry pie, a long sunny day doing nothing. There’s fizzy cedrat and the salty-fresh friction of tart rhubarb against rooty vetiver. Like all dreams, things get weird: a niff of rosy plastic and smoky incense. Yesterday is a place you can never visit again, but it’s still an escape from tomorrow. That’s Delulu.. Delulu bottle caps are hand made from memories, specifically a nostalgic jumble of plastic beach toys captured in epoxy resin. . Master perfumer David Chieze .

A meditation on untamed nature, lost marshes, primeval fires. A dusky oud softened by labdamum and tonka, sharpened by rhubarb and saffron, toughened by tar and smoke..

Perfumer: Cyrill Rolland. An interpretation of the winter solstice brightening into spring, the whisper of growth beneath the melting snow. The cold twang of grapefruit sparks against the heat of Szechuan pepper, while geranium’s complex rosy-minty profile deepens the rawness of hemp, vetiver and leather. .

The scent of damp earth after a spring rain — heavy, alive, pulsating with the power of rebirth. This is a different kind of aquatic fragrance, one that plants you deep in the roots of a fertile forest. Akigalawood, with its peppery-oudy profile derived from patchouli, joins forces with juicy raspberry and fig leaves to create an abundant, life-affirming scent..

A floral abundance of radiant orange blossom and lily-of-the-valley, given extra oomph by sultry jasmine sambac. An incredibly holographic progression from dewy green to heady roawr, aided and abetted by musk and guiacwood. .

Contrary to Western expectations, sumo wrestlers rikishi 力士 exude an elegant scent which incorporates a traditional hair oil called bintsuke. This perfume conjures bintsuke with an aromatic eucalyptus and anise opening, before violet and heliotrope create a powdery smellscape, turning musky with the addition of patchouli and sandalwood. This eau de parfum represents a powerful sumo wrestler with a gentle, incense-like warmth. .

Yawahada is a perfume that triggers the unconscious, a sensual scent inspired by Yasunari Kawabataʼs novel, "The House of the Sleeping Beauties" A milky cloud of pear and rice powder float the warming base of amber and sandalwood enticingly around you — and around anyone else in your orbit. .
The contrast of sugary milk and soft mint, conjuring fluffy white clouds in a hot summer sky..

In Japan, yuzu is used like lemons, adding freshness and acidity to dishes. This zippy citrus fragrance expresses everything about yuzu, from the astringency of its peel to the sweet and sour taste of the pulp. An accord of bergamot and orange bolsters the yuzu, while thyme adds herbal intrigue. .

An olfactory rendition of the iconic Japanese peach もも. From the opening salvo of green calling forth the unripe fruit, this eau de parfum gradually matures to the peach’s full sweetness and delicacy, with creamy sandalwood and musk folding in a velvety accord. The voluptuousness of tuberose suggests the sensuality hidden deep within. .

Inspired by shards of sunlight streaming through the trees, Shaft of Light summons warmth and well-being. In this case, the light is shining down upon grapefruit and lemon trees, and creamy white florals including magnolia and gardenia. Warm tones of sandalwood, patchouli, and oakmoss call forth nature's life-affirming power. .

listings.rawTitle: ほうじ茶 Hojicha (Roasted Green Tea) 50 ml EdP
listings.description: An interpretation of hōjicha ほうじ茶 (roasted green tea), a popular tea in Japan. The scent combines the roasted crispness of brewed tea leaves with the creaminess of steaming milk. Accents of gyokuro (high-grade green tea) and seaweed create a beguiling depth. .

Ramune is a traditional Japanese soda pop sold in a pale blue glass bottle sealed with a marble. The drink is evocative of Japanese summer festivals, carefree times illuminated by dreamy paper lanterns. This eau de parfum starts with the clear notes of lemon, aldehydes and mint, followed by gentle rose, muguet and magnolia, before drifting into musk and vanilla. .

A nostalgic soap scent that’s fresh and creamy, based on the tissue thin, dissolving paper soap available in Japan. Lavender and aldehydes soften into rose, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley, conjuring vintage sudsiness. .

listings.rawTitle: 恋雨 Koiame (It's Raining Love) 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Mandarin and cassis spill out of this cornucopia of dew-dappled fruity florals. Soft-focus peach, magnolia, violet and jasmine glow against a gentle base of cedarwood and musk. .

Japan has a rainy season from June to July, called “tsuyu.” Embodying tsuyu is hydrangea, blooming in the gentle rain. Here, hyacinth and violet entwine with the fresh floral scent of jasmine and iris, with an undertone of humidity and the smell of soil. .

A beautifully bittersweet dance between honey and fresh lemon. A surprising herbal nuance undercuts the syrupiness of the honey, with undertones of rose and jasmine adding gentle cushioning. Sandalwood and musk lend subtle structure. .

listings.rawTitle: Hanamizake (Watching Sakura & Drinking Sake) 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Hanamizake refers to drinking Japanese sake underneath the cherry blossom trees while petals slowly flutter into your cup. The aroma of cherry blossoms and ginjo sake dances tipsily into the last musk note, summoning this serene hanami (cherry blossom viewing) experience. .

The so-called “Hanamachi” (花街 literally “flower town”) was traditionally the area where geishas lived and worked. This intriguing perfume evokes the allure of an “oiran”, the highest-ranking courtesan, expressing the contradictory charms of innocence and worldliness. Iris adds ravishing powdery notes to a bouquet of rose and violet. The base of sensual agarwood creates a beautiful harmony suggesting bygone decadence. .

Hakka is Japanese mint, which contains a higher concentration of menthol than the more familiar peppermint. This eau de parfum is an irresistible call and response between leafy green hakka, and the clear-as-a-bell appeal of jasmine, lily and lotus. White musk softly sustains this delicate, revivifying experience. Note: you may feel a cooling sensation from the minty menthol when applying on skin. .

A poetic coffee perfume, conjuring the charms of a mid-century coffee shop in the Showa era. The contrast of the bitterness of roasted coffee beans and the sweetness of orange blossom supplies the sparkle, before the caramalised drydown of musky vanilla brings the mmmmm! .

A refined agarwood inspired by the scent of Japanese temples. The combination of incense with the sheer sweetness of orange peel gives this eau de parfum an elegant touch. The presence of natural woody notes such as cedarwood and patchouli with the spicy cinnamon accent turns this into a sophisticated oud with a mysterious allure. .

This is the Bold version of Velvet — a powerful, room-filling rendition of its Balanced counterpart, infused with deep, dark notes that’ll make your presence known. Also try Velvet | Personal and Velvet | Balanced & Expressive..

This is the Balanced & Expressive version of Velvet, with a noticeable projection that’ll make a mark, not a scene. Also try Velvet | Personal and Velvet | Bold. .

This is the Bold version of Juice, a powerful, room-filling rendition of its Balanced counterpart, infused with deep, dark notes that’ll make your presence known.
