listings.rawTitle: Penguin (Limited Edition) 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Emperors they may be, but when a massive cyclone unleashes its merciless austral winds, the colony of penguins bow to its power. It's from such extremes that the male penguin must guard his precious bundle. Passed tenderly from mother to father, the egg is their shared purpose. She embarks on a perilous odyssey to the sea for food. He begins his own monotonous march, packed tightly in a circle of trudging penguins. So intent is he on protecting his egg that even the dazzling aurora australis against a lonely night sky escapes his notice. . Zoologist Penguin opens with saffron caught upon a salty blast of crisp antarctic air. Against the cool desolation, anticipation glimmers as lively aromas of pink pepper and sea moss swirl over musks, suede and sandalwood. Brace yourself for a vibrant scent that Is always invigorating, a reminder of nature’s harsh reality in a welcome blast.. Perfumer: Chiaki Nomura .

An olfactive reconstruction of 17th century Viceregal Mexico: the mineral notes of terra cotta tile floors and stucco walls, the wooden beams and gilded altars give way to a heart of of spiced cacao. In the background, the incense from the church mixes with the kitchen spices, creating an evocative Baroque concoction between heaven and earth. Notes include: Cocoa absolute, Mexican vanilla, cinnamon, and a smoked chili infusion..

Beyond masculine, somehow transcending gender. With citrus bursts of grapefruit and bergamot marrying with rose, vetiver and violet leaf the layers reveal facets that are sometimes smoky, sometimes leathered, sometimes spicy. A kaleidoscope of nuances within every drop, it really packs a punch! .

Perfumer: Chris Maurice . Sensual, refined and compelling this fruity rose opens with crisp, succulent green apple blended with spicy pink pepper and lush blackcurrant. A honeyed bouquet of jasmine and tuberose enriches the delectable pink rose for a sophisticated effect. The tenacious golden base of amber, musk and vanilla indulges the floral fruits for a bold and amplified diffusion. . .

Perfumer: Chris Maurice . Nothing if not sensually refreshing. A sparkling aromatic warmth created by juniper, bergamot and grapefruit is paired with bright floral marigold, sweet musk and the boozy tones of tequila for a luminous edge. Think golden hour sundowners in one truly seductive scent..

listings.rawTitle: Passion Figuier 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Verdant juicy fig and jasmine blend to conjure the Garden of Eden and stir feelings of desire and temptation. Sparkling spiced pink pepper highlights the white floral tones transporting you to hazy days under Provencal fig trees. The sharp herbaceous artemisia lends intense green nuances for refreshing yet seductive tones. .

A tantalizingly tropical fragrance. With evocative zesty mandarin orange, blackcurrant and peach marrying with a gentle blend of white florals. The creamy notes of vanilla and caramel join in the final with a woody note of cedar and white musk. Like a warming Mediterranean breeze sweeping across your face as you take in the golden hour. .

Perfume: Sidonie Lancesseur. A roasty-toasty nose of matcha tea is your entry point to this delightful essay on the joys of the gently-reviving hot beverage. The nutty bitterness is supported by a beautifully calibrated blur of basil, peppermint, geranium and cedar. .

Perfumer: Nicolas Beaulieu. Open a door, follow the light and let yourself be guided through the night. Forbidden, audacious, passionate, escapist, playful or soothing: live your ideal night. A fragrance where the depth of sandalwood and the warmth of bitter cocoa mingle with the comforting light of Marseille soap and cassie flower: an invitation to sensual, reassuring skin-to-skin contact. . Perfumer: Dominique Ropion. An enigmatic leather perfume merged from captivating nuances of tuberose, orange blossom and gardenia. The wild facet of ylang ylang intertwined with the woody notes of patchouli add a sensuous tone. Frankincense and labdanum complete the leather theme. The trail left by the perfume is surprising, narcotic filled by a magnetic elegance..

Perfumer: Angeline Leporini. Drawing on the Kazakh belief in the sacredness of the number 7 this scent holds seven empowering materials. Exotic osmanthus and apricot brings a soft floral sweetness which sits aside gentle warming amber. The reassuring scent of cashmere wood blends in peaceful harmony with balsamic gurjum resin and potent oud for smooth woodier tones. The beautiful allure of soft suede from orris enhanced by rich earthy patchouli leaving behind a sensual diffusion that is aromatic and graceful.. .

The beautiful allure of soft suede from orris enhanced by rich earthy patchouli leaving behind a sensual diffusion that is aromatic and graceful.. .
Step into the bamboo forest with this beautifully refreshing perfume. A new addition to the Molinard’s iconic La Fraîcheur collection..

The women and men in these pages are lovers and brawlers, bullfighters and boxers, soft talkers and hard drinkers. They inhabit dusty Spanish villages and dank, dark brothels. At the heart of these unforgettable characters is a determined and undying passion that pushes them to make extraordinary decisions in the face of fear. Their fates are varied but the outcome is always the same, these are stories that grip you by the throat and don’t let go until you profess your devotion. Seductive and steadfast, this classic is not for the faint of heart but for the full of heart..

listings.rawTitle: A Whiff of Waffle Cone 50 ml EdP
listings.description: More of a Howdtheydoit? Than a Whodunnit? This magical tale will sweep you back to simpler times and envelop you in a warm blanket of nostalgia. At the center of the novel is an ice cream shoppe with mysterious powers. Upon entering, customers are hit with “A Whiff of Waffle Cone” and immediately transported to different periods of their life. Ping-ponging through four generations of rich family history and tender community connections, a narrative emerges that threads a message of hope and togetherness unlike any other. And rather than dipping into an expected sugary sweetness, the melange of voices rings honest and true, making this a highly respected coming-of-age story you’ll want to revisit again and again.. Created in partnership with Salt & Straw, a pioneering ice cream brand based in Portland, Oregon with outposts across the country..

Perfumer: Olivier Cresp. A delicious, shimmering floral from a Maître Olivier. . The perfume is luminous and hypnotic like the moon reflected in the Mediterranean Sea.. Magnolia is resting on velvety woods..

Perfumer: Olivier Cresp. A delicious, shimmering floral from a Maître Olivier. . The perfume is luminous and hypnotic like the moon reflected in the Mediterranean Sea.. Magnolia is resting on velvety woods..

listings.rawTitle: Smoky Soul 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Inspiring and carnal, Smoky Soul features smoked black tea infused with Osmanthus absolute with fruity accents of apricot.. Black tea, extracted with supercritical CO2, is smoked with Java Vetiver essence, which brings out facets of burnt hot wood. Black pepper enhances the spicy and black notes of the tea while a trace of seaweed absolute accentuates the mossy, savory and mineral notes of some Chinese teas..

‘O absent presence, Stella is not here’ . The fifth and final instalment of the Revenants collection draws inspiration from the Elizabethan poet Sir Philip Sidney. In his Sonnet sequence ‘Astrophel and Stella’ Sidney develops and captures the essence of a haunting… the presence of one that is always felt but never seen.. ‘Now I, wit-beaten long by hardest fate, . So dull am, that I cannot look into . The ground of this fierce love and lovely hate, . Then some good body tell me how I do, . Whose presence absence, absent presence is; . Blesst in my curse, and cursed in my bliss.’ .

Perfumer: Miroslav Petkov. A bestial intense animalic amber serving the visceral image of a wild stallion. Patchouli and labdanum harmonise to a rich decadent leather while hits of oriental osmanthus add to the floral sweetness which in turn is balanced by spicy cypriol and vetiver. Stunning and magnificent. .

Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet. Capturing the essence of desert myrrh warmed by the beach. With spicy cinnamon, rich cedar and sweet tangy ambroxan all clarifying and defining the sensational incense. It is a scent of contradiction with amber tones and mineral references that serve a blend that can be peaceful or invigorating. You choose..

Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet. Capturing the essence of desert myrrh warmed by the beach. With spicy cinnamon, rich cedar and sweet tangy ambroxan all clarifying and defining the sensational incense. It is a scent of contradiction with amber tones and mineral references that serve a blend that can be peaceful or invigorating. You choose..

Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet. Sparkling in it’s pure simplicity, evoking the sweet blonde texture of fresh sandalwood shavings and champagne. Sharp and generous rose tones that project confidently. Woody facets are sprinkled with frankincense and sweetened with the bright fruity nuances of red berries..

Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet. Sparkling in it’s pure simplicity, evoking the sweet blonde texture of fresh sandalwood shavings and champagne. Sharp and generous rose tones that project confidently. Woody facets are sprinkled with frankincense and sweetened with the bright fruity nuances of red berries..

Perfumer: Nicolas Beaulieu. Conjuring the complexity of iced absinthe where the balance of heady wormwood and fresh ozonic greenery surrounds violet leaf for a seductive euphoric tone. This is set against a dark aromatic base that is smooth and warming. The head-turning diffusion of sweetened leathers and earthy woods offers a contemporary enticing edge..

Perfumer: Nicolas Beaulieu. Conjuring the complexity of iced absinthe where the balance of heady wormwood and fresh ozonic greenery surrounds violet leaf for a seductive euphoric tone. This is set against a dark aromatic base that is smooth and warming. The head-turning diffusion of sweetened leathers and earthy woods offers a contemporary enticing edge..

Perfumer: Nicolas Beaulieu. The evocative scent of a blooming tubereuse in a smokey room. Like an olfactory photograph of the five petalled sensuous and narcotic white flower. A delightful blend of cassis, tobacco and honeyed vanilla puts the floral tones into light and exotic relief. The natural freshness of galbanum and green leaves gives a viridescent effect that’s rich and inviting..

Perfumer: Nicolas Beaulieu. The evocative scent of a blooming tubereuse in a smokey room. Like an olfactory photograph of the five petalled sensuous and narcotic white flower. A delightful blend of cassis, tobacco and honeyed vanilla puts the floral tones into light and exotic relief. The natural freshness of galbanum and green leaves gives a viridescent effect that’s rich and inviting..

Perfumer: Caroline Dumur. A soft fresh focus on clary sage after a storm, the bright flowering Mediterranean herb full of bright, uplifting tones. With classic fougere materials at the forefront and an artful blend of frankincense, tonka beans and sandalwood swirling in the background the effect is of a herb picked in the company of sweet fresh woods in the sunshine..

Perfumer: Fanny Bal. The transporting scent of gin at a coastal golden hour, a glittering seashore and soft focus horizon. Minimalist fresh fragrant juniper is dosed with olibanum to revitalising effect. While the sparkling spicy tones of pink pepper and mandarin are clean and fresh..

Perfumer: Fanny Bal. The transporting scent of gin at a coastal golden hour, a glittering seashore and soft focus horizon. Minimalist fresh fragrant juniper is dosed with olibanum to revitalising effect. While the sparkling spicy tones of pink pepper and mandarin are clean and fresh..

“One night we found ourselves wandering in the light shining with a full moon and, stopping at contemplating, we felt like smelling a scent of wood and flowers…” [travel notes]. A perfume that captures a moment, an emotion, an image, enveloped in the light of a shining moon.. A fresh and luminous departure of Pink Pepper. Then, an olfactory kaleidoscope comes to life that combines a flowery heart of Magnolia, Jasmine and Rose with a base of Cedarwood Virginia and Sandalwood, softened by Cashmeran, Iso E Super and Musk.. The fusion of flowers and soft woods reveals a surprising, refined and magnetic jus. A celebrative fragrance, emotional, evocative, that captures the magic and poetry of the moon….

This is your fragrant revolution, embrace it! A scent to inspire and spark imagination, where leather meets soft florals and ozonic tones. The saffron brings warmth while violet leaf conjures a suede-like feeling and incense offers a spicy woody nuance. Heads will turn as the delectable and seductive diffusion creates an atmosphere creativity and fortitude..

Heads will turn as the delectable and seductive diffusion creates an atmosphere creativity and fortitude..

Here we have the bountiful beautiful peony, the anointed 'Queen of Flowers'. Pivione Souveraine offers a floral masterpiece in petals that reigns over delicate notes of buttery jasmine and indolic rose. Spicy tones of pink pepper and creamy elemi bring a warmth that is seductive and regal. A shining affair of white florals that lasts and lasts..

The water slips over him as if sliding down a marble rock, sinking into the grooves of his muscles, vanishing into his pores. This is fresh, pure water, with top notes of aldehydes and lemon, a water that washes away the sins of the night and leaves the skin luminous. ​ He feels clean, like a shaving from a cake of soap. It is an ode to the beauty of the male body and to the radiance of the natural self. This perfume offers unrestricted access to the immense outdoors, the forest, with notes of birch leaves, cypress, galbanum and pine at its heart. ​ He is sex, in all its fullness and magnitude, open and erect. Fantasy clings to him like his leather jacket, with suede, musk, and grey amber in the base notes. His belt is fastened with an accord of pepper and spicy-fresh saffron, tangled with a blond suede sensuality on a vanilla bed of tonka bean and iris. ​ This is a man who wants to play, to love, to die and be reborn, again and again. This fragrance is a tribute to tomorrow’s glorious possibilities..

Arabesque takes you on a journey through the enchanting and mystical Middle East by way of flowers, fruits and woods entwined together. Inspired by the most beautifully carved arabesque's of Islamic art. A heart of rose and jasmine absolute dance together to create a sense of well-being and serenity while patchouli and oud transports you to another world..

"A rich fragrance that opens up with a burst of humid basil and crisp galbanum. The green notes give way to luscious and fruity strawberries and raspberries that offer a tartness to the velvety peaches and apricots. The white floral bouquet is big and bold, conjured by layers of tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom and white lilies. This choir of florals lies down on a soft bed of caramelised sandalwood and vanilla, intertwined with milky musks and radiant amber. ".

Olfactory opulance conjures the Palace of Versailles in its heyday when Louis XIV and his Court would amble the Grand Orangery to delight in the flowering orange trees warmed by bonfires. This is a bright orange blossom with a warm, woody background, with notes of orange blossom absolute, pomegranate, honey and firewood smoke..

The sweet freshness of coconut water is infused with biting pink grapefruit zest. These cooling tones are beautifully offset with spicy pink pepper bringing a layered effect to the delectible diffusion. Warm nuances are created with creamy tonka beans which are rounded with the delicious salty sweet vibes from salted caramel. This is balanced by a background of aromatic fern and refreshing and green chlorophyl. All this conjures an olfactory allegory of a powerful white tiger resting on a bed of fresh grass..

listings.rawTitle: Northern Cardinal 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Northern Cardinal, formally Cardinal, is a big bold fragrance, loudly herbaceous with a sparkling citrus tone and a heavy backdrop of oakmoss which serves up a delicious earthy greeness. The vanilla brings warmth, the leather a dark intensity and the clary sage depth. It's like biting into something crisp and juicy while feeling the sun on your face. Cloak yourself in this warm, cheerful perfume, a spark of joy on a bleak winter day..

listings.rawTitle: A Corps Cuivre (Like Copper) (Discontinued) 90 ml EdP
listings.description: A soft sheen dances in the air from a combination of bright sparkling spices of juniper, cinnamon and cloves which conjure up warming tones. These are perfectly balanced with rich amber and create a shimmering copper feel. Carefully crafted metallic aroma chemicals are blended with rum and patchouli to add layers of complexity and depth. A heavenly seductive fragrance that lasts..

"This is Molinard’s 2023 re-issue of their iconic amber fragrance. This new format includes 90ml spray bottle and a 7.5ml roll-on.. Ambre Lumiere is retro amber with a hint of a patisserie counter deliciousness. This curious nuance comes from tolu which brings it's unique roast coffee aroma to the composition. This is combined with a special variety of chocolaty patchouli, sweet vanillic benzoin and creamy honeyed ylang-ylang.".

This creation delivers a diffusion of sweet woods and earthy green tones. It is generous and bountiful in it's layers. Tonka beans and vanilla create a seductive yet subtle gourmond effect while earthy patchouli balances the sweetness. An unusual green note sparkles in the background created by sandalwood and fennel. At the forfront liqorice and anis seed entwine with rich florals to a deliciously spicy fragrant impact.. Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

Inspired by the culture of the vikings; where strength and fortitude are inbuilt Invoking this theme, Northman is sumptuous and green with powerful woody layers. Such spirit is reflected by the use of absinthe and Swedish alder. While balsamic tolu balm, tangy labdanum and green vanilla bring earthy empowering tones. . Perfumer: Alexander Olsson .

"Astrakan conjures the dense apple orchards of Sweden. These Astrakan apples are artfully spiced and sharpened with cinnamon and oranges; while the vanilla, sandalwood and doses of gurjum resin ensure the effct is woody and green rather than warming and christmassy. The diffusion is complex in it's layers and serves a shimmering effect that invokes a sense that you can't get enough. Overall this is a fruity fragrance that is rich, sophisticated and delectable. . Perfumer: Alexander Olsson .

A full bodied fouger with a green leathery focus. Tomato leaves, clary sage and birch tar inject a full freshness effect while warming notes of vanilla and myrrh meld with woody sandalwood and musk. The orris ensures the leatherey effect. This is a testiment to the enduring power and scope of the fouger formular.. Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

listings.rawTitle: Golden Hour 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A soft focus woody, fruity diffusion that is nothing if not seductive. The edible quality is created by caramel and rose while the apple and bergamot are refreshing against the sweetness. These notes are carefully brought together in the warmth of amber. This is gourmond but with nuanced tones of darker sophistication. . Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

A full-on fruity floral goumond. Radiant goosbury and ylang-ylang work in harmony for a delightfully delectible effect. Shavings of sweet woods is created by cedarwood and jasmine which are encased in honeyed amber. A background of vanilla enriches the oriental effect with hints of leather giving a rounded diffusion. . Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

Delivering complex layers of fruits, woods and florals with a leathery background. Bountiful roses and tea-like rosehip fuse creating a shimmering floral effect. While earthy patchouli is balanced with bright tones from orange and raspberry. Musk underlines the edible quality which is enriched by warming amber. Overall the effect is a spiced and leathered rose that makes for a seductive impact. . Perfumer: Alexander Olsson .

listings.rawTitle: Majestic Radiance 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Bright and refreshing with hints of sweetness. Classic cedarwood is paired with smokey inscense with enriching green tones of sandalwood hovering in the background. Gentle doses of castoreum works with beeswax to give a subtle warming effect that balances out the woody tones with a more leathery nuance. . Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

listings.rawTitle: Crown Jewel 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Multifaceted and elusive Crown Jewel can portray cold ouds and warming spices all at once. Indian oud harmonises with sweet saffron and the aromatic refreshing tones of cypriol. Warm nuances are created by amber and vanilla which are layerd and balanced by a background of woody sandalwood and green pine. The effect is oriental and leathery giving a rounded and rich diffusion. . Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

A bright bouquet with a citrus woody focus. Bergamot, mandarin and ginger inject a full freshness effect while sunny floral notes of organge blossom, jasmine and rose meld with velvety notes of milk chocolate. This is an ode to the enigmatic power of white flowers in a rich and edible interpretation.. Perfumer: Sfean J.A. .

listings.rawTitle: Dodo Jackfruit Edition 2023 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The sun sparkled across rippling waves, its morning dance upon the Indian Ocean rousing the dodos from their carefree slumber. Stumbling drunkenly across the forest floor they feasted on overripe fruit where it lay, dropped for them by the lush island paradise that nurtured them. For generations, the predator-free and bountiful shores lulled them into such a state of complacency that their wings grew idle, and flight was lost – even to memory. Ultimately evolution would betray them, but while it lasted, the dodos enjoyed an existence marked by ease and comfort. . In Zoologist Dodo, notes of jackfruit and bergamot border a winding path dappled with aromatic turmeric and pink pepper. Venture along it to the heart of an island forest where hints of powdery orris emerge from beneath a potpourri of lavender, geranium, and orange flower. Soothed by the comforting florals, you’ll soon surrender, sinking into the loam where woody tonka and sandalwood sprout from an earthy base of patchouli and vetiver.. Perfumer: Yves Cassar.

listings.rawTitle: Extrait Blanc 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A scent that is unmistakably sexy. This deliciously obscure gourmond scent conjures empowering luxury. A creative blend of sandalwood and cashmeran is layerd with rice and milky tones to bring rich slightly nutty nuances. This is balanced with sparkling and tangy notes of radiant ginger and pink pepper that offer a refreshing effect on the skin. In turn these blends are softened by delicate floral notes of tuberose and orange blossom. With such rich materials this perfume is unexpectedly delicate yet warming. .

listings.rawTitle: Nilubol นิลุบล (Limited edition) 30 ml Parfum
listings.description: Nilubol (นิลุบล) conjures a magical Thai night under the shimmering purple moon as you witness the enchanting yet fleeting bloom of the blue water lily, or Nymphaea nouchali. Bursts of shiny black currant bud absolute imbue you with a fruity and vibrant energy. The blue water lily absolute and jasmine absolute bring a sweet floral effect, while the orris butter and birch tar balances the sweetness with rich leathery tones. Violet leaf absolute and osmanthus absolute add depth and complexity. Precious ouds are highlighted by refreshing citrus notes and herbal touches and seductive patchouli reflects the earthy romantic nature of the perfume. Overall, you are left serene as the lingering trail of edible hops and warm ambrette seed diffuses around you. .

listings.rawTitle: Krissana (กฤษณา) (Limited edition) 30 ml Parfum
listings.description: Krissana (กฤษณา) is a celebration to oud. Here the perfumer has expertly sourced seven precious ouds from across Thailand. Each region has its own process of cultivation and thus each oud holds its own unique quality and characteristic.The warm embrace of amber adds luxury and sophistication, harmonising with the swirling balsamic and smokey ouds. Delicate flowers like jasmine sambac and rose absolute enhance their elegance. Spices from black pepper to clove and cinnamon balance the bitterness while adding complex nuances to the overall effect. Sandalwood, patchouli, vetiver, benzoin and styrax enrich the composition with green earthy and woody tones..

Loup tells the story of a full moon and a roaming lone wolf. The rugged terrain is reflected in the blended smoky spices and green earthy Malaysian oud. The warm air is conjured by the rich fossilised amber while the camphore and castoreum add to the sense of wild abandon. The patchouli and labdanum lend sweet leather nuances to the animalic diffusion and harnesses the potency of the oud. Hints of wisdom linger in the gentle relaxing lavender while the jasmine brings a vibrant white floral tone that softens the fragrance. .

listings.rawTitle: Patchouly Essential (Discontinued) 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: An ode to that wonderful perfume material and each of its potential nuances (woody, gourmand, earthy, dry and ambery) carefully highlighted with relevant notes.. .

Lush exotic flowers and succulent fruits stand out against the soft tropical woods conjuring the golden-age glamour of the French Riviera. Sweet and green Madagascan vanilla is expertly blended with ambergris to create a playful yet sophisticated effect. . .

listings.rawTitle: Encens de Nuit 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: This is an idyllic effusion of aromatic herbs and the unmistakable scent of frankincense. With shiny citrus notes of orange and bergamot balancing deep rosewood the effect is one of peace and well-being. A perfume to wear in the golden hour. . .

listings.rawTitle: Safran Gourmand 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The enticing quality of sweet saffron blends with notes of milk, almond and vanilla bringing instant warmth and softness. Rich caramel is offset with the suede nuances of sophsiticated sandalwood delivering a delicious and intoxicating fragrance that feels like velvet on the skin. . .

listings.rawTitle: Pomme Amoris 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Dreamy davana and apple blend, delivering swirls of vacation glamour. Sparkling citrus notes are deepend with rich florals from rose to patchouli evoking nights wandering the cobblestone streets of Saint Tropez. The exotic osmanthus lends complex nuances for sophisticated and seductive tones. . .

listings.rawTitle: Matin d’Été 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Step out of shower after a long day in the sun and recline on crisp clean cotton sheets. Spritz bright and refreshing lime and be enriched with soft ylang ylang, your magical day at the beach lingers with hints of sea salt. This scent will idle as you rest and the sun sets. . .

listings.rawTitle: Vanille en Fleur 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A hit of white florals from jasmine to mimosa underlined with stylish bergamot and encased in the green yet creamy delights of vanilla. A fragrance that conjures soft retro chic vibes but with contemporary poise. . .

listings.rawTitle: Saint Malo 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Laidback, hippy, salty and sexy this perfumes delivers reimagined 60's chic. A fragrance with an impetuous character, in which the earthy tones of patchouli and lavender blend with a citrusy soul. . .

listings.rawTitle: Sous Le Pont Mirabeau 100 ml EdP
listings.description: L'espérance est violente. Mirabeau, what a pretty word, peculiarly Parisian, suspended above the Seine. It composes a memory, joins another bank, and returns by following its trail of sandalwood, pink bay and cedar. In the heart of the City of Light, on the way to the twilight of the day, there is a bridge, a poem and a perfume. A discreet and symbolic bridge, of the master-builder spirit which transcends borders, becoming better by coming together. Those solid foundations of cedar, sandalwood and orcanox span love and musk. A poem as slow as it is violent, expressing the brutal and desirable hope of the one who would like to believe, of the one who wants to love. Vanilla, I write your name on the water, with muffled traces of incense and violet green. A perfume to save us, fish us silently out of the water, bringing us above the Seine, our spirits on the water of our essences, bergamot and pink berry mingled with fig in a glass bottle, fiercely reuniting bodies in unison with souls, coming back to her by following her wake. .

Cardinal has been renamed into Northern Cardinal . It's the same formula, just a new name.. Branches lay bare against a grey sky. The gaiety of summer has given way to doldrums of fall, and as winter settles in, flocks take flight, like guests from a dwindling party. But one pair of revellers lingers on, he in crimson finery, she in demure tones. Among tattered streamers of copper leaves, they warble a merry duet. Around the cardinals' nest, tinsel icicles may have replaced vibrant blooms of roses, but as they feast on scarlet berries that dot the snowy landscape, this feathered brood's festive spirit refuses to be chilled. . Zoologist Cardinal combines the invigorating scents of bergamot, rose and rich hints of leather. Tart green notes entwine with handsome undertones to encircle you in a subtle wreath of fragrance. Cloak yourself in this warm, cheerful perfume, a spark of joy on a bleak winter day.. Perfumer: Rosendo Mateu .

Rattikarn means night time in Thai and so this fragrance serves to capture the ancient forests of Thailand at twilight. With an exquisite blend of smoky, spicy and herbal notes you are whisked to a mysterious world filled with the scents of nocturnal fauna and flora. Deer musk is complemented with zesty yuzu and elegant camphor while oriental florals from osmanthus to lotus and patchouli and rose bring a delicate refreshing sweetness. Intricately layered spices like cumin seed, cinnamon and lapsang souchong add a rich warmth which balances the green nuances. A perfume that will embrace your confidence, wildness and awaken your thirst for adventure. .

Naruemit, which means creation in Thai, is a fragrance that captures the human drive towards innovation and creativity. A blend of animalic, citrus, and herbal notes come together as a classic chypre but with a signature twist of oriental yuzu. Revitalizing verbena and bergamot bring a fresh and uplifting energy, while the green and resinous notes of galbanum and camphor add depth and complexity. Rose, angelica and cumin seed serve as inspiring notes that can spark ingenuity by bringing a rich and floral bouquet that's both alluring and playful. The deep and rich base notes of thai oud, patchouli and deer musk accord give a warm and sensual foundation to the fragrance, while the spicy and aromatic notes of geranium, civet, and cinnamon harness the complexity and sophistication for a truly special diffusion. .

The perfume centres around Burmite, a prehistoric rare type of amber found in Northern Myanmar. With an exquisite blend of smoke, beeswax and honey serves to capture an entombed bee fossilised in amber; the effect is sumptuous ancient opulence. The formula contains the resinous amber which is married with the richness of beeswax absolute. Champaca adds sweetness and complexity while delicate florals, from orange flowers to jasmine absolute, bring softness. These are balanced with tangerine and a hint of incense and thai oud which give an overall romantic warmth. The spicy notes of black pepper, cinnamon, and nutmeg are layered with coriander and myrrh, while the base of tonka bean and amyris provide a creamy and sensual finish. .

listings.rawTitle: Vanille de Tahiti Extrait 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Perris Monte Carlo's Vanille de Tahiti Extrait de Parfum showcases the evocative and precious Vanilla Tahitensis . Vanilla Tahitensis , native to Central America was once a popular aphrodisiac in Mexico. Like a love potion, women would make a balm and spread it on themselves such was its power to allure. Brilliantly crafted this warm and exotic perfume represents the rich essence of fresh green vanilla pods. This fragrance in particular harnesses the multifaceted woody, floral and fruity nature of Vanilla Tahitensis as we might find it in the jungle. Blended with ylang ylang, champaca, and magnolia absolutes, there is a delicate and delicious smokey sillage that’s both playful and irresistible. While sandalwood, amber, and musk add an enveloping and sophisticated base. . .

The frail glow of the waning moon dwindles until only impenetrable blackness persists across the grasslands. A herd of deer venture tentatively into the expanse. Though their long necks dip to feed, their dainty legs remain tense, poised to flee. Nearby, gleaming gold eyes pierce the gloom, and silky ears stiffen, attuned to the softest tremor. The tiger advances haltingly, intent on its prey, anticipating a moment of vulnerability. In a seamless motion, it leaps and descends upon its victim, its razor-sharp fangs sinking deep into the deer’s throat. As the deer’s life fades, its herd is already gone, evaporating into the night. Like the thrill inspired by a low, rumbling growl cutting through silence, Zoologist Tiger couples danger with majesty. Vetiver’s earthy body is licked with stripes of kumquat, saffron and jasmine in an elegant pattern. Incense lurks at the edges, shrouded by smoky undertones of papyrus and ebony wood. Tiger arouses intrigue, putting those around you on high alert. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali.

Inspired by the classic cocktail, this scent is a rich and fruity blend of cherry, amaretto, and grenadine, with a hefty dose of fruity sweetness from pomegranates and apples. The diffusion conjures a deep red liqueur, with a hint of spice that brings a rich complexity to the fragrance. As the scent settles on the skin, the sweet note of white chocolate emerges, something rich and luxurious that is both comforting and seductive. Perfect if you want to add a dash of sophistication to your evening or to simply enjoy the scent of a good time all day long..

Or "into the madness" in French... This perfume tells the story of the city of love as it transitions from the bright light of day to the temptations of twilight. Inspired by the smell of French pastries that waft through the streets, enticing you to indulge in the decadent treats - to the city's transformation into a place of stilettos on cobblestones, cocktails and cigaterretts. A La Folie opens with a gourmand base that captures the essence of Parisian indulgence. The warm and sexy notes of tobacco and amber combine to create a rich and inviting aroma that will get you noticed. A la folie speaks to those who wish to embrace the madness of life with romance and indulgence.. .

Conjuring the beauty of early spring, evoking the scent of sunlight and raindrops sparkling on top of fresh forest leaves. This is a contemporary fougere scent, inspired by the Korean movie "One Fine Spring Day" capturing the fragrant love affair that takes place under a blossom tree; serene, tranquil yet full of anticipation. Revitalising mint, bamboo and bergamot are married with warming cardamom and lavender bringing a sensuous depth to the diffusion. Jasmine, tobacco and vanilla add woody sweet notes to the sophisticated and seductive nature of the perfume. Overall this is a rich and complex scent bound to transport you to a world where you can experience the fresh joy of spring all year round.. .

Green Lunar captures the essence of a little known part of Northern Thailand. Inspired by the locals' belief that the native cannabis absorbs the magic of the moonlight. They believe the best time to harvest this plant is right after the full moon, when the plant is at its most potent. The unique strength and wildness featured in this particular cannabis accord will turn heads. As ever with Strangers, this formula is carefully crafted, the intention is to quieten the mind so the wearer can awaken their senses. With hints of earthy notes and a touch of sweetness Green Lunar captures that same magic of the original source, bringing a scent that speaks to our feral passions..

listings.rawTitle: St. Paul's 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The floriental baroquesque parfum St. Paul's embodies an adoration and admiration to the spectacular era of Baroque. This style in architecture, music, art, sculpture demonstrates exalted movements, clear details, intense light and dark shadows, emotional exuberance, richness, extravaganza, which distinct baroque from other style. . The English baroque represents iconic St. Paul's Cathedral, which dome has long dominated the London skyline. . The perfume opens with the precious orange flower and jasmine absolutes with a hint of dried and juicy fruits, contrasting with the darker woody and balsamic base. .

This fragrance is inspired by love, drama and opulence of the famous painting by P. P. Rubens and the legend of Samson and Delilah. Osmanthus Noble is intense and has a strong personality and notes of Osmanthus, Ylang Ylang and Jasmine absolute flowers, spicy tobacco, warm amber and sandalwood.. At opening you can feel fresh, spicy and aldehydic notes blended with bergamot and mandarin that give vividness and intensity. The noble osmanthus absolute combined with an aromatic clary sage play together to form a soft suede accord. Tobacco absolute, delicious black cherry, saffron and tonka beans play an important role in creating a sensual atmosphere. Floral notes of jasmine sambac and ylang-ylang give vitality and bloom in the heart. In the dry down, oakmoss absolute, labdanum, sandalwood, smoky vetiver and animalic musks bring a spiritual feeling and allow the perfume to linger on the skin..

The emotional statement to Freedom.. The perfume was inspired by walks along the fast flowing and vibrant River Thames in London. . Passing by leafy, graceful London iconic plane (platanus) trees arcing over the river with spherical fruits on strings, induce the emotional connection with Nature.. The large white Chrysanthemum plays the main character in the composition.. Feeling protected, loved, connected. .

listings.rawTitle: Mimosa Gold 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Our life is a long journey through good times and difficult times. We carry our inner child through those hardships and hills, trying to protect it, guarding it on the road. . For me, mimosa flower is a symbol of a beautiful, fluffy pompon, innocent and micro-sized Earth. . I remember myself at the age of three, dressed in a short puffed mimosa-yellow georgette dress, hiding in the tall, light green grass, experiencing a tremendous sense of bliss and joy. . This memory follows me all my life. MIMOSA GOLD is a memory of my happy childhood. Therefore I encourage you to remember good times in your own childhood while experiencing this perfume.. That's why I chose a marvellous mimosa dealbata absolute from France and acacia farnesiana from Egypt to create the heart of this perfume, supported with a creamy ylang-ylang from Comoros. They have not only beautiful smell, but are an incarnation of innocence, beauty of Nature and joy. . .

Exploring autumnal woods and London parks is an endless experience. Colorful palette of feelings and emotions touches the inner self. Rose petals slowly falling on the dark, warm earth. The lights passing through autumnal tree leaves play a symphony of emotions.. The eau de parfum Ruby Wood is rose- woody- balsamic floriental scent with the red berry and coffee nuances. The perfume was created by Eglija Vaitkevice in 2018..

listings.rawTitle: By Serpentine 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The perfume was inspired by contemplation at the Serpentine Lake in Hyde Park, London.. Nature and people come together to celebrate the summer Solstice. Light tobacco smoke rises above the tall grass, drowning merry people in its sweet cloud.. Ripe berries and plant seeds attract park squirrels and other animals. White Royal swans fall asleep in the pond. A light breeze ripples the surface of the water. The mystical snake (serpent) rustles on the dewy evening grass and disappears into the fern, frightening the screaming birds. Everything around is immersed in a bohemian night..

Pergola opens with the most incredible rush of twisted green vegetation and instantly transports you back to the heyday of that decadent walkway. There is so much happening in here but the notes of galbanum, bergamot, and ivy are particularly spectacular. The floral heart is a swooning blend of narcissus, tuberose, and jasmine but the pergola’s passage of history is provided by an earthy pairing of patchouli and vetiver. You get a real impression of its heritage from touches of resins and moss and, whilst it’s described as a fougere, there is definitely a feeling of the most glorious aromatic chypre. .

This will captivate your senses with a clean, sweet and woody diffusion that exudes luxury. With a masterful blend of tonka beans and lilacs, this balmy floral is elevated by the addition of balsamic and spicy blossoms that is both warm and inviting. The soft, ambery warmth of white cocoa extract adds a richness that is sure to leave a lasting impression. For those who find life-enhancing beauty in a well-crafted scent..

Costume Liquide boasts a refined and modern blend of floral and spice that is peppery and clean.The result is a scent that emanates an understated elegance and an enveloping sophistication. Basil and violet leaves are artfully blended providing a crisp, rich freshness that perfectly complements the lavish quality of Haitian Vetiver. Costume Liquide is sure to be a modern classic. .

Beso Dorado is inspired by the 10 years of magic and splendor of Beso Beach. It is an addictive perfume with intense and fresh aromas. Capture the authentic Mediterranean spirit of summer evenings with the sunsets and endless nights. Pink pepper and juniper give a lively and spicy opening, cinnamon and patchouli make Beso Dorado a warm and seductive fragrance, with vibrant and refreshing notes of vetiver. A woody personality with a touch of mystery.. Dominique Ropion: “ I wanted to mix deep, nocturnal, distinguished ingredients with an aromatic freshness. I wanted to create the perfume of a summer afternoon, a Mediterranean and sensual fragrance ”..

Mechanic is an elegant old-school leather built around the violet leaf note with a pinch of aromatic herbs..
See breeze, sunshine and a calm god of fitness watching over the bathers.. Lifeguard is a marine incense, sea salt and frankincense, a rare combination, cool and composed. .
Oh, the rich air of the carpenter’s workshop filled with the aromas of freshly cut wood, sweet vanilla and smelling glue. Imagine a cricket quietly chirping in the background..

In any drama there is a character who listens to a weary soul while pouring a drink. This gives the main character a chance to pause, relax and digest the plot. Barman is a boozy concoction infused with fruity brandy, velvety sandalwood and plush tonka. .
Stroll alongside a gardener and enjoy the crisp fresh air and birds chirping away. Gardener is a refreshing blend of green notes, spearmint and cypress. .

Frosted patchouli : a palpable tension between hot and cold. The fragrance begins on a frosted note with marine accents, warmed by a spicy combination of ginger, pink pepper and juniper berry. The patchouli is intense, warm and powerful, a patchouli leaf captured in ice. .
“Scent of liberty & madness. Untamed, unleashed and auncensored.” . PERFUMER CHRISTOPHE RAYNAUD.

Perfumer: Hamid Merati-Kashani . Inebriated with desire, mmmmm! Red berries in a sparkling swirl of aromatic juniper, clary sage and ginger, spiked with cognac and cardamom, infused with fragrant woods and resins. One sniff leads to another, and another, and another….

Opening with sparkling notes of lime and mandarin tempered with pink pepper and a green accord, delicate cherry blossom with soft almond aromas enhanced with powdery violets and creamy vanilla. Elusive elegance, realising the power of subtlety, radiating an inner confidence - to be worn with an innate love of understated good taste..

A kaleidoscope of metal, volume and zest, with zest provided by yuzu. Alive in an ethereal dream of shimmering clarity, Resonant pulses with addictive hot iron and ozonic citrus, sharpened with ginger.. Master perfumer David Chieze .

listings.rawTitle: Dead Air 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Macabre fantasy of decadent shadows and drama, unfolding from a fresh salty breeze to the deep dark underwater with blurry black tones, exuberant flora and a binding touch of wood. . Lids for Dead Air are made by hand from imperfectly beautiful charcoal encapsulated in epoxy resin resulting in unique shapes and shades, each is one of a kind — a true masterpiece. . Master perfumer Mark Buxton .

listings.rawTitle: Naked Dance 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Naked Dance is an olfactory impression of our lives at home, where we jazz through space filled with our attachments, memories and comforts in bliss of intimate liberty to be ourselves. . .Oddity bottles are an art object that combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design. Each piece is topped with handmade cap made to order individually from wood scraps and epoxy resin. The irregular shape is unique endoved with imperfect beauty of raw materials and the craftsmanship that folds them into an artful piece. . Master perfumer Mark Buxton .

An Eau de Parfum with floral amber notes, Mulberry Fig, is a warm creamy scent combined with bittersweet, green, and powdery orris notes to an incredible effect. . Created by the in-house perfumery team at 89 Jermyn Street. Inspired by St James's Park, a quick promenade away from our Jermyn Street shop, one of London’s oldest Royal Parks, surrounded by some of the country’s most famous landmarks and lush greenery. Creamy sweet and bitter green aromas encompass the shoreline of the blissful lake towered by an abundance of fig trees, immense in scale with elongated deciduous leaves flaunting their architectural foliage, believed to be the largest in Britain. Mulberry Fig is a scent that evokes a floral amber fragrance combining the soft powdery character of orris with hints of fruit and spice. The perfume opens with a sparkle of fig and cardamom supported from the heart with fragrant green tones of vetiver and cypress. Amyris, cedarwood and sandalwood emphasise the overall woody character that permeates through the perfume..

Limited not-playing-games-any-more edition of Mriga with natural Mongolian deer musk. There is also a unique oud the perfumer collected in Myanmar, orris butter, absolutes of clary sage, choya ral, black hemlock, rose de Mai and more.. The result is raw, savage and wild just like the original habitat of deer musk.. May contain small sediment of deer musk pod..

Nilmalee (นิลมาลี) or Black flowers in Thai. First part the flowers blossom, Inspired by rare narcotic natural flowers absolute such Gardenia , Indian Tuberose , Lotus , Jasmine and Orange flowers.. Second the plant stem part ; Violet leaf absolute , Angelica absolute , Ho wood oil , Jatamansi (Spikenard) with two type of natural Indonesian oud from Malino and Kalimantan in Borneo island given green woody with hint of animalic.. Finally, The black character provide by the hard to find material such as Sumbul (Ferula moschata) or sometimes call Musk root , a medicinal plant found in Central Asia. A few botanical musk found in nature. Given aromatic green animalic deer musk vibe bring all the materials together.. Please note that the perfume may contain small sediment due to very high percentage natural absolute ,resin and oil.. One batch only and almost impossible to recreate again.

Ultimate vintage glory. Mandodari Mandodari feels like it belongs to the era before the mass production and synthetic musks took the industry over. It’s a complex blend featuring precious rich floral absolutes and animalic bases.. This perfume (at 48% strength) is double the concentration of the original Mandodari . The perfumer adds extra smokiness with the tropical sal tree absolute (choya raal) and a tree ash accord (cade oil + birch tar).. Absolutes of rose de Mai, jasmine grandiflorum, orange blossom, tuberose as well as natural ambergris and civet steer the formula in the vintage dimension. There is an intentional YSL’s Opium spicy cameo too..
Drunken Cherries. Wild side to an innocent one.. PERFUMER FLORIAN GALLO . This is a new more concentrated edition. . .
Drunken Cherries. Wild side to an innocent one.. PERFUMER FLORIAN GALLO . This is a new more concentrated edition. . .
A rose bush in a dark, dusky, and cold air. Beauty in sadness, but magnificence in darkness. . PERFUMER FLORIAN GALLO .
A scent of dead rose vine. A dry and withered being, stomped upon by those who once loved. . PERFUMER FLORIAN GALLO .
A dry dusty oud amalgamated with sandalwood and patchouli. It’s smoky and dark but with a hint of sour lemon zest. . PERFUMER: DORA BAGHRICHE .
Steamy, sticky, and luscious. A lazy afternoon, spent with a girl not so vanilla. . PERFUMER FRANK VOELKL, FLORIAN GALLO .

Hazy scent of wet soil amidst the rain. The pouring rain cools off the ground. Water fiercely falls from edge of the roof, raindrops splashes between the grass, and the ground turns to mud. The subtle scent of the water, the wet grass, and muddy ground permeates the air. . PERFUMER NATHALIE LORSON .
The orange martini at lunch. Naked in the water. Stinging sunlight. . PERFUMER DAPHNE BUGEY .
Dirty Rice evokes the fresh powdery green aroma of rice shoots ready to go in the sunlit mud of a flooded paddy.. PERFUMER OLIVER CRESP .
Dirty Rice evokes the fresh powdery green aroma of rice shoots ready to go in the sunlit mud of a flooded paddy.. PERFUMER OLIVER CRESP .

The cigarette after the sex in the woods. Damp and dewy. A night spent in the old cabin in the woods. Lighting a cigarette as we walk into the forest, which was still moist from rain. . PERFUMER FRANK VOELKL .
A milky green fig oozing sweet musk. . PERFUMER FLORIAN GALLO .

The eternal question of: is it half-dresses or half-naked?. Sex & Cognac, delicious & smoky, is a lovely rich formula featuring honeyed Laotian oud, saffron and a realistic cognac accord.. PERFUMER HAMID MERATI KASHANI .
Steamy summer night. Overgrown grass and its thick scent. Jumping naked into cold lake. Inspired by world-famous Gin & Tonic of Zest Seoul. . PERFUMER HONORINE BLANC .
Love around the campfire. Heavily peated, spiced scotch in the wet woods . PERFUMER FLORIAN GALLO .

A snapshot of a sensual night for two on a veranda overlooking a tangled garden. Cognac is shared, its boozy intimations amping the intoxicating amber scent lifting off warm skin. Earthy patchouli adds grit to the grace. . PERFUMER HONORINE BLANC .

A fragrant and floral dedication to emotions and the intricate patterns that shape and run through the structure of our brains. Liquid joy prepared with balsamic labdanum, leathery orange blossom and violet leaf absolutes and a drop of fruity coffee nuance.. Perfumer: Luca Maffei. Strength: 35% extrait de parfum. The origin of some materials in the formula:. pink pepper -> South America. arabica coffee -> South America. cinnamon -> Sri Lanka. galbanum -> Iran. jasmine sambac -> India. violet leaf absolute -> Egypt. orange blossom absolute -> Tunisia. Ylang Ylang -> Madagascar. guaiac -> Paraguay. Vetiver -> Haiti. Labdanum -> Spain.

Perfumer: Nathalie Feisthauer. Note from the creator: “My personal interpretation of the term “privilege” is that it is a privilege for me, to have water, nature, greenery, woods and the sea available to me. In other words, having nature around me is the ultimate privilege. PRIVILEGE has become my tribute to the natural elements!” .

listings.rawTitle: Harvest Mouse 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Autumn winds skip across golden wheat fields. As the tall grasses billow, the rattle of husks beats a soft prairie lullaby, signalling to the weary sun to rest. In the fading light, tiny harvest mice venture forth, scrambling to gather seeds and fruits. For once the sun sinks fully beneath the horizon, its rule of the sky is bestowed on another. And when the coo of the owl breaks the night, the mice dash, trembling, back to their nests.. Like a countryside bathed in sweet sunlight, Zoologist Harvest Mouse conjures images of home-baked goodness. Stalks of wheat sway among chamomile, davana and hay, and rich beer extracts are sobered by resins and woody notes. Cozy up in a warm nest of homespun scent.. Perfumer: Luca Maffei .

listings.rawTitle: Secrets du Paradis Rouge 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A timeless ode to the Orange Blossom, carnal and enticing, seducing by its elegance and rarity. Its exalting “sillage” and its enveloping character are a pure invitation to discover a magnificent, enchanted garden, where the orange freshness and the elegance of Neroli are sublimated by sensual notes of honey, rose, vanilla and Tonka beans. This magnificent mix is sustained by a perfectly balanced accord of benzoin, amber and musk. . Parfumeur : Luca Maffei .

listings.rawTitle: Stilettos on Lex 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A haunting, captivating perfume… Its powerful yet refined personality enchants the lovers of timeless floral fragrances with a powdery touch. Nothing and no one can resist it, by day or by night. This enveloping perfume is a real “séducteur”, pure reflection of the beautiful and mysterious silhouette encountered on this legendary New York City avenue… . Parfumeur : Dorothée Piot .

This girl is a gift for well-behaved men. The one who bursts into a party and suddenly makes you want to believe in Santa. Half way between a flirtatious temptress and a dancing queen, the temperature rises just by her presence. . To hell with “global warming”! She’s here to have fun, no matter what. Heavenly lightness in December… Sweet honey notes at the start lie on a vanilla-tangerine accord and all at once life becomes as captivating as the fullness of her décolleté. It’s soft and warm, notes swirl and dance, and the world starts spinning, like a faceted mirror ball, marvel of all marvels. . In the heart, red pepper mingles with nigella in a detonating cocktail of scents. Hot red lips adorn a lavishly extraverted smile. Breathtaking! The slightly musky, solar accord of the base speaks of the radiant warmness of her skin under her laughing throat. She calls for her after-midnight man, the one who will abduct her under the Xmas tree. And who will jealously sweep her off her feet and into his room, like a child would with his most precious present. .

Perfume: Alexis Dadier. Galbanum, bergamot and tomato leaves create an exquisite citrusy woody diffusion. Marie Jeanne, known for the outstanding quality of their materials, have excelled, offering a beautifully rich green fragrance..

listings.rawTitle: Cardinal (Limited Edition) (Discontinued) 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: One bottle left of this collectable edition SPECIAL EDITION IS NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION The same perfume is available in the regular/standard packaging: Cardinal .. Branches lay bare against a grey sky. The gaiety of summer has given way to doldrums of fall, and as winter settles in, flocks take flight, like guests from a dwindling party. But one pair of revellers lingers on, he in crimson finery, she in demure tones. Among tattered streamers of copper leaves, they warble a merry duet. Around the cardinals' nest, tinsel icicles may have replaced vibrant blooms of roses, but as they feast on scarlet berries that dot the snowy landscape, this feathered brood's festive spirit refuses to be chilled. . Zoologist Cardinal combines the invigorating scents of bergamot, rose and rich hints of leather. Tart green notes entwine with handsome undertones to encircle you in a subtle wreath of fragrance. Cloak yourself in this warm, cheerful perfume, a spark of joy on a bleak winter day.. Perfumer: Rosendo Mateu .

listings.rawTitle: Macaque Fuji Apple 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Against the backdrop of a mountainous terrain, two communities share a peaceful coexistence. Yet despite their proximity, the societies are distinctly unique. Macaques cavort among the trees, grasping with delight at nature’s bountiful pleasures. From the quiet solemnity of a nearby temple, their human neighbours regard them, coveting the monkeys’ playful abandon. The macaques are all but oblivious, sparing only the briefest of curious glances at the pensive faces below before surrendering once again to their carefree revels.. Sweet notes of Fuji apple dance through a pine forest, welcoming you to Zoologist Macaque. Incense adds gravity with aromas of Hinoki woods and myrrh. The delicate balance between heavy and light results in an austere woody scent with mild hints of creamy sandalwood. Macaque is exuberance tempered by calm, sublimity buoyed by joy, a happy harmony of meditative bliss.. This perfume is a new interpretation by perfumer Mackenzie Reilly. The original version, designed by Sarah McCartney, is discontinued and no longer available. . Perfumer : Mackenzie Reilly .

listings.rawTitle: Noir By Night (Discontinued) 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A Bold, Suave Fragrance Infused with Precious Woods and Silky Caviar . NOIR BY NIGHT is a juxtaposition of textures and flavours, that offers a unique experience between freedom and sensuality. The fragrance brings confidence and elegance to the fore with a bold expression of silken caviar and rich woods.An elegantly intense opening of incense and dusky coriander drapes the evening shadows.. As the night falls, a molecular explosion releases the power of unexpected scents.The sleek combination of gaiac wood and sandalwood infused with amber notes offers a luminous warmth with subtle nuances..

listings.rawTitle: Pink Me Up (Discontinued) 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A Luminously Playful Fragrance Sparkling with the Effervescence of Champagne . PINK ME UP sparkles and pops, with a mood boosting shine. Experience uplifting emotions with the radiating glow of happiness, joie de vivre and frivolity. PINK ME UP is like a joyous bubble of pleasure, swirling in a crystal glass, symbolising the pleasures of life. Discover the addictive fizz of champagne and the perfectly paired fruitiness of blackberry and bergamot.. PINK ME UP’s addictive yet sophisticated scent unveils the delicacy of champagne and the blush of rose centifolia. Swirling floral notes of orange blossom and iris are amplified with seductive musk..

The intense scent of Ylang Ylang, the “flower of flowers” with its long, tapered leaves: sweet, powdery, floral, strong, radiant and unmistakable, surrounded by a chorus of Frangipani flowers, Jasmine, Orange blossoms and Tiarè. .

From the fields of Indonesia and the islands of La Réunion, the deep, intense fragrance of Vetiver Bourbon with its bitter, green, sensually smoky features. A base of aromatic woods, with touches of Rosewood, Angelica root and Poppy. .

An ancient ritual. The wonder of green, perfumed resin flowing from the tree. It is reminiscent of journeys along the perfume routes, of the magic of nocturnal ceremonies. Fresh, intense notes of Incense, Opoponax, Storax and Tolu. .

The atmosphere of a luxuriant garden, where the notes of Carnation, Rose, Geranium, Jasmin and aromatic spices blend into a spicy-floral accord that gives this fragrance its distinctive personality. .

The unmistakable aroma of perfumed powders; the scent of face powder in a soft, gentle, enveloping fragrance. Subtly imbued with the richness of natural extracts from precious Rose, Jasmine and Ylang Ylang flowers to evoke the delicate beauty and femininity of the Belle Epoque. .

The unmistakable aroma of perfumed powders; the scent of face powder in a soft, gentle, enveloping fragrance. Subtly imbued with the richness of natural extracts from precious Rose, Jasmine and Ylang Ylang flowers to evoke the delicate beauty and femininity of the Belle Epoque. .

The brand’s vision of uomo/man . This is a fresh, elegant, masculine fragrance made with citrus, spices and aromatic woods, Calabrian bergamot and equatorial peppers, sweet-smelling resins and oakmoss. A true classic..

A timeless classic in the world of perfumery, unmistakable and as beloved as the sun-drenched fields of Provence, with their endless purple and blue. A refined base of Lavender, citrus and Iris with spicy, Tonka and Laurel undertones. .

Trees laden with joyful, colourful exotic fruits: Pineapple, Coconut, Raspberry and Passion fruit. Lively Osmanthus and Ylang Ylang flowers. Sweet, delicious notes, as sensual and enveloping as an embrace under the infinite stars of the southern seas. .

A rich, refined perfume from the Indian tradition, made with Mysore Sandalwood. A precious harmony of Sandalwood and Rose notes, in an embrace of Guaiacwood and Opoponax, of aromatic woods and wood sap. .

From a rich prelude of fresh Galbanum and Cistus notes, with marine undertones and spices, emerges the deep scent of balms, resins and Incense, Labdanum, Myrrh and Frankincense, which herald the enveloping, sensual undertones of Ambergris accompanied by animal notes and aromatic woods. .

An endless expanse of green blending into the sky. The scent of grass and Hay, of countless plants and various small flowers, of aromatic herbs and fields blowing in the wind, warmed by the sun. An evocation of simple, pristine nature. .

The green, relaxing scents of the Tuscan countryside blend with the liveliness of exotic spices. Cypress and Cinnamon, Bay and Pepper, Tomato and Cardamom leaves all dance together to create a rich, fresh, unique fragrance. .

A fresh, radiant, suggestive fragrance reminiscent of ancient adventures across unknown seas and countries, in search of mythical lands. Rich in rare and precious scents, where citrus, spices, flowers and mysterious resins accompany captivating notes of Leather and Vetiver. .

The epitome of femininity as narrated by the queens of flowers: Rosa centifolia and Rosa Damascena, crowned by powdery Ylang Ylang and Florentine Iris, with touches of Jasmine and mountain Narcissus, Violet leaves, Blackcurrant and oriental woods. .

The scent of the desert wind blowing over the pepper and spice trade routes, steeped in their fragrances, merges with fresh citrussy notes for a unique, refined effect. Memories of the Orient and of markets overlooking the Mediterranean. Fresh, aromatic and spicy. .

The scent of pristine, primordial nature, the gentle breath of the woods and the Indonesian jungle. An unmistakable, free-spirited, evocative scent. An original, sophisticated, intense fragrance of Patchouli, wood and aromatic roots. .

The sophisticated sensuality of notes of Musk is caressed by the scent of aromatic woods, petals from the most beautiful roses, the mysterious scent of Oakmoss and the sweetness of Vanilla. . A particularly elegant fragrance with discreet charm. .

Kamasurabhi, the “perfume of pleasure”: a kaleidoscope of fragrances and colours, an incredibly precious attar. Piercingly delicate Indian flowers, infused with the mysterious, seductive scent of a Sandalwood forest and exotic woods, with sensual, enveloping undertones of Leather, Amber and Musk. .

The legend of a happy island and eternal youth: there, beyond the north wind, in the perpetual spring, the fresh northerly breeze carries the scent of blossoming flowers searching for the first ray of sun in the morning dew. A vibrant fragrance of the freshest flowers with citrus notes and light fruity touches that opens up in a radiant heart of Lily of the valley, Magnolia, Mimosa and Cyclamen. .

Dilmun is heaven for the ancient people of Mesopotamia, the Garden of the Sun where bushes are laden with buds, where flowering plants climb, and lapis lazuli leaves are mixed with sweet fruits. A sunny, radiant fragrance where notes of Neroli and Orange blossoms develop against a background of Opoponax and Incense, aromatic woods and Vanilla, with green undertones of Laurel leaves. .

A crisp, citrus fragrance, the breeze brushing gently over the grass, flowers and shrubs of the Mediterranean, and golden reflections of the sun’s rays on the shimmering sea. A fresh, lively, green scent with notes of Bergamot and Mandarin, and light flowery undertones of Jasmine and Narcissus. .

A deep, intense, mysterious fragrance that radiates unique atmospheres: magical, spiritual, real and imaginary. An enveloping scent of Leather, Tobacco and precious woods with light undertones of flowers and wild herbs, on a gentle, sensual background of fragrant resins, of Vanilla and Patchouli, of Amber and Musk. .

A deep, intense, mysterious fragrance that radiates unique atmospheres: magical, spiritual, real and imaginary. An enveloping scent of Leather, Tobacco and precious woods with light undertones of flowers and wild herbs, on a gentle, sensual background of fragrant resins, of Vanilla and Patchouli, of Amber and Musk. .

Heaven on earth: Alamut.. If we were to believe Marco Polo’s story - Alamut was the fortress and headquarters of the order of assassins. In Alamut among other things, according to Marco, the new recruits could experience the demo version of heaven. An assassin to be would be inebriates by some potion (even though Marco never mention which drug it was, highly likely it was hashish). Then the recruit would be taken to a pleasure garden with drinks, food and beautiful maiden. Afterwards the head of the order would explain that absolute loyalty and fearless determination would guarantee an afterlife of this kind.. Lorenzo Villorezi’s Alamut is an intense sensual rose resting on a cloud of ambergris..

A timeless, traditional cologne: fresh, versatile and eternally elegant like all true classics. The fragrance expresses all its radiant freshness with the most intoxicating citrus aromas: Bergamot, Lemon and Orange are a perfect contrast to the Lavender and invigorating Mediterranean herbs. .

The powerful and regal bison grazes in the vast open space of the Carpathian Mountains; at one with the wild and beautiful landscape. Hay, wild berries and grass transport us to the remote and wooded hills. The contrasting earthy leather and delicious vanilla conjure the creatures thick fur and gentle heart. .

The bear prowls amongst resinous pine and fir foraging as he goes, his rich damp fur steams against his body heat. Iris and labdanum conjure a free and floral nature whilst fragrant cinnamon and ginger embody the dominating and ruthless presence. Edible honey and sweet vanilla add richness to this oriental, spicy and woody fragrance.. .

The lone wolf roams the forest at twilight. Strong and resilient in the face of cold, crisp and hostile woods. Vetiver and pine evoke the dark green atmosphere, whilst plums and davana allude to the spicy energetic power of the wolf. Cedarwood and pepper are beautifully balanced with leather, with tonka beans adding a herbaceous bitter richness to the fragrance. This original EdP version offers a leaner, more frankincense-forward iteration to the bass-heavy extrait treatment..

The intelligent and devious and boar strides confidently under the forest canopy. Hunger fuels his progress. Apples, fallen leaves and mushrooms swirl in the atmosphere around him. His fur is perfumed by the deep green conifer and galbanum. The fragrant blend of leather, vetiver, and truffle denote the damp moss, sweat and scratched bark. .

The quiet majesty of the deer is undeniable as he stands aloft the dry forest, watchful and ready. Aromatic herbs, spices and aged bark reflect the fresh mountain air as it swirls around the energetic herd. Musk, leather and hay illuminate the powerful glory of the wild animal whilst smooth and earthy patchouli softens and relaxes. .

The wild side of the indomitable goat swirling with the learthery darkness of the mountain roads. Mushrooms and truffles conjur the habitat; and the dirty, bestial, almost aggressive side of the creature is felt through goat's milk, costus and oud. An earthy, woody, animalic fragrance denoting strength and virility. .

The Nero collection. Nose: Pierre Guéros. “When I received the first samples of the fragrance that would later become Nektar, I was ravished by its personality and by the quality of its composition. Full of softness and creativity, Nektar recalls honey without being overwhelming, while drawing a distinctive character from its intense notes. Working with Pierre was a real pleasure. In little time, we gave life to a perfume that does not go unnoticed, now available in our flagship stores and at authorized retailers across the globe.”. Roberto Drago, LO's owner.

Perfumer: Pierre Guéros. “ExpLOud marks the beginning of a new creative synergy: Laboratorio Olfattivo meets Pierre Guéros, perfumer at Symrise. This great traveller and connoisseur of Middle East immediately seduced us with his sensitivity, his human curiosity and his ability to establish an empathic contact with other cultures. Without hesitation, we entrusted him the mission of giving body to “our vision” of Oud. ExpLOud was born, as an aromatic explosion based on the most precious and luminous of Ouds, with floral notes to lift and twist the characteristic scent of this unique raw material which has already experienced numerous interpretations on the market”.. Roberto Drago.

A beautifully calibrated vanilla fragrance perfectly poised between woody and sweet, huggable and lickable. The vanilla here suggests milky skin, made more velvety with cashmeran, and more mouth-watering with candied fruit. Cardamom, cedarwood, patchouli and incense add spice and shade..

A beautifully calibrated vanilla fragrance perfectly poised between woody and sweet, huggable and lickable. The vanilla here suggests milky skin, made more velvety with cashmeran, and more mouth-watering with candied fruit. Cardamom, cedarwood, patchouli and incense add spice and shade..

David Maruitte. “Nerosa is a perfume realized with David Maruitte in 2011, but at that time we believed that Laboratorio Olfattivo was not yet ready to launch a fragrance like this. Today instead, Nerosa can perfectly enter in our Black Collection, thanks to the depth, wealth and strength of its formula. A fragrance whose energy is noticeable and whose enveloping sillage is strong.”. Roberto Drago.

The Nero collection. “Sacreste comes out from the study of another perfume that I have been trying to realize for eight years. Two years ago I received a trial fragrance by Luca Maffei which was characterized by an incense note I really like. We have been working on that note, finishing it and making it sensual until we arrived at the final project, that I completely love.”. Roberto Drago, LO's owner.

Perfumer: Luca Maffei. Vanhera: a dark Vanilla, an unexpected fragrance that recalls intriguing and unclear sensations. A journey around one of the most iconic perfumery’s notes. A Vanilla perfume, not the usual Vanilla fragrance where just sweet notes are emphasized. A battle, a conflict among ingredients.. In Vanhera, a Madagascar Vanilla absolute tries to find a place in a universe of ingredients that want to suppress it. Vanhera is surrounded, almost besieged, by spicy notes of pepper, cardamom, cinnamon; it is embraced by warm notes of sandalwood and cashmeran and it is stained by karmawood, timbersilk and ambery notes. Nevertheless, the Vanilla absolute arises and makes its presence felt, conquering heart and soul of whoever smells it..

Cécile Zarokian. Hypnotic, sensual, sexual, erotic, nerotic…Nerotic. Nerotic is a charming and addictive perfume: it drags you into a very emotional journey. The idea was to create a scent that stuns the senses thanks to a composition both elegant and intriguing: just like a black dress with a special detail. Nerotic opens the “Laboratorio in Nero” collection, the new collection of fragrances of Laboratorio Olfattivo, where the color black, symbol of elegance, luxury and mystery, represents fragrances with complex formula, made with precious raw materials..

Cécile Zarokian. Narcotics flowers, psychotropic herbs and haunted spices are the main ingredients of Kashnoir, the eleventh fragrance of Laboratorio Olfattivo, created after embarking on a long journey in search of the most forbidden and mysterious East. More than a fragrance, Kashnoir is a softly lethal drug, that obscures reason and stuns the senses. A powerful scent, which leads to oblivion, almost dangerous to the wearer..

'A rose is a rose is not a rose' All is not always as it first appears. Character: Haunting, powerful, seductive. Inspiration: A 16th Century epic allegorical poem; a sorceress; a mythic forest. .
A delicious shimmering amber to follow the movement of your body like a fantastic beast.. It conjures up aromas of licorice rum, autumn sunset apples, and smoky bitter sweet tonka..

Exclusive for Bloom Perfumery London. Inspired by dramatic Aztec mythology and Love Death + Robots’ Jibaro this perfume is darkness distilled. It’s an elixir made with ambergris, mushrooms, extract of sea shells, licorice, and a selection of dark green materials such as galbanum, violet leaf absolute, black hemlock, artemisia and more.. Ahuizotl is a cryptid, half dog half mermaid waiting underneath the still black waters of jungle lakes. It mostly preys on naughty children who come close to the water's edge.. Jibaro is a stunning animation about a fatal game between a lake siren and a deaf conquistador soldier.. All in all, the perfume is exploring the allure of dark depths (physical and metaphysical) we should not be staring into or let alone entering, but some of us can’t help it.. Some curious facts about the materials in the formula:. Mushroom absolute (Boletus Edulis) comes from France. Soil tincture is Mitti Attar is from India . Natutral grey ambergris is from New Zealand and. Black hemlock absolute comes from Canada.

listings.rawTitle: In Love with Everything  (Discontinued) 50 ml EdP
listings.description: SYNOPSIS : Written in 1982, this electrifying novel about sex, drugs, and decadence in pre-Miami Vice Florida, follows a delinquent clique of teenage girls through nightclubs, roller discos, and seedy South Beach bars in search of anything to keep the party going. Driven by an inexhaustible enthusiasm, the girls navigate a series of potentially dangerous situations with naive ease, radiating their infectious light like a disco ball and turning even the darkest circumstances into a dance party. Lauded for its unflinchingly honest portrayal of strong, outspoken, resourceful young women whose sole motivation was to have a good time, the book stands in stark contrast to the male chauvinism of the era and still resonates today. Critics have called it “an essential examination of the joys of recklessness” and “an addictive story in which every sentence glistens with sticky sweet summer heat.”. WHEN TO WEAR THIS FRAGRANCE : This extremely versatile (and genderless!) fragrance is great for any time of day and any time of year but the blast of energy it possesses is ideal for whenever you’re feeling low or looking for a little boost of bliss to keep your body moving and your lungs laughing long into the night..

Intoxicating and smooth, the Damascena rose radiates throughout. A twist of pink pepper brings a touch of freshness. The velvety touch of rose petals combined with vanilla creates a luxurious veil. . Furthermore, there is a dark, green undertone from the davana herb which contrasts with the silkiness of the rose..

Furthermore, there is a dark, green undertone from the davana herb which contrasts with the silkiness of the rose..

Evoking the traditional smoking of tea leaves in ancient China, Indigo Smoke is an aromatic landscape of narrow serpentine rivers, blue mountains and incense-filled temples condensed into a complex formula of black tea, woody notes and incense. Rich, sophisticated and long-lasting. With notes of lapsang souchong tea, mandarin orange, apricot, guaiac wood, incense and pine tar.. .

Created in celebration of the James Bond film franchise’s special anniversary, 60 years since the release of Dr No, in 1962.. A rich and spicy fragrance with amber at its base, this captivating scent is a blend of refreshing citrus and juniper notes set against a subtly smoky accord with flashes of spicy dianthus carnation and an aromatic heart created by a fusion of rose, lavender, rosemary, and geranium, underscored by the reassuring warmth of sensual amber, sandalwood, oakmoss and musk.. .

Did you know that tulips originate from the lands on which modern day Kazakhstan is standing? Then from the foothills of Tien Shan, the flower travelled west with Sultan Suleyman’s army around 16 th century.. Land of Tulips is an impression of flowers welcoming spring in the steppes with a bright carpet of gentle fresh bloom.. .

The heart of the mountains is a small silver flower blossoming on the rocks. Its aroma is delicate and serene like the sky at an altitude of three thousand meters above the sea, like the bluish ice of millennial glaciers. Its power is to make the dreams come true; its magic is to make it possible to find love. That is why Edelweiss has for centuries been believed to be a symbol of mountain peaks and the most desired talisman for happiness and good fortune.. Perfumer - Vanessa Prudent. Year – 2019.

The facades of modern skyscrapers reflect the sky and the air is filled with the delicate aroma of roses and blackcurrant bushes growing abundantly in the suburbs.. Perfumer – Sarah McCartney Year – 2019.

The heart of the city at the foot of the Ile Alatau is sweet and dear. It is the aroma of rich apples and apricots from the bazaar and a cup of aromatic tea with scenting herbs and mountain honey. It is the exciting aroma of dark chocolate saturating the air around the confectionery factory. It is the wind coming from the mountains and bringing the freshness of the glaciers and the aroma of blossoming apple gardens.. Perfumer – Sarah McCartney Year – 2019. .

listings.rawTitle: Wind of the Great Steppe 95 ml EdP
listings.description: For a Kazakhstani, the smell that embodies happiness and freedom is the scent of a boundless steppe. It is the wind that smells like wormwood, rough and sweet herbs. Stones heated by the sun and soil cracked by the heat. Subtle smell of leather horse harness. Sundried clumps of saxaul. Give yourself away to the wind and soar above the steppe that goes beyond the horizon. Great and blissful.. Perfumer – Sarah McCartney Year – 2019.
