Give yourself away to the wind and soar above the steppe that goes beyond the horizon. Great and blissful.. Perfumer – Sarah McCartney Year – 2019.

The foothills of the Ile Alatau are filled with the aroma of the morning forest. The sun light is striking through the spreading boughs of Schrenk's spruces and warming the covering of dry spruce needles and green young grass. There is a smell in the air of meadow flowers and mushrooms, cold waters of a mountain river and the frosty freshness of glaciers.. Perfumer - Sebastian Martin Year – 2019.

listings.rawTitle: Saga of the Silk Road 95 ml EdP
listings.description: The caravan is crossing the horizonless steppe. It is the caravan from the East. The merchants are carrying spices and perfumes, expensive oils and delicate silk, overseas wood, chinaware, jade statuettes, and precious jewels. The air is filled with the aroma of wormwood and dried grass. The road is going far away beyond the horizon. The caravan is traveling westward.. Perfumer – Sarah McCartney Year – 2019.

listings.rawTitle: The Legend of Tomiris 95 ml EdP
listings.description: In the Great Steppe, for a long time, the legend has been handed down of the proud-hearted Queen Tomyris who defied the great King of the Persians and his invincible army. Until that day, the Steppe has never witnessed a commander and politician of equal power, wisdom, and influence. Her victory turned the world history upside down and forced the whole world to talk respecully and fearfully about the menacing nomad tribes and their proud-hearted warlike Queen.. Perfumer – Angela Ciampagna Year – 2019.

It is the odor of crude oil which is the black gold of Kazakhstan. It is the odor of the wild grasslands of Western Kazakhstan, the salty breeze of the Caspian Sea, petroleum, and ... money. The aromas of salt marsh, dunes, peat, and arid soil of the semi-desert with its sparse vegetation contrast the anthropogenic odors of crude oil processing. . Perfumer - Lucas Sieuzac Year – 2019.

We are united by love. To family, home, Native land .... Love is like a flower - it grows from the bottom of the heart to the light and blooms in its rays.. We want to share with you the beauty of this unique flower that has been blooming in our hearts for 30 years, filling us with joy and warmness. Its sweet scent flows solemnly, sounding like an anthem. Its scarlet petals glow in the light of the sun.. We are happy to present to you an exclusive limited edition dedicated to the 30th anniversary of the Independence of the Republic of Kazakhstan - 30 Years. Special Edition.. Perfumer - Angeline Poubeau (Leporini) Year – 2021.

The virtuous young nun gathers roses from the generous rosebush in the Convent's walled garden. They're beautifully green and floral, caressing the senses to a sinful degree. She pricks herself on the thorns. With labdanum and vetiver she's reminded of the wildness of nature.. Eau d'Epine is a fine woody rose perfume. Rich with soothing amber and herbaceous galbanum..

Perfumer: Julien Plos . The charming and playful dancer warms up before her debut. Talented and passionate she radiates confidence and anticipation. Deliciously, exciting and unexpected. Sweet almond and ripe cherries contrast with sandalwood and vanilla for a floral, sweet and woody intensity. .

Perfumer: Dominique Moellhausen . The young traveller returns, memories of adventures still visceral in the mind. The quest for nirvana never satisfied. Relaxing fumes and plumes of woody smoke follow him. Gentle spices, sweet elemi and enriching patchouli tones give a richness to this aromatic green perfume. .

Perfumer: Frank Voelkl . The charismatic and dashing French sailor steps from his sailboat, the late afternoon breeze ruffles his hair. The atmosphere is warm and salty. With graceful haste he seeks refined refreshment on a beautifully manicured lawn. Suave and impressive. With notes of green grass, sweet freesia and musk. .

Perfumer: Dominique Moellhausen . The spirited country girl arrives in the bustle of the city, determined to change her status to “anything but innocent”. That’s Sweet Lure, bubbling with naughty possibilities. Cinnamon and lily-of-the-valley swirl in a bamboozling haze of neroli and vanilla, keeping things alluring but fun..

Perfumer: Ane Ayo . The iconic, trendsetting fashionista gets ready for the day. With casual elegance she reaches for her perfume bottle. With a love for the unusual this leathery floral scent inspires her originality. Citrus and florals are made richer and more complex with animalic molecules and ambroxan resulting in a sensual and desirous diffusion. .

Perfumer: Dominique Moellhausen. The sexy and impressive urbanite’s work is done for the day. He strides down the street with a nonchalant air, people noticing his clean, aromatic and seductive scent. A confident and cool vibe swirls around him. With sparkling citrus, woody vetiver and rich amber giving a fresh but dark diffusion. .

Perfumer: Ane Ayo . The sensitive and sensuous artist picks up her paintbrush, burning with creativity and beauty. Bright light shines in the studio mirroring the floral and woody scent that surrounds her. Intense and passionate. With peppered lemons, and edible praline giving a sexy edge to the delicate and floral ambery rose. .

THE INSPIRATION. In 1977, the year I was born, Helmut Newton immortalised Charlotte Rampling in a series of photos entitled Venus in Fur. A feline and supersensual woman embodies sexual power: emancipated, she takes possession of her body and asserts her desires. Echoing the sexual revolution and its bohemian patchoulis, the perfumery of the 70s distils a chic eroticism, all in suggestion, where heady white flowers pierced by green, powdery and aldehydic notes anchor the fragrances of this decade in a glamorous sophistication.. THE PERFUME. Dialogue with Venus opens with a white floral accord evoking the luxurious and exacerbated femininity of the 70’s, while its fruity, silky and solar vanilla is treated according to the codes of the House of PIERRE GUILLAUME PARIS. Subtle exotic sprays flow through this floral melody like a wind of freedom, suggesting a mischievous and sexy “je-ne-sais-quoi”, an effortless chic..

You will always want more of this fragrance. The fleeting animality of cumin merges with the warm and powerful cinnamon, and the intense syrupy trail of rum reveals itself to be a fleeting pleasure.. The spicy and generous matriarch, vanilla, in search of vital euphoria, duplicates itself to the point of paroxysm. In its insatiable quest, it drags davana, whose fruity aromatic bipolarity is completed by the warm tones of cistus. Despite all this, it is not enough, the feeling of unfulfillment persists, like the woody ardor of chestnut and the biting character of vetiver. There is still desire, a desire conveyed through the vibrations of amber woods and the technology of Vinyl Gaiacol.. Perfumer: MATHILDE BIJAOUI.

Wandering down to the tennis court, past banks of fresh green grass and a carpet of pine cones on the path; smell the salty breeze from the sea with the dappled sun rays on your back as you walk with the racket in your hand.. Tonic and green notes of refined neroli are combined with marine and sunshine accords to bring this moment of summer into sparkling relief.A burst of freshness warmed by an understated woody musk. Healthy and bright with plenty of fun!.

An opening of citric and fizzy lemon combined with bright lime and bergamot, salty and refreshing, just like those Mediterranean summers.. The sharp salty accord lends further depth and keeps the lemon note true throughout the long-lasting dry down; interspersed with the bright combination of musks and patchouli..

listings.rawTitle: Cockatiel (Special Edition) 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: SPECIAL EDITION IS NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION. The same perfume is available in the regular/standard packaging: Cockatiel .. Perfumer: Sven Pritzkoleit . Australian spring arrives, bearing dazzling frocks of yellow blossoms to dress the bare golden wattle trees. Clouds of sweet honeyed fragrance, caught upon the breeze, carry an invitation inland, where a flock of cockatiels happily take up the celebration. Emerging from dusty nests, the birds are ready to preen and prance. On a wobbly stage of branches, vivid crests bop to the rhythm of their joyous songs. After a final encore, the flock takes flight. Alighting in a nearby field they share a delightful brunch, buzzing with the thrill of their stunning recital.. Zoologist Cockatiel exudes joy. A sunny burst of yellow acacia offers a friendly welcome. Dots of raspberry and tart rhubarb suggest a hint of mischief, like a pair of rosy cheeks beneath a golden plume. Finally, soft notes of musk and vanilla enfold the vibrant Cockatiel, like downy feathers cushioning the brashness of this cheeky bird.. Zoologist Cockatiel was formerly known as “Powder and Dust”, a perfume created by Sven Pritzkoleit, published under his own brand, SP Parfums. The creative director of the scent was Yana Lysenko. This perfume won the 2019 Arts and Olfaction Awards under the Artisan category. In 2020, Sven closed his perfume business and sold the formula of Powder and Dust to Zoologist to continue its legacy..

Neroli is an essential oil produced by steam distillation from the flower of the bitter orange tree, also known as Monsieur Le Bigaradier.. The essence of neroli in this perfume has been carefully sourced by Perris in the sunny Calabrian coast from traditional producers. It’s top quality and has a fresh, slightly bitter, floral character with aromatic nuances.. As if kissed by the sun, caressed by the wind, nourished by the earth and quenched by the sea, Neroli Mediterraneo reveals all the sumptuous citrus and flowery nuances of the Italian neroli made even more sparkling with the help of orange blossom and petitgrain. A touch of Timur pepper and ginger make it even more upbeat. .

A touch of Timur pepper and ginger make it even more upbeat. .

For the lovers of vintage chypres and Murakami’s twisted imaginary worlds.. Nimitr is a classic chypre meticulously following the canonic complexity and list of components. It opens with an aldehydes gala. There is the signature chypre leathery labdanum background and in between there is birch tar, oak moss, civet and a dozen of other dark, smoky and spicy elements.. The conceptual inspiration comes form Murakami’s story of two lonely hearts observing each other and the universe. One with a liking for sartorial elegance and jazz..

listings.rawTitle: Ayutthaya (อยุธยา) 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Ayutthaya was the capital of Siam (present-day Thailand) between the 14 th and 18 th centuries. Once, it was possibly the largest city in the world with over 1 million citizens.. Ayutthaya, the perfume, is a reference to the city’s hay day as the center of trade, culture and diplomacy in the East. Imagine the precious temple incense, spice markets against the back drop gun powder, and the eternal companion of wealth..

listings.rawTitle: Karuna (กรุณา) 30 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Karuna means Kindness / Kind-hearted or mercy in Thai. Karuna base on memories of my childhood. Every Songkarn festival (Thai’s New year) during mid April our family will visit my grand mother elder brother’s house outside city centre where we live. He owned Chinese/ Traditional Thai pharmacy shop. In front of his house there is a temple where we always visit. Karuna is olfactory of Incense from Thai temple in Southern part of Thailand with smell of spices and flowers they always plant around temple such as Camphor, Jasmine Sambac , Canaga , Tuberose , Cassia , Ebony , Champaca etc. And the olfactory of precious woods , spices and herbs from my grand mother elder brother’s pharmacy shop.. As for the memories of festive ,joy and my grand mother kindness is the reason why this perfume is made for..

A stop on the ancient Silk routes, Dunhuang was the foremost trading town to be reached by foreign merchants travelling from the West. To their senses and imagination this oasis in the Gansu-Xinjiang desert would have been truly enchanting, filled with fragrances and flavors worth crossing the world for.. The eponymous perfume is filled with echoes of these times: aromas of temple incense, musky honeyed blossom of Chinese osmanthus, cured tea, spices and dried fruit..

Base on Thai's dessert called "Kanom Jaak" made from rice powder , palm sugar , coconut milk ,coconut flakes and pandan leaf. Grilled on Nipa palm leave.. Kanom means dessert in Thai. Jaak means Nipa palm leaves also synonym for goodbye or farewell.. Years ago, Kanom Jaak used to be well known dessert. You could find it almost everywhere but recently I think I hard to find one. I’m not sure why. Maybe because Nipa palm may difficult to source. It’s not one of my favourite dessert. Just another of childhood’s memories.. Sweet farewell is woody green gourmand base with dominate notes of tea-like from Nipa palm leaves , Milky Coconut , rice powder , sweetness from palm sugar , unique.

Limonsitano mixes the aromas of chilled Limon cello and sunset nature in Tuscany’s Po sitano . It’s a soft, relaxed citrus perfume with a pinch of fresh Mediterranean herbs and elusive aroma of an old wooden wharf seasoned with sea salt.. Strangers also love adding a cinematic reference for their stories. Limonsitano is related to two scenes in Under the Tuscan Sun , in which the main character first finds hope and then peace. .

MM is a defining fragrance in Molinard's collection, reformulated in 2004 it is a mix of classic French chic and contemporary cool. A contemplative moment in the heart of a French city. Subtly spicy nutmeg, incense and cedar blends to amber nuances with teak wood and musk. Conjuring a daring soul with an elegant spirit..

Madrigal harks back to Molinard's masculin fragrances of the 1930s. Citrusy and aromatic with notes of lemon and lavender, With woody tones Madrigal is a step away from sunny Provence, towards the chic French autumn. A multitude of cosy and enveloping moments created with notes of incense, cedar and patchouli..

Campus is the 'bon vivant' moment in Molinard's historical collection, first created in 2004 it sparks adventurous pineapple and calms into luxurious tones of Provençal Lavender. It conjures an air of freedom and elegance. Beautiful geranium and woody notes from amber and sandalwood makes Campus nothing short of charm in perfume form..

Vents & Marrées whafts a gentle veil of fresh sweetness; ethereal and sunny. In this perfume Molinard conjures a romantic rendezvous on the beach. A couple lulled by the gentle melody of the waves; with rose and marine accord. A delicate harmony of sea spray with the elegance of white flowers and a sweet moment remembered by the gourmand presence of vanilla..

Miréa brings the wearer a delicious dose of Riviera sun. The fruity, musky notes create a classic Molinard moment. A delicious gourmand scent by way of lychee, fressia and vanilla that smells like sophisticated spun-sugar. Miréa is a name with an allegorical allure signalling an olfactory delight; a scent that truly enchants the senses..

Iles d’Or conjures Molinard's connection to the Mediterranean’s azure waters and the southern coasts of Provence. Guided by the scents of the dense Provençal maquis, this delightfully bright fern centred perfume explores the heated mix of lavender, sarsaparilla, and heather. With bright citrus and a floral essence one feels a siren song to this island of paradise..

Sileno or Silenus in Greek (or faun in Roman) mythology would be a creature of the wild forest – part man part beast. Silenus would accompany and entertain Dionysus in his god’s routines and parties. . The perfume is a sensual but fresh ylang-ylang with a generous crisp spices layer. .

The Mediterranean freshness of the essence, whose citrus notes are accompanied by the sensuality of damask rose, sublimating in sinuous oriental echoes, is inspired by the colour that has made the frescoes of Pompeian domes famous and unmistakable all over the world.. The pigment obtained from the mineral cinnabar, Rossopompeiano, emblem of a part of the history the perfumer Agatho’s city, becomes a perfume..

In fleeting top notes Myrtle, fragile as the promises of love, encounters the preciousness of saffron, merging into an indomitable desire for eros.. The luxuriant notes of honey are exalted by the jasmine night breeze that pervades the home of the chaste lovers, among the frescoes, on a thalamus of rose petals.. The mysterious notes of incense and sweet vanilla blend with the oriental contamination of amber and labdanum that fades into the ancient aroma of agar wood, sealing the essence of Castiamanti, expression of rich Pompeii..

It is the energy of myth and the elegance of the garden that inspire a refined and vigorous essence.. Bergamot and juniper berries become full-bodied on a carpet of incense, fading into the persistent fascination of oriental wood.. The presence of a marble Hercules in the garden of the perfumer’s house, triumph of courage and immortality, elevates to myth the creations of Agatho and the Giardinodiercole becomes a perfume..

Rest in the blissful shade of an orchard in the humming city of Pompeii: the year is 195 BC. Inhale the sweet aroma of ripe figs and the local pomegranate leaves heated by the sun; these entine spicy incense being smoked in the nearby temple. So anciently refreshing!. .

An essence whose floral and enveloping notes are rooted in myth, which plays with hypnotizing the senses like the young and beautiful Adonis against Aphrodite. Releasing the freshness of the flowers of wisteria, jasmine, geranium, damask rose, and white lily, this essence interprets and expresses the beautiful and damned Adonis, like a flower of short life that: “badly fixed to the ground and too fragile lightness owes its name to the wind and the wind just scatters its petals ”..

In Fauno ancient fires reflect off the bronze statures of Roman deities depicting Bacchus feasting in company of fauns, satyrs and nymphs.. The perfume is a smoky echo of the Pompei mysteries lit with torches, perfumed with spicy incense and fragrant herbs..

Inspired by Moby Dick this perfume is the scented expression of that famous novel about nature vs man, storms, hardship, freedom and friendship. Conjuring wooden ships, rough seas, wet rope, candlelight and old parchment.. . Ambergris forms the centerpiece of this sophisticated scent. And is complimented by the ethereal osmanthus and orris intent on conjuring a 'candlelight at sea' nuance. Cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli offer rich, woody and leathery notes to the exceptional sea salt tones. This is a beautiful, intriguing and elegant marine fragrance. . . . . . . . . .

Sleight of Fern offers a modern take on fougère . It is at once elegant and distinctive and sensual. A charming reminder of ages gone by whilst offering an unexpected 'cool' diffusion. Fresh with mint and rose, this fragrance is balanced with the depth of tuberose and narcissus, creating a crispy citrus and herbaceous edge. Facets of french lavender gently lead with confidence to a stylish, vibrating and refined woody leathery base, where birch wood echoes with red thyme and oregano..

listings.rawTitle: Sacred Scarab 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The dogged prospector strikes gold. Upon discovering a payload rich with nutrients, the scarab returns home. Face down, guided by the sun, it propels the tightly-packed dung backwards to a burrow lined with dusky spheres. Underground, it tunnels into the ball to deposit a precious egg. In time, the larva hatches and feeds, until it emerges, fully formed, and instinct drives it down the same dusty trail to repeat the cycle.. Like Egyptians entrusting sacred mummies to tombs for the journey to the next life, a scarab burying its treasure marks the dawn of new life. Zoologist Sacred Scarab captures the mystique of Kyphi incense, a blend of blue lotus, raisins, plums, olibanum, myrrh, and juniper. Once bound with wine and burned in ancient rituals, today this divine scent guides your spirit on a path to discovery and rebirth.. Perfumer: Sultan Pasha.

listings.rawTitle: La Dame Aux Camélias 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Inspired by the Alexander Dumas novel and the subsequent opera La Traviata, La Dame Aux Camélias, is based on the protagonist Violet Valery. Such is the delicate, powdery violet diffusion of this floral perfume. With ambergris, grapefruit and bergamot, the powerdary nature is expertly balanced to offer musk and citrusy tones to the rose and sweet honey. .

Inspired by the great English socialite's arrival in Paris, Cora Pearl is sumptuous, unique, decadent and 'pretty'. Bergamot and cardamom at the opening offer woody citruses notes. The heart, like Cora Pearl's, is curious and diffusive with rich leathery violet. The dry down is dry and somewhat bitter vetiver. .

Inspired by the Spanish courtesan, dancer and famous beauty, Caroline Otero, this perfume is both mercurial and delicious. It is at once floral with lavender, narcissus and violet as well as woody with sandalwood and fig. Ginger and neroli are balanced with orris to create a soft peppery and sweet leather note that is both delectable and sophisticated. .

Inspired by the famous ballerina and glamour girl, Cléopâtre-Diane de Mérode, this perfume is beauty in a bottle. Joyful yet delicate rosewood, rose and ylang-ylang offer sophisticated floral notes. The fruitiness is created by bergamot, lychee and soft cotton flower, giving a sophisticated tone. .

La Castiglione is inspired by the famous Italian countess and mistress of Napoleon, Virginia Oldoini. Like the woman, this scent is sultry and stylish with musk notes from ambergris and herbaceous woody tones from mugwort. Patchouli and cedarwood offer unique woody and floral tones that serve the regal elegance of such a formidable and promiscuous woman. .

Jardin’s d’Ecrivains presents a new scented story inspired by Baltasar del Alcázar the comic Spanish poet. Like the man this diffusive scent is zesty with notes of mint, orange and grapefruit. The warmth of the Spanish sun is denoted with tones of elemi, neroli and patchouli. Such composition offers a delightfully fresh and green fragrance that is wonderfully refreshing and cool. .

In its formula the zesty current mingles with delicious green notes of basil, aniseed and fennel. . Natural ingredients (95%):. Lively and full of contrasts, Dancing Light is a reflection of the northern lights that inspired it. Icy mint and Siberian pine needles bring a breath of coolness. Then a bouquet of bright white flowers with jasmine, neroli and seringa, dances in the heart warmed by the sandalwood. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur.

Lively and full of contrasts, Dancing Light is a reflection of the northern lights that inspired it. Icy mint and Siberian pine needles bring a breath of coolness. Then a bouquet of bright white flowers with jasmine, neroli and seringa, dances in the heart warmed by the sandalwood. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur.

Perfumer: Marie Salamagne. A fresh start… of the day, season, or in life (a reference to innocent and sweet childhood).. Riviera Sunrise is a sunny delicious citrus blend featuring lemons, sweet oranges and mandarins floating above the freshness of basil, fig and cedar. . .

This is a portrait of eternal elegance and refinement.. This sophisticated fragrance revisits the essence of vetiver. The mysterious and charming facets of this scent reveal the graceful but vigorous nature of the beauty and versatility of vetiver. The noble ingredient palette used in this creation is acknowledged from the fresh start, through to the velvety, leathery heart, to reach its full woody core.. Perfumer : Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy.

The purity of nature is captured in this original fragrance. The fresh ganja flower is sublimated by a modern chamomile-rhubarbe accord. Saffron and suede accentuate the elegant warmth. The base notes of incense, oud, black amber and precious woods create a sophisticated nuance.. Perfumer : Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy.

This is an olfactory delight, to be worn day or night!. Composed with a delicious oriental-floral-gourmand accord ths scent is enticing from the first hit of spiced rose and coffee liquor. Hazelnut gives sophisticated accents to the orris powder, vanilla and musk. A fragrant delight for day or for night, a narcotic, guilty pleasure to succumb to without limit…. Perfumer: Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy.

An ode to the most noble flowers in perfume. This is an exquisite composition that denotes the floral symbol of femininity, love, passion, adoration and admiration.. Citrusy freshness mixed with jasmine, freesia and violet and lily, Lys Nobilis offers a beautifully refined scent with a lasting effect.. Perfumer: Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy. .

Jules et Mad brings a fresh take on the iconic bergamot note.. This fragrance is a celebration of the perpetuating beautiful scent of bergamot, Enhanced with the essential oils of lavender and labdanum, and sustained by the rich amber accord Bergamot Twist becomes a captivating chypre.. Perfumer: Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy.

A modern citrus with long-lasting freshness and modern elegance.. WIth the essential oil of citron (Citrus medica), the scent offers an enhanced freshness and natural character. Bergamot and sweet lime brings an exquisite richness to the top note, along with the coolness of the ginger, for an invigorating, uplifting effect. Woody notes are given by the white amber offering a sophisticated yet fun vibe.. Perfumer : Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy.

Revelo is a beautifully crafted sensual musk. An innovative formulation that will extend and enhance the longevity of your scent.. Revelo's can be used as a soft, second-skin fragrance; as a base under all Jul et Mad Paris fragrances; or, as desired, combined with any other perfume give more sillage, while accentuating its beauty.. Perfumer: Luca Maffei, Atelier Fragranze Milano – Italy.

Perfumer: Alexis Dadier. A beautiful dedication to iris and the alluring woody powdery aroma extracted from its rhizomes. Rhizomes are the flower’s creeping rootstalks which it sends under the ground to spread around.. It takes about 1000 kg of dry rhizomes (carefully dried and cured for 4 years) to produce just 2 kg of iris butter (also called orris).. It’s truly precious - Marie Jeanne spent about a year going through 160 attempts before arriving at their perfect blend of several iris extracts: butter of iris Florentina and iris Pallida and absolute of iris Germanica . Absolutes are derived from butter to achieve a fresher character.. Their goal was to create a modern, refined iris perfume and to depart from dated powdery violet interpretations.. Very few perfume houses have access to the ingredients of the same caliber that Marie Jeanne have used so generously in their Iris Pallida. The perfume is 28% strong, very diffusive but at the same time tantalizingly delicate.. The crown jewel of the formula, the blend of orris extracts, is set on a pedestal of sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver. Iris Pallida is an elegant and sensual modern iris perfume, meticulously blended from the most refined raw materials available to perfumers at the moment. .

a collaboration with Freddie Albrighton. “I started Canvas by visualising ink (which is my medium as a tattoo artist), as black liquorice - liquefying it and adding colourful translucency with raspberry leaf, a wash of herbal notes and gauzy, painterly florals of rose and peony. Rather than create a “blank canvas”, I wanted to create a perfume that captured the possibilities of what the canvas could be - a kaleidoscope of watercolour, soft textures and contrasting elements.” — Freddie Albrighton.

Figuier Noir is a beautifully composed, delicious and sophisticated perfume which highlights different modes of fig at every layer; this is an exceptional example of fig in fragrance.. At the top, fig leaves are weaved with cardamom, cloves and black pepper for a warm and spicy opening. The fruity heart is produced by ripe black fig, jasmine and orris root. The base notes are carefully constructed with cedarwood, patchouli and sweet candied figs giving the everlasting richness of fruits and woods.. Celine Ellena, the perfumer was inspired by her time in Grasse as she experienced the beginnings of the French summer and the blooming of fig trees and their diffusive sensuous, bitter and green perfume. The intention is masculine but the scent is a perfectly unisex.... Intensity and diffusiveness: above average..

The iris powder accord, incense and vanilla suggest intelligence and power. Whilst the itauba wood and carefully infused white tea gives a refreshing yet exotic complexity to this remarkable perfume..

The exotic scent of shiso leaves enhances the note with a singular spicy freshness. This perfume is both unexpected and highly desirable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Stairway to Heaven 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The astonishingly rich fragrance is built around a complex range of 8 white musks, for a luminous “second-skin” perfume, veritable mantle of softness and lightness. This original composition is characterized by a dual whiteness: pure and immaculate, but warming and enveloping. A slightly gourmand and fruity accord contributes to its addictive effect, while elegant accents of precious woods, amber and incense complete in a most lavish manner this perfect unisex formulation.. Parfumeur : Cécile Zarokian.

listings.rawTitle: Terrasse à St-Germain 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: A perfume as elegant as it is sophisticated. The composition is a complex blend of splendid wood and musk accord, gracefully embracing its initial freshness. This perfume encapsulates a perfect duality of classical and modern modes. Masculine and feminine, strangely familiar but also extraordinary!. Parfumeur: Dorothée Piot.

listings.rawTitle: Aqua Sextius 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Top notes of grapefruit and bergamot offer a sensation of well-being and joy. The extraordinary freshness is promised by the composition of mint and eucalyptus. Named after the original Latin name of Aix-en-Provence, known as the city of 100 fountains, this fragrance perfectly describes this most beautiful summer retreat, where the time flows in the rhythm of its legendary thermal sources.. Parfumeur : Cécile Zarokian.

listings.rawTitle: Amour de Palazzo 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: This rich fragrance is built around a complex range of 8 white musks, creating a luminous “second-skin” scent. The freshness is conjured by the beautiful bergamot and orange. The gourmand and fruit accord comprised of Bulgarian rose, patchouli and the soft richness of frankincense gives a beautifully addictive effect making this a perfect unisex formulation.. Parfumeur: Dorothée Piot.

listings.rawTitle: Bella Donna 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: The beautiful ginger and bergamot notes are weighted with white, soft florals to give a truly romantic scent. The composition of the Magnolia Alba flower is used in tribute to one of the world’s most intriguing feminine portraits, “La Belle Ferronnière”, by Leonardo Da Vinci. The base notes of sandalwood and saffron encourage a deep richness to the blend.. Parfumeur : Luca Maffei.

listings.rawTitle: Mon Seul Desir 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Inspired by the last of the famous series of six tapestries, La Dame à la Licorne (The Lady and the Unicorn), this scent offers a rich interpretation of the Osmanthus flower. With a chorus of musk, amber and leather Mon Seul Desir is affectingly sensual, rich and fascinating.. Parfumeur : Stéphanie Bakouche.

This floral-gourmand accord is created with a perfect partnership of vanilla and patchouli base notes and jasmine and plum at the heart. The opening offers an exquisitely refined oriental accord with dates and pomegranate to conjure the glory of the Byzantine era.. Parfumeur : Luca Maffei.

Inspired by the greatness of the Angkor civilization, Geruda is a flawless representation of the extraordinary petrified city deep in a Laos jungle. With a golden theme, Cambodian oud, amber, orange and saffron, this composition is the temple’s pure reflection of elegance, refinement and opulence.. Parfumeur : Luca Maffei.
A huge rose with a generous helping of sweet fruit, inspired by the hanging gardens of Babylon and named after the Sumerian goddess of plants - Ninšar.. Parfumeur: Sidonie Lancesseur.

listings.rawTitle: Fugit Amor 50 ml Extrait de Parfum

Punctuated with spicy accents that reveal a fresh, crystalline note for a perfectly unisex scent. Green and woody notes underscore a seductive musk for exceptional longevity.. Perfumer: Chris Maurice. From the master perfume responsible for most of the Xerjoff range, Moon Glade is a very unconventional take on lavender. The perfumer added a charred coconut shell nuance and poured sweet peach compote to the clean musky vibes of the herb..
An elegant, ambrosial, floral perfume scored in effervescent citrus tonalities honors the eminent orange tree, cherished by Europe's royal courts throughout the epochs.. .

Balmy sunlight trips across foamy turquoise waves, sending rippling haloes onto the coral below. On the lagoon floor, anemone and seaweed sway in unison, limbs pumping to the rhythm of the current. Hovering among the coral branches, a group of seahorses gazes shyly on. The pulsating beat calls to them and two pair off, their tails entwined in a delicate waltz. Soon their passion is spent, but the memory of the dance lives on. For the pouch of the male seahorse tenderly cradles a precious clutch of eggs. . Zoologist Seahorse invites you to wade through a vibrant coral garden. This unisex scent turns expectation on its head. With such surprising couplets as tuberose and seaweed, sage and neroli, and fennel and vetiver, this delightful melody will sweep you away on a wave of joy and abandon.. Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet.

listings.rawTitle: Extrait Noir 30 ml Extrait de Parfum

Iridescent vibes of violet leaves, orange blossom and sweet jasmine from Grasse. The beautiful ylang-ylang is combined with green tuberose and softened with peru-balm to bring a gently sweet and addictive fragrance.. By Philippine Courtière.

With the rich accords of ambergris, frankincense and sandalwood the floral nature of the rose becomes rich and sensual.. By Philippine Courtière.

Empowering and addictive with an opening of rich spices, swiftly followed by green cedar and bright florals, before melting into a blissful sweet and ambery diffusion. This scent is enigmatic and luxurious.. By Philippine Courtière .

listings.rawTitle: Ambre Nomade 50 ml Extrait de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Eau Papaguéna 50 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Eau Papaguéna is one of those unique citrus formulas that last.. Here the trick is actually to use the blossom not the zest. On top of that, the citrus notes are encased in ambroxan, which protects and highlights the freshness of grapefruit and orange flowers.. In addition, there is the supporting base layer of green freshness: basil, tarragon, cypress and vetiver.. The name: Eau Papaguéna can be interpreted as Papageno’s cologne. He is a character from Mozart’s Magic Flute. He catches birds for the Queen of the Night. In return, he receives daily food and drink from her, and not in short supply: he is allowed to fill his stomach with wine and sugar bread. . By Pierre Negrin .

Perfumer: Alexandra Carlin. An ambery floral universe carefully put together with stunning night blooming flowers.. The formula features an accord of Galant de Nuit, also called night blooming jasmine (technically not a jasmine, but a plant closer related to potatoes). This gentle flower cannot be distilled, but its captivating fragrance has been recreated for Bloomastral with the help of a very specific jasmine variety. The perfumer used a particular jasmine which can only be harvested in Egypt within the space of two weeks in August. There is also a delicious, fruity and honeyed osmanthus theme. Finally, the oud oil adds extra mystery and darkness to the story.. Skunks tincture is made by macerating fresh skunk glands. The animals are trapped for their fur. Processing their scent glands makes a useful product out of something that would otherwise be discarded.. limited edition of 2 batches. Around 200 bottles will be made. Due to the very high percentage of natural materials, each batch may be slightly different..

Oqachol rousingly opens with vigorous fruity deep green citrus with Osmanthus absolute, petitgrain mandarin, blackcurrant absolute, yuzu and violet leaf. Then plenty dose of colourful materials from florals, herbs to spices provide the image of a golden sunset masquerade introducing the star of the show which is the golden ambergris from New Zealand.. Contain animal products (Deer Musk) legally harvest on quotas provided by the government.. Ambergris is a waste product of sperm whales that occur naturally collecting from the beach or sea.. limited edition of 2 batches. Around 200 bottles will be made. listings.rawTitle: Onthamara อนธมาร (Discontinued) 30 ml Parfum

Oriental part with Thai oud, resins and rare smoky Amber Fossil from Himalayan. And a heavy dose of Animalic part as the main star such Siberian Deer Musk, Hyrax Absolute, Beeswax absolute and castoreum.. Onthamara will transport you to the deep darkest ancient forest surrounded by savage nocturnal animals.. Contain animal products legally harvest on quotas provided by the government.. limited edition of 3 batches. Around 300 bottles will be made. Due to the very high percentage of natural materials, each batch may be slightly different..

listings.rawTitle: Cow (Limited Edition) 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Perfumer: Nathalie Feisthauer . Lush green pastures tumble toward the horizon, arching beneath the imposing silhouette of a mountain range. Cumulus clouds roll across a bright blue sky, their massive shadows gliding over a peacefully grazing herd. In a corner of the meadow, a tiny calf braces quivering limbs and, with a mighty lurch, stumbles up to take its maiden steps. Its velvet snout prods, rooting at its mother, until the release of warm milk signals a satisfying welcome to this vast new world.. Zoologist Cow brings to mind a bucolic scene, a myriad of scents from Mother Nature’s nurturing bosom. Innocent florals sway among soft grasses, while apple gently sweetens the soft aroma of fresh milk. The result is a place both familiar and reassuring, where warm arms unfold to welcome us into a loving embrace. A place called home..

Iris des Champs. Sacred to the Egyptians, the emblem of French Royalty and the symbol of Tuscany's Florence; the iris is a noble plant with elegant, purple flowers. Houbigant's Iris des Champs is a perfect homage to this bountiful and characterful plant.. Surprisingly, it is not its sublime flower but its earthy roots that hold olfactory treasures. It's these rhizomes, or roots, that contain irone, a unique and rich molecule that denotes the fragrance of iris; Iris des Champs is a floral interpretation of the flower. The perfume ouverture evokes the freshness of the morning dew with bergamot, lily of the valley and pink pepper. The sensual heart offers an alluring bouquet of iris, rose, jasmine sambac and ylang ylang. And the velvety smooth finale concludes with warm and woody tones.. Iris des Champs transports you to the Tuscan iris fields on a bright spring day..

listings.rawTitle: Iris des Champs Extrait (Discontinued) 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: An exquisite, pure essence extract of the incomparable, enrapturing, noble iris accord redolent of blossomed, Tuscan meadows, velvety petals and sensual, woody cadences.. IRIS DES CHAMPS: THE CONCEPT Iris is a plant with elegant and stylish flowers that conceals a hidden treasure. Already considered sacred by the Egyptians, the iris became, under the heraldic name of Lily, the symbol of royalty in France. Surprisingly, it is not its sublime flower but its underground part that holds this olfactory treasure; the rhizomes, the roots of the flowers contain the Irone, a unique fragrant and rich molecule that makes up the iris notes. The flower itself has no smell. Many perfumers have worked with this fabulous raw material, unveiling its earthy facets but none of them has given thought to what the smell of the flower should be. Houbigant has taken a completely different approach by creating an olfactory interpretation of the flower. The perfume ouverture evokes the freshness of the morning dew with bergamot, lily of the valley and pink pepper. The sensual hart pulses with an alluring bouquet of iris, rose, jasmin sambac and ylang ylang. The velvety smooth finale concludes with warm and woody notes. .

Created by Master Perfumer Paul Parquet in 1882, Fougère Royale completely revolutionized the world of perfumes and established modern perfumery as it exists today. As well as creating an entirely new fragrance family, Parquet had succeeded in extracting isolated, synthetic molecules from natural, raw materials. In the dedicated pursuit to expand olfactory palettes with novel, new aromas, he’d derived coumarin from the tonka bean in a worldwide premiere. In its mission to authentically replicate the original, regal masterpiece from centuries past, the reengineered formula cultivates refined, prestigious raw materials of the highest quality and provenance. This masterfully revamped Fougère Royale retains its elegant, noble, refined pulse and its pleasant, pastoral beauty.. The perfectly-blended perfume is redolent of green and fragrant foliage with densely shaded woodlands. Sweet green grasses suggest the freshly-released essences of a crushed and dewy verdure, with an intense hint of newly-mown hay.. Fougère Royale’s nuanced scent composition opens with a vibrant, sparkling cocktail of bergamot, lavender and Mediterranean herbs. The heart follows, with floral-spicy Rondeletia accord, rare in most perfumes. Opening into rich geranium and warm spices. A floral intermezzo showcases rare rose essences and absolutes, spiked by pepper, cinnamon and carnation. Finally, a grand finale of earthy, ambery and woody harmonies, where moss notes join a sensual patchouli enriched by warm coumarinic undertones of tonka beans and clary sage absolute..

Perfumer: Carlos Benaim. Beso Feliz, or happy kiss in English, conveys peace and harmony. As does this beautifully constructed fragrance from Beso Beach. Created with the hippy and beachy vibes of Ibiza in mind, clary sage mirrors driftwood floating in the sea, with bright green vetiver offering refreshing and vibrant notes. True tranquility is offered in the cannabis accord which serves this peppery, fruity and green scent. Beso Feliz brings you all the beautiful, hippy harmony of Ibiza in one bottle. Relax and feel all the positive energy..

Lukomorie exists in two dimensions: dreamy and real. Geographically it is situated on the shores of the Baltic Sea where dark forests are reflected in the grey waves. In the magical dimension of folklore, it is the land where witches brew sweet potions in the deep of the forest, mermaids splash and a wise cat tells stories while sitting under a giant oak. Carner adds a scented dimension: with salty, zesty and fresh notes combined with sweet berries and a caramel trail leading to a sensual musky haze..

AD 134, Villa Adriana, Tivoli, Italy. . The nape of the neck, the idealized scent of a lover and a lost embrace. Peau is based on Roman Emperor Hadrian's memories of Antinoös, his lost lover. The soft, salty and musky scent is an evocation of youth and life. From top, heart and base notes, it includes in itself the promise of intimacy and the indescribable memory of skin.. Peau is the olfactive restoration of the human body, a sublime epitaph through our sense of smell. It’s soft cruelty lies in its evocation of youth, thus life, which by nature is impermanent. From top, heart and base notes, it includes in itself the fullest promise the full spectrum of life, from beginning to end.. In this description we have included the fascinating history behind Arquiste's concept for Peau: It starts with an Imperial romance: The reign of emperor Hadrian in AD 117-38 was marked by military campaigns and building projects, including the famous wall across the north of England at the edge of the Roman Empire. Hadrian had married into the imperial family, but in his late forties he met a Greek youth named Antinoös (or Antinous) from Bithynia, now in modern Turkey, possibly during a tour of the province in AD 123. The young ephebe became the emperor’s lover.. Hadrian founded a city called Antinoopolis at the place where his lover died, and made him into a god- an honor usually reserved for member’s of the emperor’s family. Hadrian publicly commemorated Antinoös in huge numbers of statues, figures, portraits and coins across the known Roman world, an almost unparalleled memorial to a lost love.. Against pessimism, the virtue of melancholy lies in defining a memory against the “dark void”. A memory can be compared to a portrait defined in our mind like the fine lines of shapes and figures against an opaque background. The memory of a loved one, of their skin, of an idealized memory or experience, remains in our minds longer than the actual material body it evokes. This is also the memory of something lost. In the Antique world, the spiritual world takes the shape of man: preserving the contours of its physical presence, i.e. the human body, is the only way to memorialize it through the passing of centuries..

Molinard takes you on a journey far away, through arid and exotic landscapes. Across these expanses of sandy soil grows a dense carpet of tall, straw-green grasses with an intriguing appearance. Vétiver arouses curiosity, appearing to float in the air while being rooted deep in the earth, omnipresent yet insignificant.. The opening notes are fresh and luminous, shot through with sparkling grapefruit and bitter orange. The heart of amber, lavender, and violet intensify the fragrance before giving way to vetiver. The intertwining roots from Java and Haïti open up to release fresh citrusy scents, woody, and delicate smoky notes all at once, with a powerful and elegant trail.. An evocative kaleidoscope of aromas within a single substance celebrated in a modern scent for men and women alike..

listings.description: Designed by Dali after the face of the Aphrodite of Knidos, the legendary lips bottle uses black to highlight the precious elixir held within.. The first Salvador Dali fragrance, with a harmonious blend of rose and jasmine and an especially sophisticated Chypre side, is more intense with a higher concentration.. A single drop of perfume extract for an infinite sillage....

First launched in 1983 in a crystal numbered limited edition, this first fragrance by Salvador Dali made a splash. Just two years later, it would be released in fragrance shops with a glass bottle that would become THE iconic Parfums Salvador Dali sculptured bottle.. A Dali perfume masterpiece, inspired by the voluptuous lips and regal nose of the goddess Aphrodite whose portrait he had just completed.. Salvador Dali dedicated the fragrance to Gala, the love of his life and eternal muse. So, the scent is a floral bouquet of jasmine and rose, Gala's favorite flower. A feminine fragrance with character, created in the purest tradition of opulent floral Chypre perfumes..

A fragrant invitation to the fresh outdoors created from lavender, lemon, sage and wild harvested rosemary supported by fir and pine resins. A beautiful aromatic journey.. This blend is part of the Bravanariz limited edition olfactive experiments, only 50 bottles of each batch are ever made, based on the wild aromatic landscapes beyond IFRA regulations.. This is not a conventional perfume. It's a fragrant story you can sniff from the cuff of your jacket, from a blotter lying on your desk. You can, of course, invent your own way to enter this space, leaving mundane and ordinary behind.. These Bravanariz olfactory digressions are 100% natural and are made from herbs, woods and flowers collected in the Spanish Emporda natural park where the house is based. These blends are wild, literally made from wild flora and wild in terms of not complying with mass market regulations and fashion.. IMPORTANT NOTE: This is not “a perfume”. It is an Olfactory Digression, and is blended by Bravanariz to be a different olfactory and sensory experience compared to “perfumes”. It does not comply with the IFRA standards, and for that reason is not recommended for topical (direct application to skin) use. Please spray on fabric (scarf, sleeve, etc.) to experience. .

listings.rawTitle: Seahorse (Limited Edition) 60 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: Balmy sunlight trips across foamy turquoise waves, sending rippling haloes onto the coral below. On the lagoon floor, anemone and seaweed sway in unison, limbs pumping to the rhythm of the current. Hovering among the coral branches, a group of seahorses gazes shyly on. The pulsating beat calls to them and two pair off, their tails entwined in a delicate waltz. Soon their passion is spent, but the memory of the dance lives on. For the pouch of the male seahorse tenderly cradles a precious clutch of eggs. . Zoologist Seahorse invites you to wade through a vibrant coral garden. This unisex scent turns expectation on its head. With such surprising couplets as tuberose and seaweed, sage and neroli, and fennel and vetiver, this delightful melody will sweep you away on a wave of joy and abandon.. Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet.

listings.rawTitle: Fox in the Flowerbed 50 ml EdP
listings.description: Bio: Rescued from obscurity by students who tracked down the reclusive author at a remote cabin in the Austrian Alps, this collection of alpine fairy tales marks the return of enigmatic writer, Chunhua Luli. The main characters in these stories are wild animals but the tender lessons they impart cut straight to the heart of the human condition. In the titular story, a young fox becomes obsessed with a butterfly, only to learn the hazards of infatuation. Other themes explored include the advantages of unflagging ambition, the importance and impact of beautiful objects, the pursuit of serenity, and the power of positive thinking. Forty years after her remarkable debut, Luli once again reminds us we are all animals, connected by an expansive and ever-changing ecosystem much larger than ourselves.. When to Wear: Wearing this floral wonder will amplify the beauty in everything. It’s a versatile scent, doubling as a mood-lifter during the day and bringing an ethereal elegance to nights out. Don't be led astray by the name, there is nothing animalic or off-putting about this scent..

This is a super potent and grand ouds blend from Prin. Anatolia Anatolia has the strength of 49% 'pure parfum' which makes it one of the most concentrated fragrances in Bloom’s collection. Moreover, it features very intense dramatic materials: ouds from Thailand and India, incense, spices and much more..

Euphoria: a feeling of great (exaggerated) happiness. A concentrated formula infused with vanilla absolute, rum, an array of sweet condiments and honey to conjure up a fragrant equivalent of a first love elated state..

listings.rawTitle: AG arts & crafts 100 ml Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: If you wish to order sample this perfumer please order samples on the page of AG Classic . AG is a totally self-referential work built on notes and inspirations that from the very beginning has been the basis of his quests into the olfactory universe. . Resins, woods, flowers, aldehydes together with rare and hard to find raw materials are combined into a phantasmagorical creation, extremely dense and concentrate forever changing on the skin, unveiling unpredictable facets of a complex personality.. The perfume itself is an ode to an imaginary world that the perfumer built in years of research and experimentation, a world made of contrasts and juxtapositions filled with surprising and conceptual ideas.. AG opens with a dense citrus accord together with green sparkling notes, it quickly fades into a complex bouquet of carnal white leaking flowers. A sharp and thorny rose fights against an imaginary jasmine, gardenia and ylang ylang’s bush fiercely standing in the middle of a blooming field. On this field’s boundary a verdant forest rises with its grand cedarwood trees, cypresses, junipers and oaks beckoning you inside. Once inside the wood a thick smell of resins and moist mosses lead the senses to a comfortable grotto where they calm down (fall asleep) hugged by the sacred heat of amber notes and incense clouds.. The AG perfume project is a limited edition. The AG perfume project was produced in 66 classic bottles - 50 ml and in a special "arts&crafts" edition of 33 special bottles - 100 ml. . THE CERAMIC CAP by Livio Scarpella Each ceramic cap is a unique sculpture of its own, being entirely hand modelled. They are enriched with irregular variations of form, giving an organic effect that pleases the eye and the touch. The cap is made using the Third Firing ceramic technique. The white and the oxidized copper glazes on the surface of the cap create random effects resembling seaweed, moss and lichen. In the third firing the pure gold details on the insect shape are added. Livio Scarpella is an Italian contemporary artist who has received many awards and recognitions in the past decades. He won first prize at the Mediterranea Biennale in 2005 and he was invited to exhibit his work at the the 54th Venice Biennale in 2011. His work has been used for book covers and magazines illustrations. Livio is a painter and a sculpture living in Brescia (Italy). His art combines extremely refined technical skills rooted in a grand artistic tradition with a very personal and contemporary sensory view of reality. THE SILK HANDKERCHIEF by Maria Francesca Broggini The handkerchief is made with pure Shantung silk, hand dyed with tea. Bogue-profumo’s signature insect icon is hand embroidered with threads and purls made of 24 kt gold, using an ancient technique of Goldwork embroidery. The embroidery itself is a real jewel. On each handkerchief the bug is positioned in a different spot, making it unique. Maria Francesca Broggini is the textile artist behind Aembrosia Luxury embroidery: she designs and embroiders every creation herself in her atelier in Monza (Italy). She takes an artistic approach to embroidery and brings to it a personal and poetic twist. Maria Francesca creates fragments of beauty, using the most ancient and prestigious techniques of hand embroidery in a creative and contemporary way. Goldwork embroidery has been used since the middle ages to adorn coronation and Papal robes..

«I have been smelling different qualities of vetiver – Haiti, Bourbon – with bold and intense scents, but too clean, transparent, linear. Then, I lingered over a vetiver from the island of Java, less used in perfumery, which I found intriguing, pungent, smoky, burned-like, with surprising floral, green and spicy nuances. It wasn’t love at first sight, but at the end the arrogance of its intensity conquered me.». Gian Luca Perris.

Theme N°29 : Hesperimental . An experiment in citruses effect, ITABAÏA is the latest addition to the hesperidic genre in Pierre Guillaume's collection. It holds fresh and fruity notes that are barely concealed by the wisps of an illicit spliff: it has a neo-chypre air thanks to the hemp and vanilla accords.. Like it’s name; ITABAÏA was created by the perfumer with elegance and mystery in mind. Both the word and the perfume impresses with an exotic sound and smell, evoking Brazil, dance, a divinity…. Pierre Guillaume was inspired by the strength and energy associated with Capoeira; the Afro-Brazilian art that combines dance and wrestling. The perfume conjures the Brazilian beach of Itacaré, where dance warriors perform an acrobatic and solar ballet to the rhythm of Berimbau and feverish songs, dazzling the spectator with power, grace and harmony.. Like the sand dispersed in the wind by the acrobatic movements of the Capoeira dancers at sunset, ITABAÏA is a citrus heat wave coloured with vanilla and hemp. Its floral-fruity heart releases the green powdery scrolls of the Jurema flower tinged with a hint of passion fruit..

Presenting a unique variety of vanilla, from the hills of Uganda. This vanilla matures during two rainy seasons and is harvested twice a year in January and July. Ugandan vanilla has broad and flat beans. Their magnetic aroma has leather, fruity cocoa and peat nuances. The name of the perfume translates as “To a Madonna”, to a woman, an archetype merging the divine, sensual and corporeal. The perfumer believes the nature of the selected vanilla’s aroma reflects this duality in a sensory way: being pure, angelic yet seductively carnal at the same time. The dichotomy is highlighted with contrasting themes: animalic (civet & castoreum) and clean (cardamom & gaiac)..

Some battles are worth a few strikes below the belt. Secretly, he tirelessly weaves his web of seduction - and his victims get caught with delight. Friends, lovers, whoever... one only betrays a loved one. True to himself and to his own desires, the traitor is cunning and crafty but at least he does not lie to himself. Like Lucifer with the face of an angel, he makes a virtue of cupidity and knows all its rules inside and out. He who kisses him is damned and yet asks for more. History is full of divine traitors who are looked on as heroes : who would be Cain without Abel, Cesar without Brutus, Cinna without Augustus, Samson without Dalila, Remus without Romulus ? This perfume is a tribute to all the Judas of this world. The price to pay ? 30 denarius..

An anti-hero never lies about who he is, hence the seeming simplicity of this hedonistic and sun-drenched creation, entirely centred on lavender flower. This hero of everyday life fights very ordinary battles at work, when driving, at home without every taking anything too seriously. His innate modesty is extremely appealing and he knows it. He cultivates his imperfections with wit and with natural unconventional elegance. With his tousled hair and look, this somewhat unexpected superman catches the eye and still cannot believe it — that’s why we adore him..
A deep black animalistic composition, with assertive leather notes. Inspiration - A tribute to a fiery & impetuous horse. Perfumer : Bertrand Duchaufour (2021).

Explorethe very soul of the orange blossom in Fleur d’Oranger, a singular scent paletteto enchant the senses. Sparkling petitgrain from the bitter orange tree isswathed in a neroli floral accord before unfurling across an orange blossommellowed with musky magnetism.. The orange blossom, symbol of a sweet and gentle way of life, shares itssultry, indescribably delectable freshness in Fleur d’Oranger..

Jasmin transports us to the gardens of our childhood. It embodies the expression of a poetic, delicate and luxuriant nature. This unique, powdered, single note floral fragrance is orchetrated atound the starry flower. An irresistible moment of freshness ans serenity..

With an ephemeral bust of freshness, an aromatic breath of lavender unfurls in a floral, woody heart, before blossoming fully over mellow, musky notes.. Discover Lavande, a soft, enveloping, tenderly reassuring lavender that transports you instantly to the sunlit French countryside, to the floral heart of Provence..

Simple and sophisticated, Violette embodies the fresh and bright flower, inviting to a sweet trip towards carefreeness. Exceptional and gourmand, this Eau de Parfum provides a delicious sensation, as if time were suspended. The olfactory spell pours out into dreams of evasion..

Like a magic wand, the boldness of Molinard fascinates us. Vanille- Patchouli is the fragrance of the exquisite paradox between provocation and delicacy. Irresistible, the union of the two elements leads to a spectacular attraction. Delicate and racy, the fragrance creates an electroshock of oriental scents..

A gourmand fragrance, Vanille Fruitée embodies a woman filled with freedom and irreverence. The scent seduces through its spontaneity and restores its magnificence to femininity. The unexpected fragrance sparkles through its timeless audacity and creates a summer-scented bouquet..

The Les Éléments collection. A delicious relaxing perfume starting with a very gentle vanilla orchid aroma and then reaching a steady vanilla frequency to make your day more … vanilla in the background.. .

Sensual and voluptuous, Rose has a mysterious simplicity. The Eau de Parfum embodies contemporary feminity with graceful notes ans playfully unveils its fruity chords. An invitation to a walk along the Riviera as a return to the Dolce Vita..

A subtle blend of provocation and seduction, Patchouli is infinitely sensual and addictive. Its light and singular fragrance reveals a mysterious and bewitching wake with woody and copper notes. A vital trip to new daring lands.. A Unisex Eau de Parfum, subversive, of a large Eastern feat, a real Molinard signature!.

The Flower of the Rising Sun!. The blooms of osmanthus, also known as sweet olive, exude sweet, fruity, leathery notes. In its creation bearing the blossom’s name, Molinard presents a surprising twist, blending the intoxicating floral notes of jasmine and tuberose with an irresistibly velvety duet of iris powder and apricot.. A sensuously carnal creation brimming with insouciance and freedom!.

Like a vibrant tribute to the legacy of the perfumer, Musc offers a warm and enveloping wake. The fragrance highlights with sincerity the strokes of a refined and sensual echo, before blossoming in the softness of the skin. The Eau de Parfum delivers the incredible fragrances of a musk of character..

Muguet calls for a getaway in a wonderful garden, on the first days of spring. Enveloping and subtle in its freshness, the Eau de Parfum lets the tender heart of the delicate flower express itself tranparently. A creamy flavour develops around the precious lilies of the valley notes, rounded by the softness of the petals..

The Les Éléments collection. Steep yourself in the rich, sweet, and gentle ambiance of a summer’s evening, caressed by the dappled Mediterranean light shifting in shadows and sunbeams through the branches. Figue is a private paradise for the senses, transporting you to a garden of a thousand colors.. A sparkling Mediterranean citrus is wrapped in the broad leaves of the fig tree. The green fig accord captures the fruit’s mellow, velvety smoothness before unfurling across a woody, musky base note, echoing the silky sap, the nectar of a milky fig.. When the plump, sensual fruit joins with the fig leaf, the fragrance unfolds with profound intensity..

With Cuir, Molinard revisits its past to better face the future. Tinged with the sweet scents of leather, this new element reveals the secrets of that, which was once the city of tanners, Grasse.. Cuir is sensual and with a strong character, disseminating seductive notes of musk and chypre. The rose, jasmine and iris flowers come to visit the spicy herbs and patchouli to create a delicious and addictive smell of leather..

An unforgettable journey in the enchanting lands of the East! Intended to maintain the mystery of seduction, Ambre reveals the refinement of a noble and exclusive matter. This unisex Eau de Parfum offers elegance in a dazzling tone, for a contemporary olfactory interpretation of the Molinard myth..

listings.rawTitle: The Ghost In The Shell 100 ml EdP
listings.description: A bionic fragrance from the future, where nature and technology unites to create something extraordinary. Aqual™, a floral aldehyde that summons rain-soaked lily-of-the-valley, combines with Yuzu in citrusy metallic freshness. Juicy peach intertwines with Hexyl Acetate, an aromachemical with the scent of a green, melting pear. The jasmine heart becomes humanized with a nourishing accord that replicates the scent of milky skin. The result is poetry that lives on the skin..

Your hand guiding me in a firm but gentle hold, we slipped into the wings of the Mariinsky theatre. While the dancers warmed up to the sound of Tchaikovsky, you lent towards me and tenderly kissed my cheek, enveloping me in a sweet, lingering aroma of incense.. A story of contrasts finding its inspiration in Carine’s Slavic roots. The story of a family, of love and transmission. Vladimir is the name of Carine’s son. The contrasting ingredients of orris, incense and amber blow hot and cold, express rigor and fluidity. The fragrance opens with the icy effect of grapefruit and natural bergamot enveloped in the aromatic notes of French sage. The heart reveals the spicy notes of natural cedar and Egyptian geranium. Then arrives the warmth of Moroccan orris, a modern leathery note and a complex ambery accord composed of sensual, woody, vanilla notes..

Leaning against the rooftop railing of your walk-up, the timid light of the studio opposite lit up our faces. Your coat draped over my shoulders, your floriental fragrance enveloping my thoughts, together we watched them – the young artist and his colorful canvas.. A fragrance of unwavering sensuality. The sensuality of the petals of hawthorn flowers, the very generous tuberose absolute and ylang ylang are illuminated by peppers. The powerful presence of sandalwood, benzoin laos, opoponax and venezuelan tonka bean root the ethereal petals in the earth..

Perfumer: Yann Vansier.. You pushed a hidden door in the back of a bookstore, bewitching me as you passed with your chypre scent. Our words drowned by the punk notes of the secret concert, we embraced and watched the crowd.. Poised between tradition and modernity, this is an eclectic perfume. Electrified and inspirited by accords of cannabis and Iranian galbanum resin. The delicate green and floral notes of violet leaf – an utterly exceptional leaf absolute – are combined with jasmine, rose and iris and enhanced by the classic notes of wood, earth and leather offered by oakmoss..

Perfumer: Aurelien Guichard.. My body nestled against your arm, we strolled among the orange trees near the Sacré Cœur, my dangerous heels dancing on the cobblestones. your confident air, my swaying movement… you whispered the improvised poems of our nascent romance.. A fabulous allure. A fine balance between black and white with a floral accord literally enveloped in magnificent incense. Two opposite poles attracting one another. White floral absolutes – orange blossom and jasmine – express depth and mystery. The resins symbolize the Parisian elegance of black. Benzoin, myrrh, opoponax, patchouli and a black amber accord create the intensity of this splendid fragrance..

Perfumer: Pascal Gaurin.. Your ardor outweighed my reason. I can recall those dark streets where we lingered, the sensual gleam of the urban neons caressing our skin. I remember you slipping an osmanthus flower into the open front of my dress.. Addiction of the senses. A perfume offering the forceful contrast of violence and sensuality. The exploration of another continent. A smoked longjing tea combined with the modern leather notes of natural osmanthus conjure an invitation to dangerous, romantic games. Vetiver creates imperceptible fluidity. Bergamot, cardamom, Turkish rose and jasmine nurture the intrigue. Many musks and leathery nuances intensify the mystery.. .

Among the colorful silks and glazed pottery, we loved to lose ourselves in the voluptuous atmosphere of the spices. Sheathed in my leather dress, I can see myself surrounded by all the mysterious, colorful flacons. You chose one exhaling the irresistible notes of oud and trickled two small drops into the hollow of my neck.. A magnetic, very leathery, spicy perfume. A composition of Egyptian jasmine absolute aroused by a complex of soft, sensual, highly textured balsams – tolu balsam, musk and agarwood – and softened by the warm, aromatic notes of cumin, coriander and saffron. Oud base notes define and complete this sultry, flamboyant fragrance..

Leaning against the bar of your argentine café you invited me to dance a tango. The wooden floor vibrated under the shock of our heels, and as you lent me backwards the sultry, spicy notes of your hot skin caressed my own.. Strength and sensuality. The duality of black and red. The fragrance evokes passion, energy, ardor and the languid spirit of dance. It is constructed around the immortelle (with the evocative latin name of “golden sun”) and opens with the strong, energetic scent of immortelle and indian tuberose absolutes. These are lightened by an aqua flora captive merged with the soft notes of sandalwood. At its base a magnificent, creamy, natural vanilla seals the romance..

A new blend from the fictional monks conducting fragrant experiments in their chapel factory.. Hermit Coat might be inspired by the musk of a brilliant yet reclusive detective (Mr. SH. H. ) and is a smooth resinous blend of fir, boswellia, elemi as well as musk and smoke..

A magnificent marriage of Ta’if and Cambodian Oudh providing boundless pleasure. Enormously extravagant, the Elixir intensifies the basic accord to create nothing short of a masterpiece.. It’s a perfume of tremendous presence, personality and panache. Intensely powerful and utterly seductive..

Osmanthus, but not entirely as you know it. It’s a new discovery, catapulting you into a sunny field of flowers embellished with intense citrus notes, crisp and mesmerising as illustrious as the original but more achingly profound.. .

The house signature, astonishingly original and inspired around forests of hemlock and cedar. Now with an added harmonic note of Cambodian Oudh for warmth and intense sensuality with a hint of animalistic spice..

Introducing this superb new edition to Ormonde Jayne’s Signature Collection. Evernia by Ormonde Jayne is a modern take on a classic and is totally unisex. The overall impression is of soft interlacing flowers; lily, freesia, orris and violet, fanned with the unmistakable aroma and tenacity of oakmoss. Moroccan rose adds sweetness and cardamom an intense wave of spice.. Cashmeran, sandalwood and musk give Evernia its underlying softness and sensuality. Wear Evernia on any occasion when you want to feel at your alluring best..

Perfumer: Anne-Sophie Behaghel. A radiant woody perfume with an intriguing name. Is it match as in a box of matches? The perfume does possess that dry wood and cardboard vibe escaping from a box when you take a match out. Or is it a match with your skin? There is a lot of musky sandalwood and veil-like ambroxan that together create an alluring clean super-layer hovering over your skin. Or match as in new love?.

The 2021 batch is blended according to the same recepie as the 2019 batch of FUM. However, the plant ingredients have matured in different weather, took a different amount of sun, etc. and this new batch is a beautiful new variation.. The concept . The camp is already mounted in a forest clearing. On the fire camp, what we have been gathering for hours is being destilled. Juniper berries and wood, pine resin, birch bark and moss. The gentle winter sun fades away and our clothes are impregnated with the resins and the smoke. In the morning, with the firsts lights, after making coffee in the embers, our hands give a bright contrast to the blend, keeping the fragrance of an orange that was pealed without a knife. This is it. FUM (smoke in Catalan) captures the simplicity of a mountain expedition in winter. It’s not a place, but a shared momento in the wild.. What's in the bottle . Limited edition olfactive experiments (only 50 bottles ever made), wild aromatic landscapes beyond IFRA regulations. This is not a conventional perfume. It's a fragrant story you can sniff from the cuff of your jacket, from a blotter lying on your desk - or invent your own way to enter this space, leaving mundane and ordinary behind. These Bravanariz 'olfactory digressions' are 100% natural and are made from herbs, woods and flowers collected in the Spanish Emporda natural park where the house is based. These blends are wild literally (made from wild flora) and also wild in terms of not complying with mass market regulations and fashion.. IMPORTANT NOTE : This is not “a perfume”. It is an Olfactory Digression, and is blended by Bravanariz to be a different olfactory and sensory experience compared to “perfumes”. It does not comply with the IFRA standards, and for that reason is not recommended for topical (direct application to skin) use. Please spray on fabric (scarf, sleeve, etc.) to experience. .

Mediterranean sun in a bottle. Lemon, fennel, pine and immortelle. Sempreviva, means “always alive”. It is the Catalan name for immortelle (Helichrysum italicum). When you cut the flower, it keeps its colour and smell for years. Its yellow buttons, concentrate the solar radiations and turn the Empordà’s fields into a golden sea in an attempt to emulate the burning star. Sempreviva, is like diving into the ever-returning energy of the sun. Is not hope what this flask contains, but confidence. Confidence and warmth.. This blend is part of Bravanariz limited edition olfactive experiments (only 50 bottles of each batch are ever made), wild aromatic landscapes beyond IFRA regulations. . It does not comply with the IFRA standards, and for that reason is not recommended for topical (direct application to skin) use. Please spray on fabric (scarf, sleeve, etc.) to experience. .

The warmth of the horses in the cold morning, raising the aroma of chamomile in the prairies as they pass by. The leather of saddles, chaps and headbands of the harness room. The animal intensity of cattle and rockroses, the austere elegance of oak moss and lavender. And those cigars and pipes charged with marine tobaccos, smoked by the fire place, when the script of life is written after a working day in the Extremadura fields. Casa Cuervo contains some of the best moments spent the Bravanariz owner spent with his family, sharing his father's dreams and passions..
